items.title: The Pre-Owned Watch Market Is Back to Normal and Rolex Remains the Undisputed Leader
items.text: The Pre-Owned Watch Market Is Back to Normal and Rolex Remains the Undisputed Leader Summary Rolex's share of sales on Chrono24 dropped to 30.5% from a 44% peak in 2022, returning the brand to pre-pandemic market levelsThe watchmaker remains the marketplace leader with 31% of total sales volume, significantly ahead of competitors Omega and Patek PhilippeYounger shoppers are driving a shift toward dressier models like the Datejust, which has become the brand's top revenue generator on the platform The crown is heavy but Rolex still wears it. Following an unprecedented surge during the pandemic lockdown era, the secondary watch market is finally cooling off. A new report from Chrono24 reveals that Rolex currently commands 30.5 percent of sales on the platform. The figure represents a stark contrast to the 44 percent market share the Swiss powerhouse held during the peak of 2022. This shift brings the manufacturer back to its pre-pandemic baseline and indicates a broader market normalization. Prices for highly coveted timepieces are stabilizing after years of skyrocketing demand.Despite the statistical pullback, the watchmaker maintains an iron grip on the top spot. During the second quarter of this year, Rolex accounted for 31 percent of total sales volume on the marketplace. Competitors remain far behind in the rearview mirror. Omega secured 11 percent of sales volume during the same period, while Patek Philippe captured 6 percent. The changing tide is most visible in the luxury tier exceeding the $20,000 mark. In this elite bracket, brands like Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet and Vacheron Constantin are carving out larger pieces of the pie at the expense of the industry leader.Mid-tier luxury remains absolute territory for the Geneva-based giant. Timepieces priced between $10,000 and $20,000 make up the core segment where Rolex secures 61.4 percent of all Chrono24 sales. This sweet spot houses legendary silhouettes including the Submariner, the GMT-Master II and the stainless steel Daytona. Buyers chasing these iconic sports models previously fueled the massive pandemic price premiums. As hype transitions into a more calculated consumer mindset, buyers are spending their money deliberately across a wider spectrum of horological options.Younger collectors are fundamentally altering the current retail landscape. items.title: Mercedes-AMG CLA 45 4MATIC+ Claims Nürburgring Nordschleife Class Record
items.text: Mercedes-AMG CLA 45 4MATIC+ Claims Nürburgring Nordschleife Class Record Summary Mercedes-AMG has announced that the all-electric CLA 45 4MATIC+ set an official Nürburgring Nordschleife class record Driven by Kevin Berger the stock electric sedan completed the 20.8-kilometer lap in 7 minutes and 32.070 seconds Powered by three axial-flux motors producing 680 horsepower the performance EV accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in 2.7 seconds Mercedes-AMG has officially set a new Nürburgring Nordschleife class record with the all-electric Mercedes-AMG CLA 45 4MATIC+. Driven by driver Kevin Berger, the high-performance four-door sedan recorded an official, notarized lap time of 7:32.070 minutes, crowning it the fastest vehicle in its segment around the iconic circuit.The record-setting run was achieved in a stock production-spec vehicle fitted with track-focused Pirelli P Zero Trofeo RS tires. Powering the electric CLA 45 is a tri-motor setup utilizing liquid-cooled axial-flux electric motors—two mounted on the rear axle and one at the front—delivering a combined output of up to 680 horsepower (500 kW). This powertrain configuration utilizes a fully variable AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel-drive system with rear torque vectoring, pushing the vehicle from 0 to 100 km/h in 2.7 seconds.Built on an 800-volt electrical architecture, the sedan integrates adaptive suspension, refined aerodynamics, and continuous thermal management engineered to sustain peak power output across demanding track laps. items.text: EVANGELION:95’s First FW26 Drop Turns Five Iconic Anime Moments Into Faux-Vintage 1995 Graphic Tees Summary EVANGELION:95 rolls out five graphic T-shirts drawn from key 'Neon Genesis Evangelion' scenes and artworkEvery tee is built on heavyweight 100% cotton with deliberate fading and distressing for a vintage feelThe lineup pulls from End of Evangelion, the fan-favorite Episode 9 battle, and a classic CD jacket EVANGELION:95 has released its first Fall/Winter 2026 run of five graphic T-shirts translating landmark Neon Genesis Evangelion imagery into apparel styled to look like it survived from 1995. Each design pairs a specific scene or piece of franchise artwork with the brand's faux-vintage construction, positioning the T-shirts as statement pieces rather than standard merch.The construction is consistent across the collection and central to its concept. Every shirt uses a 6.5oz heavyweight 100% cotton body described as smooth to the touch, durable and absorbent. From there, the brand leans into wear that would normally take years to develop, building in body fading and adding intentional distressing at the collar and cuffs. The result is a deliberately aged finish meant to sharpen each graphic, and the damage detailing is baked into the design rather than treated as a flaw.The graphics themselves span the franchise's most charged moments. Two T-shirts draw from the film End of Evangelion: the 0097 in white centers on Unit-01's awakening scene paired with "AWAKENING" text, while the 0099 in black turns to the striking Mass Production Evas, both backed by the brand's original anti-A.T. Field pattern. Another pair pulls from the fan-favorite ninth TV episode, "Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win," staging the clash between Units 01 and 02 and the Angel Israfel across front and back, each sleeve marked with an in-scene countdown time.The fifth design reaches into franchise music history. The 0103 in black is built around the CD jacket for Yoko Takahashi's single "Soul's Refrain," the theme from the film Death & Rebirth, with the vintage jacket illustration digitized in high resolution and a period poster graphic printed on the back. It lands as the most collector-leaning piece in the group.All of it flows from the brand's founding idea. items.title: Nan Shufang Carries Its Scholar's-Study Aesthetic Into Hong Kong With a Pacific Place Debut
items.text: Nan Shufang Carries Its Scholar's-Study Aesthetic Into Hong Kong With a Pacific Place Debut Summary Nan Shufang has opened its first Hong Kong store at Pacific Place, its debut location beyond the Chinese mainlandThe brand builds each space around the tradition of the Chinese scholar's study, uniting objects, setting and cultural activityWooden wares, porcelain wares, and gold and silver wares anchor a lineup meant to be used and passed down rather than simply displayed Nan Shufang, a premium Chinese cultural brand rooted in the tradition of the scholar's study, has officially opened its first Hong Kong store at Pacific Place. The opening marks a significant step in the brand's global expansion, framing the space as an immersive experience that ties together objects, setting and cultural engagement.The brand's identity reaches back to its 2008 founding. Nan Shufang established its first location in Beijing's Houhai area and takes its name from the "South Study," or Nan Shufang, of the Forbidden City, a nod to its scholarly lineage. That heritage informs a guiding belief that objects are not simply functional vessels but carriers of culture, craft and spiritual value. The brand roots that idea in a line from the Zhuangzi's "Ren Jian Shi" chapter: "The achievement of beauty takes time; the making of ugliness allows no room for correction, how cautious one must be."The Hong Kong store arrives as part of a wider footprint. Nan Shufang now runs cultural spaces across Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen and Hong Kong, a four-city network of seven stores that each interprets the scholar's-study theme through object display, spatial design and cultural experience. The mainland locations range from the founding Houhai store to metropolitan settings at Beijing's China World and SKP, a Shanghai Xintiandi space built around refined pursuits such as incense appreciation and tea tasting, a historic Amanyangyun site, and a Shenzhen Bay MixC store attuned to that city's open, contemporary character.At the center of the offering sit three craft categories. Wooden wares focus on classical furniture and scholar's-study objects built through mortise-and-tenon joinery and hand carving, with an emphasis on proportion, line and spatial rhythm. Porcelain wares carry forward classical ceramic forms and glazing, spanning everyday tea wares to desk pieces. items.title: David O. Russell's ‘Madden’ Biopic Starring Nicolas Cage To Premiere November 2026
items.text: David O. Russell's ‘Madden’ Biopic Starring Nicolas Cage To Premiere November 2026 Summary David O. Russell's John 'Madden' biopic will premiere on Prime Video in November rather than in wide releaseNicolas Cage stars as the Raiders coach turned broadcaster, with Christian Bale playing Al DavisA limited theatrical run is planned for awards eligibility, but the film skips a nationwide big-screen rollout David O. Russell's sports drama Madden, starring Nicolas Cage as the legendary football coach and commentator John Madden, is heading to Prime Video this fall. Amazon MGM, which is backing the film, has set it to arrive on the streamer November 18, with an awards-qualifying theatrical release expected earlier in the month.The film traces Madden's full arc as a defining figure in American football. He led the Oakland Raiders through repeated championship contention in the 1970s and delivered the franchise its first Super Bowl win, then retired from coaching in 1979 and spent the next three decades as a fixture of televised football as a color commentator. Russell's movie follows that career alongside two central relationships: Madden's friendship with Al Davis, played by Christian Bale, and his partnership with his wife Virginia, played by Kathryn Hahn. John Mulaney, Sienna Miller and Shane Gillis fill out the rest of the cast.Russell framed the project's ambitions when it was first announced in 2024. "[The] feature will be about the joy, humanity and genius that was John Madden in a wildly inventive, cool world of the 1970s," the director said at the time.What remains less clear is the reasoning behind the streaming-first strategy. Russell carries serious awards pedigree as the filmmaker behind American Hustle, Silver Linings Playbook and The Fighter, which makes the decision to forgo a wide theatrical release notable. That said, Russell has long been a divisive presence in Hollywood, with a well-documented history of combative on-set conduct, and his most recent feature, 2022's star-packed period piece Amsterdam, was a costly box-office failure, taking in roughly $31 million USD worldwide against an $80 million USD budget and posting heavy losses for its studio.Madden is expected to play a limited, awards-qualifying theatrical run in early November before premiering worldwide on Prime Video November 18. items.text: UNION and in･stru(mental). items.text: New Era and ‘Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn’ Stitch In-Universe Emblems Onto the 9FORTY A-Frame Trucker Summary New Era and 'Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn' team up on a 9FORTY A-Frame trucker cap through STRICT-GThe cap arrives in two versions set apart by their front emblem, one Anaheim Electronics and one Vist FoundationA single-panel pinched front, breathable mesh and an adjustable strap define the build New Era and Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn have collaborated on a 9FORTY A-Frame trucker cap, released through STRICT-G in two emblem-specific versions. Both lean on New Era's classic logo-cap format, swapping in crests tied to the anime's in-universe organizations.The foundation is New Era's 9FORTY A-Frame, a variant of the shape-retaining 9FORTY built to hold its form. Rather than a rounded multi-panel crown, the A-Frame runs a single front panel with a pinched top, giving the cap a distinctive profile before any branding is added.Function is handled through familiar trucker-cap cues. A breathable mesh construction keeps the build ventilated, while a curved visor and an adjustable strap are set up to dial in a comfortable, flexible fit.Branding is where the two versions diverge, and it stays deliberately clean. One version wears the Anaheim Electronics crest, the other the Vist Foundation crest, letting buyers pick their allegiance while keeping the rest of the design unadorned.Both versions of the STRICT-G x New Era Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn 9FORTY A-Frame trucker are scheduled to ship in September 2026 via STRICT-G. items.title: Tiny Vinyl Launches a $49.99 USD Miniature Turntable Built Specifically for Its Four-Inch Record Format
items.text: Tiny Vinyl Launches a $49.99 USD Miniature Turntable Built Specifically for Its Four-Inch Record Format Summary Compact belt-drive turntable designed specifically for four-inch 33.3 RPM recordsFeatures integrated stereo speakers, Bluetooth output and a 3.5mm headphone jackCompletes a collectible music ecosystem with matching storage crates and display frames Tiny Vinyl launched a dedicated miniature turntable engineered specifically for its proprietary four-inch record format. Priced at $49.99 USD, the new tabletop machine pairs the palm-sized discs with hardware scaled to match. The device features a black leatherette suitcase design and utilizes a belt-driven platter rotating at 33.3 RPM. While the miniature records remain fully compatible with standard manual turntables, the dedicated player provides a specialized hardware solution for casual collectors. This drop establishes a comprehensive physical ecosystem for a novelty format that has already surpassed one million global pressings.Measuring just over 10 inches wide, the unit opts for straightforward accessibility over high-end audiophile specs. The player operates via AC power and bypasses battery operation entirely. Listeners can push audio out through built-in stereo speakers or utilize Bluetooth connectivity for external sound systems. A standard 3.5mm headphone jack offers a hardwired alternative for personal listening. The machine specifically spins the brand's growing catalog of sequentially numbered releases from major artists like BTS, Rihanna, Ariana Grande and The Rolling Stones. Each pressing relies on 15 grams of 100 percent bio-attributed vinyl instead of the standard 140 grams required for a conventional LP.Beyond the core hardware, the company expanded the collectible footprint with two new organizational accessories. A $19.99 miniature storage crate features a wood frame covered in black leatherette with a velveteen interior designed to house up to 32 individual releases. Fans looking to highlight the physical artwork can grab a $14.99 square display frame equipped with a shatter-resistant window and magnetic closures. The frame holds four record jackets and mounts easily on a wall or flat surface. Together these add-ons replicate the familiar rituals of digging, shelving and exhibiting wax with considerably less furniture involved.The dedicated player transforms a novelty merchandise item into a legitimate consumer audio category. items.title: A LEGO Ideas Fan Build Recreates Jeff Koons' Iconic 'Balloon Dog' in 1,026 Bricks
items.text: A LEGO Ideas Fan Build Recreates Jeff Koons' Iconic 'Balloon Dog' in 1,026 Bricks Summary An independent designer submitted a 1,026-piece pop-art sculpture recreation to the LEGO Ideas platformThe glossy red build utilizes specialized curved windscreen elements to mimic the smooth lobes of an inflated balloonA hidden interior compartment depicts the animal as a pressurized industrial vessel operated by minifigures Contemporary art meets brick engineering with a massive new fan submission on the LEGO Ideas platform. Independent creator brxstr recently unveiled a 1,026-piece homage to the iconic Jeff Koons sculpture. While the Danish toy brand already produces a fingernail-sized balloon dog accessory for carnival sets, this display-ready model scales the concept up to 15 inches long and 12.5 inches tall.The structural foundation relies on a single specialized part. Piece 5274 is an 8x6x2 curved windscreen that entered the brand palette in 2024. The builder scrapped an earlier iteration of the project to utilize this exact element. Mirroring two of these windscreens together forms a single smooth balloon segment for the legs, body, ears and nose. Tapered tips use a smaller rounded windscreen to close off the ends. Technic angled pieces handle the internal connecting work to keep the skeleton completely hidden. A clever side effect of this construction is the visible plate seams along each lobe mimicking the natural crease lines of over-inflated latex.Beneath the serene glossy red exterior lies a highly detailed and humorous interior. Lifting the top off the body reveals a pressurized industrial operation. Inside sits a minifigure wearing a yellow hazmat suit with a radiation warning on his chest. This worker stands over a trans-blue gas cylinder equipped with a chrome pipe, a printed gauge panel and a valve wheel. Four official miniature LEGO balloon dogs sit racked up on the wall behind him like lab specimens. A second minifigure occupies the head cavity to steer the vessel.The Balloon Dog Mk II submission is currently gathering community votes to be considered for production as an official retail set. The designer noted that only two specific parts do not currently exist in the correct red colorway. He also pitched the possibility of future multicolor variants to match the diverse spectrum of the original gallery artworks. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Bugatti's New One-Off Destrier Transforms the Track-Only Bolide Into a Coachbuilt Masterpiece
items.text: Bugatti's New One-Off Destrier Transforms the Track-Only Bolide Into a Coachbuilt Masterpiece Summary Bugatti’s bespoke Solitaire division has revealed the Destrier, a one-off hypercar adapting the track-focused Bolide into an elegant road-oriented machineThe vehicle retains a 1,578-horsepower quad-turbo W16 engine and carbon tub but removes aggressive downforce elements in favor of a sleek profile standing just one meter tallFinished in Sapphire Celeste blue, the model pays homage to Ralph Lauren’s Type 57SC and features a luxurious cabin detailed with leather, nubuck and 3D-knitted textiles Bugatti has expanded its exclusive Solitaire program with the unveiling of the Destrier. Built on the ferocious foundation of the Bolide track car, this unique one-of-one creation translates relentless circuit performance into a masterpiece of coachbuilt proportions. By stripping away the high-downforce prototype aerodynamics of its predecessor, the French marque highlights an incredibly low-slung carbon tub pushed forward to emphasize the brand's signature C-shaped metallic streak.The hypercar trades aggressive winglets and massive rear aero for a subtler flat spoiler and a sleek silhouette that stands just one meter tall. Flared front fenders rise sharply from the beltline, complementing staggered 20-inch front and 21-inch rear wheels. Out back, the Bolide’s quad tailpipes remain intact, though its X-shaped track lights are swapped out for a bespoke cross-shaped LED pattern. Bugatti design chief Frank Heyl noted that removing the aerodynamic constraints allowed the team to treat the underlying architecture as pure sculpture. It is scheduled to make its global debut at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.The exterior paint finish serves as a deeply rooted historical tribute. Dubbed Sapphire Celeste, the unique blue shade honors the original color of the Type 57SC Atlantic famously owned by Ralph Lauren. The aesthetic link bridges the gap between road and track, mirroring the historic relationship between the 57SC street car and the Type 57G racer that secured a victory at the 1937 24 Hours of Le Mans. The connection underscores how the new machine bridges raw motorsport heritage with refined grand touring luxury.Inside the cabin, the extreme minimalism of a race car gives way to lush materials and exquisite detailing. items.text: Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy" Merges Six Fictional Alter Egos Summary Jordan Brand is reviving its 2012 Kilroy Pack through a singular mismatched Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy"The left and right shoes feature distinct color blockings and details representing Michael Jordan's six fictional alter egosThe pair is expected to release on August 14 for $180 USD via Nike and select retailer Name: Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy"Colorway: Black/Deep Royal Blue-White-Challenge RedSKU: IV6476-010MSRP: $180 USDRelease Date: August 14, 2026Where to Buy: NikeJordan Brand is revisiting a unique piece of Michael Jordan lore with the upcoming release of the Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy." The new release takes the memorable 2012 "Kilroy Pack" and creatively folds it into a single mismatched low-top silhouette.Rather than reissuing all six original pairs—dedicated to Michael Jordan's alter egos Johnny Kilroy, Motorboat Jones, Bentley Ellis, Slim Jenkins, Calvin Bailey, and Fontay Montana—the brand has scattered their signature colors and details across the design. The left shoe features a primarily black build with dark blue wrapping the lower half, an orange midsole, yellow lining, and white laces. In stark contrast, the right shoe goes in a completely different direction, utilizing red leather, black overlays, light blue lining, and black laces.To further honor the 2012 pack, the tongue tags spell out the names of the alter egos, acting as a checklist for the mismatched aesthetic. Additional thematic callbacks include three stacked Jumpman logos on the insoles and heel embroidery alternating between numbers "23" and "4." Finally, "KILROY WAS HERE" is printed behind the tongues to directly tie the model back to the original advertising campaign.The Air Jordan 9 Low "What The Kilroy" is expected to release on August 14, 2026. items.title: John David Washington to Star in Supernatural Horror Thriller 'Mime'
items.text: John David Washington to Star in Supernatural Horror Thriller 'Mime' Summary John David Washington is set to star in and produce the upcoming supernatural horror thriller 'Mime'Nikyatu Jusu will direct the film based on an original spec screenplay written by Stephen HermanSony Screen Gems acquired the feature project after competing against Amazon and Searchlight Sony's Screen Gems has officially landed the rights to Mime, an upcoming supernatural horror thriller starring John David Washington. The studio beat out competitive offers from Amazon and Searchlight to secure the feature project.Nikyatu Jusu, who made her feature directorial debut with the Sundance Grand Jury Prize winner Nanny, is attached to direct. The screenplay was written by Stephen Herman based on his original spec concept, though specific storyline details are currently being kept under wraps.The project is produced by Matt Tolmach alongside The Black Phone filmmaker Scott Derrickson via his Crooked Highway banner. Washington will also serve as a producer on the film alongside Tolmach's partner Camila Grove. Washington previously starred in Spike Lee's BlacKkKlansman, Christopher Nolan's Tenet, Gareth Edwards' The Creator, and most recently appeared in the 2024 drama The Piano Lesson. One of two neuroscience-backed models alongside the Mind 002 sneaker, the mule has sold out with regularity since it launched in January, giving this new colorway a built-in audience.On the makeup itself, official images show Palest Purple running from heel to toe, keeping the design almost entirely tonal. Early Mind releases leaned on a bright accent applied to the 22 foam nodes underfoot, but Nike has since moved away from that approach, leaning into fully monochrome executions across its more recent drops. The "Palest Purple" sits squarely in that newer, tonal direction. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

The café serves original blends and Cabourn’s beloved flat white, extending the brand’s lifestyle ethos into a sensory experience.To commemorate the opening, customers spending over ¥22,000 JPY (approx. $150 USD) will receive an exclusive Omotesando Store keychain, designed in homage to vintage motel chains and engraved with messages such as “Cheers body!” and “Love Nige x.”Nigel Cabourn OMOTESANDO STOREPine Under Flat B1F, 5-13-2 JingumaeShibuya-ku, Tokyo 150-0001, Japan Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

The Tokyo Jazz Club is set to make its debut in November, launching as a major new cultural event in partnership with Art Week Tokyo. Located near the Jimbocho district, the innovative project will take over all eight floors of a former capsule hotel, transforming the unconventional venue into a dynamic, multi-level hybrid space.Designed to blur the boundaries between a contemporary art exhibition, a socialization hub and a marketplace, the Tokyo Jazz Club will bring together a diverse array of artists, galleries, and musicians under one roof. items.title: Timberland's FW26 Tokyo Design Collective Line Reinterprets "Timeless Heritage" Through Flannel, Corduroy and Leather
items.text: Timberland's FW26 Tokyo Design Collective Line Reinterprets "Timeless Heritage" Through Flannel, Corduroy and Leather Summary The Timberland by TOKYO DESIGN COLLECTIVE line returns for its seventh installment with a Fall/Winter 2026 collectionA "TIMELESS HERITAGE" theme centers on Timberland's material heritage and enduring brand colorsTokyo-directed design filters American workwear roots through Japanese craftsmanship and sensibility Timberland is releasing the seventh installment of Timberland by TOKYO DESIGN COLLECTIVE, the premium line directed by the Tokyo-based TDC team, with a Fall/Winter 2026 collection built around a "TIMELESS HERITAGE" theme. The season leans on the brand's long-standing material use and timeless colors, translated through a distinctly Japanese lens.The collection is drawn from Timberland's roots in American workwear and outdoor culture, then rebuilt with Japanese craftsmanship and feel. Framed as a Japan-born project that speaks to a global audience, it aims for pieces that balance approachability, functionality and a universality meant to outlast trends.Fabric is where that thinking gets concrete. The season's key materials are a yarn-dyed flannel with rich surface character, a corduroy defined by its refined wale, and the premium leather that has long been a Timberland signature. By combining those different materials deliberately, TDC pushes the designs toward a space where classic and modern elements sit together rather than competing. The lineup runs all-gender, spanning outerwear such as the Stratham bomber and a heavier zip jacket, an LS thermal, a TIMBS hoodie, and headwear including a waxed leather-patch cap and a corded hat.The reinterpretation extends to how the collection is shown. TDC places its Tokyo-made styles within architecture and scenery that read as unmistakably Japanese, capturing the product among contrasting forces of nature and city, stillness and motion. It is a framing meant to express the team's particular view: heritage seen again through a Japanese sensibility.That heritage runs deep on the Timberland side. The brand was founded in 1973 in Stratham, New Hampshire, and earned global recognition with the original Yellow Boot, designed for people working in the harsh conditions of New England. items.title: Lionsgate Targets a Late 2027 to Early 2028 Release for ‘Michael 2’
items.text: Lionsgate Targets a Late 2027 to Early 2028 Release for ‘Michael 2’ Lionsgate is pushing ahead on Michael 2, the sequel to its blockbuster Michael Jackson biopic, with plans to roll cameras as early as late 2026 or the start of 2027. Motion picture chief Adam Fogelson laid out the timeline on the studio's latest earnings call, flagging a release window that runs from the end of 2027 into the first half of 2028.The sequel's momentum is a direct product of the original's numbers. Michael, directed by Antoine Fuqua, became a commercial powerhouse, grossing in the neighborhood of $1 billion USD worldwide and posting what has been billed as the strongest opening a biopic has ever recorded. The film charts the King of Pop's climb from the Jackson 5 to global superstardom and closes on his 1987 Bad tour, with the singer's real-life nephew Jaafar Jackson in the lead. Its parting title card, "His Story Continues," left little doubt that a follow-up was coming.On the timeline itself, Fogelson signaled that the sequel can lean partly on footage already in the can. A number of sequences filmed for the first movie went unused and are now likely to migrate into the second. "We have a number of sequences, particularly some big musical sequences, that were shot previously, that are almost sure to be incorporated," Fogelson said on the earnings call. He added that the studio's attention is currently on delivering the biggest, best sequel it can at the right price.Stay tuned for more details. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

The upcoming colorway introduces a thermal heat map treatment paired with bold structural overlays.The upper is constructed with a deep purple base overlaid with a bleeding gradient of red, yellow, aqua, and blue hues that simulate a radar scan. Bright orange covers the oversized Swoosh logo alongside sharp, angular support pieces embedded through the midsole. Black accents settle across the tongue, laces with orange trim, collar, and outsole, giving the multi-toned color arrangement a grounded frame.Shifting away from the softer contours of the Ja 3, the Ja 4 features a more angular build with heavily textured materials and enlarged support structures surrounding the midfoot and heel. Personal details for the guard appear throughout, including Morant's signature logo on the tongue and repeated "12" markings molded into the orange sections underfoot.The Nike Ja 4 "Radar" releases in October 2026 for $140 USD. items.text: Nike Wraps the Mind 002 Slip-On in Cooling “Work Blue” Nike has revealed a "Work Blue" colorway of the Mind 002, dressing its neuroscience-minded slip-on in a cooler palette for Fall/Winter. The makeover reworks the model's established look rather than reshaping the shoe itself, pairing a blue-forward upper with a bright accent.The colorway sticks to the blueprint the Mind 002 debuted with. Its two-tone blocking carries over, but this run fills that structure with cooler shades across the upper, giving the slip-on a calmer, more subdued read. The lead tone is a Horizon Blue that sets the mood for the whole makeup.Against those cool shades, the shoe reworks its high-visibility detailing through a Light Lemon Twist trim. It functions as the makeup's one jolt of contrast, a fresh take on the hi-vis accenting that keeps the pair from reading as entirely monochromatic.Underpinning the colorway is the Mind line itself, Nike's slip-on platform positioned around its neuroscience angle.The 002 sits as the more attainable, everyday-ready entry point into that family, a lower-key counterpart to the sold-out, resale-inflated Mind 001. items.title: Ye Unveils Four Pastel Colorways for the Upcoming Yeezy 800
items.text: Ye Unveils Four Pastel Colorways for the Upcoming Yeezy 800 Summary Ye has revealed four new pastel colorways of the independent Yeezy 800 silhouetteThe retro running design combines ballistic mesh nubuck overlays and textured synthetic panelsThe model is expected to release during Fall/Winter 2026 via Yeezy YEEZY founder Ye has revealed new pastel iterations of the upcoming YEEZY 800 silhouette. The updated previe, which the artist posted to his Instagram Stories, expands upon the initial all-black edition of the independent runner, introducing a vibrant shift from the brand's traditional muted earth tones.The Yeezy 800 leans into a retro running shape, featuring a complex layered construction across the upper. Ballistic mesh forms the tongue, while textured panels reinforce the toe and heel sections. Nubuck-like overlays frame the eyestays and forefoot, complemented by layers of loose, gauze-style mesh that give the upper a raw, unpolished texture that continues onto portions of the midsole.Marking a return to the numbered naming format used throughout Ye's classic releases, the model signals a new era of independent production for the brand. Following reports of a retail partnership with JD Sports, the silhouette could become one of the first post-adidas Yeezy footwear releases to receive wider mainstream distribution.The Yeezy 800 is expected to launch during Fall/Winter 2026 through the Yeezy website and select retailers. items.title: teamLab Transforms Osaka's Sunflowers Into an Interactive Ecosystem
items.text: teamLab Transforms Osaka's Sunflowers Into an Interactive Ecosystem Summary teamLab unveils new interactive sunflower artwork at Osaka Botanical Garden.Sunflowers glow and emit tones, responding to visitor presence and movement.Installation fosters connection, awareness and meditative engagement with nature through digital art. International art collective teamLab has unveiled its latest seasonal interactive installation, Life is the Small Sun Flickering in the Dark, at the permanent nighttime open-air museum teamLab Botanical Garden Osaka inside Nagai Park. Featuring a soundscape created by composer Hideaki Takahashi, the 2026 installation transforms a field of roughly 20,000 white sunflowers into an ethereal, glowing landscape where living flora, technology, and human presence merge into a single interactive ecosystem. Operating on view through August 16, 2026 - subject to the seasonal blooming period of the flowers - the exhibition turns the botanical garden into a dynamic sensory environment after dusk.The artwork comes to life through human and animal interaction across the darkness. When visitors or local wildlife approach and stand near the sunflowers, the individual plants respond by illuminating more intensely and emitting a distinct resonant audio tone. This initial pulse of light and sound rapidly ripples outward to adjacent sunflowers, creating a continuous wave that radiates through the entire field. If a secondary wave of light approaches from across the meadow, it alerts guests to the presence of another person or creature moving on the far side, transforming the physical behaviors of those in the space into a collective visual and auditory dialogue.Rooted in teamLab’s conceptual exploration of how existence is continuous with its surrounding environment, Life is the Small Sun Flickering in the Dark frames each sunflower not as an isolated entity, but as part of an interconnected web of relationships. Rather than treating art as a static object with rigid physical boundaries, the collective uses flow, light, and sound to establish an evolving ecological field where audience participation actively shapes the structure of the pieceteamLab Botanical Garden OsakaNagai Botanical Garden at 1-23 Nagaikoen,Higashisumiyoshi-ku, Osaka 546-0034, Japan View this post on Instagram A post shared by teamLab (@teamlab) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Seiko Brings Its ‘Passionately and Obsessively Crafted Watches’ Exhibition to London This Summer
items.text: Seiko Brings Its ‘Passionately and Obsessively Crafted Watches’ Exhibition to London This Summer Seiko will bring its Passionately and Obsessively Crafted Watches exhibition to Japan House in London. This marks the third consecutive year the brand has showcased its Power Design Project outside Japan, offering visitors a rare glimpse into the creative process behind one of the world’s most respected watchmakers. The exhibition highlights Seiko’s philosophy of innovation and craftsmanship, while celebrating Japanese culture in a global setting.The exhibition highlights seven conceptual timepieces, each expressing a different designer's hyper-fixation on specific physical elements. Takuya Matsumoto’s "Dial Texture" uses high-precision metal stamping - controlled to within one-hundredth of a millimeter - to render intricate geometric patterns inspired by Spain's Alhambra Palace.Naoya Sukeda’s "Machining Marks" draws inspiration from fine woodworking, deliberately leaving visible tool marks and file textures on a stepped steel case to celebrate the artisan's hand. Meanwhile, Design Director Miho Wada’s "Bar Indices" transforms standard hour markers into a hypnotic grid across a rectangular face, creating a dense mosaic where polished beams harmonize light.Rounding out the lineup are concepts that redefine watch geometry and typography. Yu Ishihara’s "Spherical Surface" seamlessly aligns the curvature of the glass, bezel, case and crown guard into a single continuous sphere. Free to the public, the exhibition will officially unveil at Japan House on August 27 and will remain on view until September 15, 2026.Japan House101-111 Kensington High St,London W8 5SA, United Kingdom Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: KIDILL x UMBRO's "Wizard" FW26 Track Suit Pairs a Waist-Length Hood With 40-Plus Adjusters
items.text: KIDILL x UMBRO's "Wizard" FW26 Track Suit Pairs a Waist-Length Hood With 40-Plus Adjusters Summary KIDILL and UMBRO have reunited for a second collaboration, delivering a unisex "Wizard" track jacket and matching track pantsThe set builds on UMBRO's functional sportswear patterns while carrying KIDILL's punk sensibility and the sorcery-tinged theme of its Fall/Winter 2026 "Heaven" collectionMore than 40 adjusters let the wearer reshape the garments, and the jacket's hood extends dramatically down to the waist KIDILL and UMBRO have linked for a second time, folding a unisex "Wizard" track jacket and track pants into KIDILL's Fall/Winter 2026 "Heaven" collection. The pairing runs UMBRO's athletic construction through KIDILL's subversive lens, arriving as a track set that treats its own silhouette as something the wearer can rebuild at will.The engineering is the hook. Both the jacket and the pants are fitted with more than 40 adjusters positioned along their seams and panel breaks, and cinching or releasing them lets the wearer stretch and reshape the outline of each piece. It is a genuinely modular approach to a track suit, one that keeps the functional bones of sportswear intact while opening the garment up to constant reinvention.That performance framework comes from UMBRO, whose sportswear patterning forms the base of the collaboration. KIDILL then layers its own punk attitude on top, and the clearest expression of that is the jacket's hood, which extends far enough to reach the waist. The exaggerated shape reads like something pulled from a sorcerer's robe, a deliberate nod that ties the piece to the wider mood of the season.That mood is where the collaboration connects to a bigger story. The set belongs to KIDILL's "Heaven" collection, whose Fall/Winter 2026 lineup runs on tarot-inspired artwork, and the wizardly hood is designed to echo that visual world. The result positions a functional two-piece as part of a larger narrative rather than a standalone drop. Offered across four colorways in black, pink, blue, and gray, the range extends the partnership the two brands first explored together in the Spring/Summer 2025 season.The KIDILL x UMBRO "Wizard" track jacket and track pants release on Saturday, August 8, 2026, at KIDILL ROOM and KIDILL stockists. items.title: mfpen's 10th Anniversary Runway Show Teases New Balance Collaboration
items.text: mfpen's 10th Anniversary Runway Show Teases New Balance Collaboration On Wednesday, mfpen presented its SS27 collection “Deadlines” at Copenhagen Fashion Week. Marking 10 years in business, the Danish label embraces the spirit of imperfection for a collection of “overworked” office-wear-inspired silhouettes.Exploring “the feeling of working late nights on a project to meet a deadline,” the SS27 collection translates this theme into the garments through lightly distressed fabrics and slouchy styling. For more interesting proportions, wool shorts and skirts cut too short expose inner lining, while the sleeves of tops, including a cable-knit sweater, extend past the hands. Together, these design choices break from the formality of the workplace, placing a primacy on unkempt and lived-in detailing.In one men’s look, a red floral jacquard shirt is worn with the chest exposed and paired with a dark gray suit, while another utilizes a white checked shirt with a loosely styled floral necktie and front-pleated trousers. Other men’s looks get subtle feminine touches from lace stockings and tassel trims, while sun-faded jersey knits and raw-cut hems add a gritty sensibility to the collection.Accessories like glossy leather messenger bags and belts with chrome grommets bring an alternative character to the range, balancing out the more formal silhouettes. Finally, for footwear, mfpen introduces a New Balance Made in USA 992 that follows the neutral late 90s feel of the accompanying garments.See the gallery above for a full look at mfpen SS27 at Copenhagen Fashion Week. items.text: BEAMS Opens Doors to Inaugural Malibu Outpost Japanese menswear label BEAMS has expanded its U.S. presence by officially opening BEAMS MALIBU on the California coast.Located at 23710 Malibu Road, the seaside store operates on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM.BEAMS MALIBU has opened its doors officially opened its doors nestled right next to California’s southern coast. The opening is only the latest development in the ubiquitous Japanese menswear label’s expansion into the US, which has largely taken place in the Los Angeles metropolitan area.Starting today, shoppers can browse and buy BEAMS at a seaside Malibu Rd space that will be open only on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays from 11 AM to 6 PM. The Japanese label quietly announced the move earlier this year, saying, “BEAMS has secured a location in Malibu, California and is currently preparing for the upcoming project,” on BEAMS America’s official site. It comes after the brand’s first-ever BEAMS Plus Limited Store in central LA in 2024 and the later “All Things Japan” pop-up in Summer 2025. View this post on InstagramA post shared by BEAMS America (@beams_america) The brand’s long-awaited entrance into the US market was confirmed in 2025 with the official e-commerce launch of BEAMS America. Since then, the brand’s American arm has released a plethora of dedicated collabs with labels like Vans and Champion. BEAMS expands its presence at a time when Japanese fashion gains popularity stateside via retailers like UNIQLO and MUJI, as well as trends like Japanese selvedge denim and sashiko stitching. As the nation's cross-cultural influence continues to grow in the West, BEAMS’ recent moves suggest there may be more stores coming in the near future.BEAMS MALIBU23710 Malibu Road, Malibu, CA 90265Fri, Sat, Sun 11:00 am – 6:00 pm Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: This 1:1 ‘Fallout’ Pip-Boy Comes Off Your Wrist and Onto Your Desk
items.text: This 1:1 ‘Fallout’ Pip-Boy Comes Off Your Wrist and Onto Your Desk Summary The Wand Company has produced an officially licensed Pip-Boy replica tied to the Amazon Original Fallout seriesBuilt as a 1:1 wearable, it pairs die-cast metal and a hand-weathered finish with a functioning LCD screenA machined metal stand lets the piece double as an in-universe desk clock when it is not being worn The Wand Company has recreated the Fallout Pip-Boy as a fully functional, wearable 1:1 replica, officially licensed by Amazon Studios from its live-action series. Modeled on the show's prop geometry, the collectible reproduces the Pip-Boy 3000 Mk V as a piece that works as both cosplay hardware and a desktop display.Construction is where the replica makes its case. The front casing is die-cast metal finished with hand-applied weathering, so each unit carries its own worn-in character, while the body is built from engineered injection-moulded ABS. A memory foam cuff lines the interior for universal fitting and longer wear, striking a balance between authentic materials and something you can actually strap on. The piece is described as the most accurate reproduction of the wrist-worn "Personal Information Processor" yet made, an ambition that tracks with The Wand Company's reputation for high-fidelity prop replicas.The electronics carry the fantasy further. A TFT LCD screen runs more than 45 different in-universe screens and animations pulled directly from the series, navigated through a side control dial, and the same display doubles as a working timepiece with an in-universe alarm. A built-in FM radio lets owners tune real stations or switch over to Wasteland broadcasts at the press of a button. Power comes from a rechargeable Li-Po cell topped up over USB-C, which also allows the replica to run constantly on for an always-lit desk display.That desk life is anchored by the stand. The replica ships with a solid, machined metal stand that seats it cleanly and unlocks the table-clock function, turning a cosplay prop into an everyday object. The result speaks to how far the Pip-Boy has traveled, from an in-game HUD to a live-action prop to a piece of hardware sitting on a collector's shelf.The officially licensed Fallout Pip-Boy replica is available via Amazon. items.title: Apple Could Unveil the Camera-Equipped AirPods at September's iPhone 18 Pro Event
items.text: Apple Could Unveil the Camera-Equipped AirPods at September's iPhone 18 Pro Event Summary Tiny built-in cameras will serve as visual sensors for Siri to provide contextual information about objects and environmentsThe integration is expected to significantly enhance the VoiceOver and Magnifier accessibility tools for blind or low-vision individualsPrivacy measures will likely include a small onboard LED light that flashes whenever the image sensors are operating Apple might launch AirPods equipped with cameras during the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro unveiling next month. The rumored hardware aims to expand the wearable health and accessibility ecosystem of the tech giant. According to recent reports from Bloomberg, the device will integrate visual intelligence capabilities to let users query Siri about their immediate surroundings.The project recently surfaced in iOS 27 beta code under the internal codename B790. This discovery suggests development is much further along than a competing camera-equipped prototype slated for a 2027 release. Apple engineers designed these internal sensors exclusively for artificial intelligence processing rather than conventional photography or video recording. The earbuds will capture low-resolution data to assist with physical navigation and task-based visual inquiries.A key application for the new hardware lies in advancing accessibility software. Earlier this year, Apple previewed major artificial intelligence upgrades to VoiceOver and Magnifier. The Image Explorer feature currently allows individuals who are blind or have low vision to receive detailed descriptions of their environment through a smartphone camera viewfinder. Users can press a physical button to ask follow-up questions in natural language about specific objects in their vicinity. Shifting this capability directly to a wearable audio device creates a completely hands-free experience while eliminating the need to hold up a screen.To address privacy concerns associated with wearable cameras, the earbuds will reportedly feature a small LED light that flashes during operation. This hardware indicator prevents covert recording and signals to bystanders when the device is analyzing visual data. The approach aligns with broader industry standards for smart wearables while actively avoiding the negative reception associated with continuous background recording.The introduction of vision-focused hardware follows a clear trajectory for the audio product line. items.title: Netflix Reportedly Scraps David Fincher's 'Squid Game' Spinoff
items.text: Netflix Reportedly Scraps David Fincher's 'Squid Game' Spinoff Summary Netflix has reportedly abandoned David Fincher's long-developing English-language 'Squid Game' spinoff, working-titled 'Heckler'The project had 'Utopia' creator Dennis Kelly attached to write and was set to film in the United Kingdom despite its American framingExecutive changes, Fincher's move to other projects, and a pivot toward country-specific spinoffs are cited as reasons David Fincher's long-gestating American Squid Game spinoff, developed under the working title Heckler, is supposedly no longer moving forward at Netflix. Per reporting from The Playlist, the streamer has stepped away from the English-language expansion after years of development, closing the book on what had been one of the franchise's most anticipated offshoots.For all the anticipation around it, Heckler carried a few details that ran counter to expectations. Though framed as an American continuation of the deadly games, the series was actually set to film in the United Kingdom rather than the US. Writing duties had gone to Dennis Kelly, the creator of Utopia, who had a prior connection to Fincher through an HBO adaptation of Utopia that was ultimately abandoned before it could get off the ground.The collapse reads as a gradual loss of momentum rather than a single clean break. Sources close to Fincher point to a run of factors that drained the project's forward motion, including multiple executive changes at Netflix and the director shifting his focus to other work, among them The Adventures of Cliff Booth.Underpinning those setbacks is a change in how Netflix wants to grow the property. Rather than build the next chapter around a single American series, the streamer is now oriented toward developing country-specific Squid Game projects tailored to individual international markets. That strategic turn effectively reframes Heckler as a casualty of a broader plan for the universe, not just a stalled production.Much of the spinoff's early buzz traced back to one moment in the finale. Cate Blanchett surfaced in the closing scene as an American recruiter in a Los Angeles setting, and viewers read the cameo as a tease for Fincher's project. Series creator Hwang Dong-hyuk consistently rejected any link between the two. According to The Playlist, there is no indication Blanchett was ever attached to Heckler, even though she had previously voiced strong openness to returning to the franchise. items.title: Barbour x JOURNAL STANDARD's Cropped "Old Bedale" Is Built Around Broken-In Wool
items.text: Barbour x JOURNAL STANDARD's Cropped "Old Bedale" Is Built Around Broken-In Wool Summary Barbour and Journal Standard have reworked the classic Old Bedale into a wool special order built around a soft, pre-washed hand feelThe silhouette keeps its signature flap pockets while dropping to a cleaner cropped lengthTwo colorways, black and brown, round out the Japanese retailer's exclusive take Barbour and JOURNAL STANDARD have teamed on a special-order Old Bedale that swaps the model's usual outdoor toughness for a wool build with a lived-in, ready-to-wear feel. Rather than lean on rugged utility, the exclusive centers its story on fabric and fit.The centerpiece here is the material. JOURNAL STANDARD selected a wool fabric that carries the warmth you expect from the fiber but reads as though it has already been worn and washed for years. The result is a soft, relaxed texture that avoids looking too crisp or formal, giving the jacket an easygoing presence straight off the rack.Construction leans on the flap-pocket detailing that defines the Old Bedale shape. Those classic elements stay intact, but the body has been reworked to a trimmed, cropped length. That shorter cut is the practical hook: it pairs cleanly with slim trousers and balances just as well against wide-leg or heavier, high-volume bottoms, positioning a heritage silhouette for current styling.Barbour's pedigree backs the collaboration. The label was founded in 1894 by John Barbour in South Shields, England, and has since earned three Royal Warrants, a rare mark of British royal endorsement. Journal Standard channels that legacy into a piece designed less for the field and more for daily rotation.Color rounds out the offering. The special order comes in a versatile black that slots into most wardrobes and a brown option chosen to bring out the character of the wool itself.The Barbour x JOURNAL STANDARD Wool Cropped Old Bedale is available for pre-order now. items.title: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Sails Past $1 Billion USD at the Global Box Office
items.text: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Sails Past $1 Billion USD at the Global Box Office Summary Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' has crossed $1 billion USD at the worldwide box office in its third week of releaseThe milestone marks the director's first billion-dollar film since The Dark Knight Rises and only his second everThe run positions the Homer adaptation to soon overtake Nolan's all-time highest-grossing release Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey has sailed past $1 billion USD at the global box office, a milestone that reframes where the director's latest epic sits within one of the most closely watched filmographies in modern Hollywood. The take on Homer's poem, with Matt Damon as Odysseus, has now become the 65th film to reach the mark worldwide.The achievement lands as a career marker rather than just a strong opening. This is Nolan's first film since 2012's The Dark Knight Rises to clear $1 billion USD, making it only the second billion-dollar title of his career. That gap is telling. His 2023 awards juggernaut Oppenheimer came close but stalled at roughly $975 million USD, leaving the milestone just out of reach even at the height of the Barbenheimer phenomenon.The bigger prize is now within sight. The Odyssey is on track to become Nolan's highest-grossing release ever, overtaking the $1.085 billion USD earned by The Dark Knight Rises. For a director whose previous peaks were anchored by a globally established superhero, crossing that line with a nearly three-hour drama adapted from an ancient text underscores how far his commercial pull now extends beyond franchise material.The current split shows where the momentum is coming from. The Odyssey has drawn $429.7 million USD domestically and $570.3 million USD overseas for its billion-dollar total. The film also stands apart on content: it is only the third R-rated movie to cross $1 billion USD, following Joker and Deadpool & Wolverine, and the first R-rated title to do so without leaning on comic-book characters.Format has been central to the story. Nolan shot The Odyssey entirely with IMAX film cameras, a first for a feature, and demand for those premium showings has stayed unusually high.The milestone also feeds a broader banner year. Combined with Spider-Man: Brand New Day, the two films account for around $2.1 billion USD globally and are poised to pass the $2.4 billion USD that Barbie and Oppenheimer earned together during the 2023 Barbenheimer summer. items.title: LEGO Recreates the Ministry of Magic as a 3,491-Piece, Multi-Level ‘Harry Potter’ Collectors' Set
items.text: LEGO Recreates the Ministry of Magic as a 3,491-Piece, Multi-Level ‘Harry Potter’ Collectors' Set Summary LEGO marks 25 years of 'Harry Potter' with a 3,491-piece Ministry of Magic Collectors' Edition display modelThe multi-level build runs from a London street scene down through Ministry offices to the Hall of ProphecyFourteen minifigures include a first-ever Arabella Figg, alongside a brand-new Lynx Patronus element The LEGO Group has revealed the LEGO Harry Potter The Ministry of Magic Collectors' Edition, a 3,491-piece set built to mark 25 years since the release of Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone. The minifigure-scale model renders a cross-section of magical London as an involved build aimed at adult collectors.The set is structured as a vertical journey through the wizarding world's London headquarters. The build opens at street level, where a detailed scene includes a subway station and the franchise's recognizable red telephone box, establishing the entrance to the Ministry hidden below. From there, the model descends through the government complex itself, opening up interior spaces to explore.Those lower levels are where the interactive detailing concentrates. Builders can access Arthur Weasley and Dolores Umbridge's offices and the courtroom where Harry stands trial, with the press materials pointing to numerous Easter eggs worked into the layout. One level further down sits the Hall of Prophecy, which brings in functional play features including collapsing shelves to stage its signature scene.Character content is a core part of the appeal. The set ships with 14 minifigures, among them Hermione Granger, Ron Weasley and Lord Voldemort, plus the first-ever minifigure depiction of Arabella Figg. Rounding out the roster is a brand-new element in Kingsley Shacklebolt's Lynx Patronus, the magical guardian that carried messages between the Ministry and the Order of the Phoenix.As a finished piece, the model is scaled for display as much as for building. It stands over 20 inches tall, measures 13.5 inches wide and 6 inches deep, and carries an 18+ age designation, positioning it firmly within LEGO's collector-facing tier. The timing reinforces that intent: the release is set to coincide with Back to Hogwarts Day, folding the anniversary celebration into a date already meaningful to the fanbase.The LEGO Harry Potter The Ministry of Magic Collectors' Edition (76476) will be available through LEGO Insiders Early Access from August 29, then to all b

items.title: Yoshida & Co. Bookbinds Its 90-Year History Using the Same Thread That Sews Its Bags
items.text: Yoshida & Co. Bookbinds Its 90-Year History Using the Same Thread That Sews Its Bags Summary Yoshida Kaban marks its 90th anniversary with a visual book documenting the brand's craft and historyThe book is bound with the Japanese wa-toji method and stitched using the actual thread from its bag productionTwo editions arrive, one built from TANKER fabric and one wrapped in cloth-covered board Yoshida & Co., the maker behind PORTER, is releasing the YOSHIDA & Co. 90 Anniversary BOOK, a visual book commemorating its 90th year in business. Weighted toward the brand's work over the past decade, the volume treats its own construction as an extension of the craftsmanship it documents.The making of the book is the clearest statement of intent. It is bound using wa-toji, the traditional Japanese technique of stitching paper together with needle and thread, and the sewing yarn is the same thread Yoshida actually uses to assemble its bags. That choice carries the brand's obsession with handwork out of the workshop and into the object itself. Two bindings are offered: a Collector's Edition finished in TANKER fabric, and a Library Edition given a rugged cover of cloth-wrapped heavy board.The contents track where the brand has been recently. The book devotes pages to ALL NEW TANKER, the project that reworked PORTER's signature TANKER series into a version made from 100 percent plant-based nylon, and it walks through the full slate of items issued for the anniversary. It also captures the exhibition Every day is a new beginning, staged at Kudan House, giving the recent milestones a place on the page.From there it reaches back to the origin. The volume collects historical material tracing the brand's roots across nine decades, including rare episodes about founder Yoshida Kichizo, the tools he favored, and the handcart used in the earliest days of the operation. Yoshida Kaban was established in 1935, which places this anniversary in 2026. Together, the recent projects and the founding relics frame the book as a bridge between the label's present output and the workshop mindset it started with.The YOSHIDA & Co. 90 Anniversary BOOK releases August 15. items.title: Story mfg and PF Flyers Rebuild the All-American High-Top Around Handwoven, Naturally Dyed Cloth
items.text: Story mfg and PF Flyers Rebuild the All-American High-Top Around Handwoven, Naturally Dyed Cloth Name: All-American Story Mfg High-Top, Signature Wobbly Waffle, All-American Story Mfg High-Top, Signature Indigo HandloomColorway: Indigo/Brown, Indigo/EcruSKU: A26SMFGW, A26SMFGIMSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: August 10Where to Buy: PF Flyers, Story mfg.PF Flyers and Story mfg. have joined forces on a limited edition of the All-American High-Top, reworking the canvas silhouette around handwoven, naturally dyed fabric. The two makeups translate a shared, slow-made philosophy into footwear, releasing online August 10.The pairing rests on common ground. PF Flyers has turned out honest, hard-wearing shoes since 1937 and has left its formula largely untouched across the decades. Story mfg., meanwhile, has spent thirteen years producing naturally dyed, hand-crafted clothing in small runs alongside artisan makers in India and Thailand. Two very different origins, the release argues, add up to the same underlying belief in building things that last.That belief shows most clearly in the cloth. Both makeups are handwoven and naturally dyed by weavers in Thailand who work from their own homes. The Signature Wobbly Waffle version is woven by hand, and its brown is not a dye at all but homegrown cotton that grows that color in the field, then gets woven together with yarn dyed in real indigo. Because of that process, no two panels match, which is the entire point, and the shoe is built to wear in rather than out. The Signature Indigo Handloom follows the same thinking, using handwoven indigo cloth colored in fermented vats with locally grown plants, meant to soften and fade into the wearer over time.Cloth like this rarely reaches a shoe, the brands note, because it is too slow, too irregular and too awkward for standard production. Getting there took a willing mill, a willing factory and two labels stubborn enough to push it through. "We are proud to partner with Story mfg. as we continue the nearly 90-year heritage of PF Flyers developing considered canvas shoes," said PF Flyers CEO Kassia Davis in the release. "Story mfg. is a like-minded partner who isn't chasing hype but is achieving thoughtful design with their hand-woven, naturally-dyed fabric"The craft carries through to the unboxing. The limited edition ships in special packaging built around a custom Story mfg. brown box and tissue design, finished with a cream dust bag to keep the sneakers protected. Click here to v

items.title: AG1 Is Bringing a New Wellness Playbook to Football
items.text: AG1 Is Bringing a New Wellness Playbook to Football AG1 is marking its first move into football as the new front-of-shirt partner of Swansea City AFC. Set to bring its branding to the club’s kits as well as stadium ads and digital content, the milestone partnership, which kicks off in the 2026/27 season, points towards a wider shift in what football sponsorship can represent.For years, the front of a football shirt has been dominated by a familiar rotation of betting, alcohol, and fast-food companies, with their branding becoming embedded in the visual identity of the game. As Premier League clubs collectively remove gambling brands from matchday kits and conversation around Championship partnerships intensifies, wellness has begun appearing in the sport, reshaping how athletes approach nutrition, recovery, and long-term performance. AG1’s arrival at Swansea City AFC brings that movement into one of football’s biggest commercial spaces. Instead of focusing on what happens around the match, the brand will position itself alongside the daily work behind the scenes. Weighing in on the subject, Snoop Dogg, co-owner of Swansea City AFC, describes the partnership as something that can bring people together through “football, wellness, and that shared commitment to performing at your best.”Continuing to extend that ambition beyond the pitch, AG1 will be making its products available across Swansea City AFC’s teams. As well as supplying products, it is set to offer nutritional advice to players to support the club’s existing work in sports science, performance data, and player recovery. The partnership will begin, though, this weekend at Swansea City AFC’s stadium, where the team will step out in its latest kit. Emblazoned with AG1’s logo, the sleek white shirt with pinstriped detail reflects the clean, health-focused ethos that the brand hopes to bring to the Championship. Take a closer look at the kit via the gallery above. To find out more about the partnership, head to Swansea City AFC’s website now. Read more at Hypebeast

items.text: Paul Smith and Artek Reunite for a Colorful “Edition Three” Stool 60 Summary Artek and Paul Smith released the Edition Three Stool 60, reimagining Alvar Aalto’s 1933 classic with bold color contrasts.The stool features stained birch legs, hidden Malachite Green underside and stackable versatility.The limited-edition piece doubles as seating or a side table. Artek and Paul Smith have introduced Edition Three of the iconic Stool 60, continuing their collaboration that began in 2024. Building upon a shared appreciation for timeless, functional design, this collaborative iteration once again reimagines Alvar Aalto’s legendary 1933 Stool 60. Edition Three juxtaposes Artek’s strict, Nordic modernist sensibilities with Paul Smith’s signature colorful, "classic with a twist" philosophy, resulting in a piece that functions both as practical everyday furniture and a vibrant, collectible design object.The stool retains Aalto’s classic three-legged birch construction but introduces striking stained finishes inspired by Smith’s Signature Stripe. The legs are presented in Lemon Yellow, Burgundy and Melrose Pink, while the seat maintains a natural wood top with a hidden Malachite Green underside, revealed only when flipped. This concealed detail adds a sense of discovery and wit, aligning with Smith’s design ethos. The stool remains versatile, functioning as seating, a side table, or a decorative surface, while its stackability - up to ten stools - creates a striped visual rhythm when grouped.Priced at €390 EUR (approx. $451 USD), the Stool 60 Edition Three is part of a limited series that also includes restocks of Editions One and Two, encouraging collectors to build a complete set. items.title: Ultra-Rare and Low-Mileage 1985 Ferrari 288 GTO Expected to Fetch Up to $11 Million USD at RM Sotheby’s
items.text: Ultra-Rare and Low-Mileage 1985 Ferrari 288 GTO Expected to Fetch Up to $11 Million USD at RM Sotheby’s Summary RM Sotheby’s is auctioning an ultra-rare 1985 Ferrari 288 GTO during its annual Monterey saleThe vehicle is the 99th of 272 total examples produced and features under 1,000 miles on the odometerThe Ferrari Classiche certified hypercar is estimated to sell for between $9 million and $11 million USD Ferrari’s legendary 1985 Ferrari 288 GTO is heading to the auction block via RM Sotheby’s for its annual Monterey sale. The pristine example represents the marque’s inaugural halo supercar and is expected to command a gavel price between $9 million and $11 million USD.Designed by Pininfarina’s Leonardo Fioravanti, the 288 GTO stands as the 99th of 272 units built between 1984 and 1987. The vehicle features a Kevlar hood and molded fiberglass body panels finished exclusively in Ferrari’s classic Rosso Corsa hue. Inside, the two-seat interior is wrapped floor-to-ceiling in Nero leather and equipped with optional factory features including air conditioning and power windows.Under the rear deck sits a matching-numbers 2.9-liter V-8 engine equipped with IHI twin-turbochargers, delivering 389 horsepower and 366 lb-ft of torque to the rear wheels via a five-speed manual transmission. Redlining at 7,700 rpm, the supercar was designed to sprint from 0 to 60 mph in five seconds toward a top speed of 179 mph. Showing just 958 miles on the odometer, the Ferrari Classiche-certified model remains one of six or fewer sub-1,000-mile 288 GTOs believed to exist globally.The 1985 Ferrari 288 GTO will cross the block at the RM Sotheby’s Monterey sale running from August 13 to August 15, 2026. items.title: TAG Heuer Honors Zandvoort’s Final Grand Prix With Two Limited-Edition Formula 1 Solargraphs
items.text: TAG Heuer Honors Zandvoort’s Final Grand Prix With Two Limited-Edition Formula 1 Solargraphs Summary TAG Heuer releases two 38mm Formula 1 Solargraphs honoring Zandvoort’s Dutch Grand Prix.Models feature orange TH-Polylight bezels, grey opalin dials and sandblasted steel cases.Limited to 1,500 units on the rubber strap and 1,000 units on the steel bracelet models. TAG Heuer has unveiled two new limited-edition Formula 1 Solargraph watches, created to commemorate the final Dutch Grand Prix at the iconic Circuit Zandvoort. Situated along the North Sea, Zandvoort is renowned for its intense coastal racing environment and vibrant fan culture, famously characterized by a sweeping "sea of orange" across the grandstands. Connecting back to the original TAG Heuer Formula 1 collection introduced in 1986, these new models revive a compact 38mm case size that directly links to the line's foundational era while bringing modern solar technology to the track.The first variant is paired with a matching orange rubber strap and is limited to 1,500 pieces. Meanwhile, the second edition, an e-commerce exclusive model, comes fitted on a 3-row sandblasted steel bracelet and is limited to 1,000 pieces. Both models feature a grey opalin dial accented with an orange and red minuterie as a nod to the vibrant fan culture of Zandvoort. The sandblasted steel case delivers a matte, motorsport‑ready aesthetic, while the bidirectional bezel crafted from TH‑Polylight adds durability and tactile character.Applied indices are filled with eggshell-colored Super‑LumiNova to ensure legibility in all conditions, complemented by red lacquered hands and a cleanly integrated date window at three o’clock. The design remains faithful to the original Formula 1 codes, with signature shields at six, nine, and twelve o’clock anchoring the dial’s rhythm.At the core of both models is the solar-powered Caliber TH50-00, which harnesses both natural and artificial light as a virtually limitless energy source. A single minute of exposure to direct sunlight supplies a full day of power, while a complete charge - reached in under 40 hours of light exposure - delivers up to 10 months of continuous operation in total darkness.The TAG Heuer Formula 1 Solargraph watches are available via the brand, with prices set at $2,150 USD for the rubber strap model and $2,250 USD for the e-commerce-exclusive, steel bracelet edition. items.title: RANSHOU Reopens Tokyo’s Closed National Theatre for ‘FUTURE HISTORY’ Exhibition
items.text: RANSHOU Reopens Tokyo’s Closed National Theatre for ‘FUTURE HISTORY’ Exhibition Summary RANSHOU presents 'FUTURE HISTORY: Lineage and Form of Onnagata' at Tokyo's National Theatre, September 12–13, 2026.The exhibition specially opens the closed Grand Theatre Stage for visitors to walk across.Features 100+ historical works, costumes and contemporary collaborations by Ranshou Fujima. Independent art organization RANSHOU will present a landmark exhibition titled FUTURE HISTORY: Lineage and Form of Onnagata this fall. Set to be hosted at Tokyo's National Theatre, the showcase will take over the Grand Theatre stage for a truly special two-day event celebrating one of the country's most renowned and respected art forms: Kabuki.Completed in 1966 as a postwar architectural icon modeled after traditional azekura-zukuri storehouse architecture, the theatre has been officially closed for a major reconstruction project, rendering its dark stage an evocative backdrop for a project exploring memory, history and physical form. For this brief presentation, the venue will be specially opened to allow audiences to physically walk across the very stage where generations of legendary master actors once performed.Curated by dancer, choreographer and RANSHOU director Ranshou Fujima, Kyōkanoko Musume Dōjōji (The Maiden at Dojoji Temple) serves as the central performance of the exhibition. This title is not only the oldest surviving Noh-based Kabuki dance drama, but it's also a highly-regarded repertoire that demonstrates the pinnacle of the onnagata (male actors performing female roles).Fujima, who trained extensively in classical Kabuki techniques as a woman outside of a traditional hereditary kabuki lineage, has long viewed the classics as living presences rather than distant relics. Her multidisciplinary practice - spanning dance, choreography, film and archival research - anchors the exhibition in both embodied tradition and contemporary inquiry. She seeks to untangle the historical erasure of women in traditional performance narratives, thus recontextualizing three centuries of onnagata practice through a contemporary feminine lens.Spanning five thematic sections, the presentation brings together more than 100 historical works and archival documents from the RANSHOU Archives & Collection alongside contemporary creative collaborations. items.title: weber Turns Vermeer's ‘Girl With a Pearl Earring’ Into a Washed Vintage-Style T-shirt
items.text: weber Turns Vermeer's ‘Girl With a Pearl Earring’ Into a Washed Vintage-Style T-shirt Summary weber renders Johannes Vermeer's Girl with a Pearl Earring onto a T-shirt through an 11-screen silkscreen processThe layered printing captures the girl's skin, her turban and the depth of the pearl against a dark groundA washed and tumble-dried 1990s-style body is built to gain character the more it is worn weber translates Johannes Vermeer's Girl with a Pearl Earring onto a T-shirt, a graphic piece that leans on printing technique to do the painting justice. Rather than a flat reproduction, the design is constructed from 11 separate silkscreen layers stacked to recreate the artwork's tonal range.That layering is where the detail lives. By building the print up screen by screen, weber pulls out the girl's skin as it emerges from the surrounding darkness, the saturated blue and gold of her turban, and the light-catching depth of the pearl itself. It is a printing-led approach that treats the tonal shifts of the original as the whole point rather than an afterthought.The garment underneath is pitched to match. weber uses a 1990s-style body finished with a wash treatment and tumble drying, a combination that softens the shirt and gives it a lived-in surface from the start, with the intent that it deepens in character the longer it is worn. The brand frames the result as wearable art, joining the painting's enduring appeal with vintage T-shirt culture.The choice of subject carries its own weight. Girl with a Pearl Earring is among the most recognizable paintings in Western art, a roughly 1665 Dutch Golden Age work often called the "Mona Lisa of the North, "which gives the tee an instantly readable image even at a glance.The Girl with a Pearl Earring by weber T-shirt releases August 11 via weber's online store.
