items.title: Porsche Builds a One-Off 911 Turbo S "Land Down Under" to Celebrate 75 Years in Australia
items.text: Porsche Builds a One-Off 911 Turbo S "Land Down Under" to Celebrate 75 Years in Australia Summary Porsche Cars Australia and the Sonderwunsch department have created a one-off 911 Turbo S titled "Land Down Under" to commemorate the brand's 75th anniversary in AustraliaThe vehicle features a bespoke two-tone Chromaflair exterior that transitions from Terra Australis Red to Southern Cross Blue in a process that required more than 300 hours of hand-applied craftsmanshipUnique details include a "See ya later mate" message hidden under the active rear spoiler and an interior headliner embroidered with the southern night sky as it appeared over Uluru in 1951 Porsche has officially rolled out the automotive equivalent of a love letter to the Australian outback. Commemorating 75 years of the brand's presence in the country, the regional division teamed up with the in-house Sonderwunsch customization department to create the one-off 911 Turbo S "Land Down Under." The celebratory vehicle represents a deep appreciation for the expansive landscapes and dramatic contrasts that define the Southern Hemisphere. Unveiled during a high-profile Sydney debut, the exclusive release merges top-tier German engineering with a heavy dose of cultural iconography.The undeniable centerpiece of the commemorative sports car is its painstaking exterior finish. Inspired by a deep outback sunset, the bespoke two-tone Chromaflair paint scheme transitions seamlessly from a dusty Terra Australis Red at the lower half into a sprawling Southern Cross Blue across the shoulderline. Formulated specifically for this project, the highly exclusive pigment incorporates reflective aluminum flakes encased in a transparent layer. This allows the exterior to shift colors between desert orange, dusk-sky blue, eucalyptus green and sunrise gold depending on the viewing angle. The breathtaking gradient required more than 300 hours of manual craftsmanship to complete. The automaker even color-matched the 20- and 21-inch Turbo Exclusive wheels in the custom blue hue.Adding localized flair, the brand tapped contemporary artist Werner Bronkhorst to integrate subtle storytelling elements across the bodywork. A ghosted "75" graphic marks the roof while miniature motifs and native fauna are dotted discreetly around the exterior. The most cheeky addition hides beneath the active rear spoiler, which deploys to reveal the message "See ya later mate" as a fitting farewell for anyone trying to keep pace with the vehicle

items.title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Swings to the Second-Fastest $1 Billion USD Overseas Run in History
items.text: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Swings to the Second-Fastest $1 Billion USD Overseas Run in History Summary Spider-Man: Brand New Day has crossed $1 billion USD internationally faster than any film except Avengers: EndgameThe movie has reached $1.67 billion USD worldwide in just 12 days of releaseIt now ranks as the biggest movie of the year and the 12th-highest-grossing release of all time Spider-Man: Brand New Day has become the second-fastest film ever to reach $1 billion USD at the international box office, a milestone only Avengers: Endgame hit at a quicker clip back in 2019. Twelve days into its run, Tom Holland's latest turn as the web-slinger has piled up $1.67 billion USD worldwide, split between $1.01 billion overseas and $655 million at home.The pace says as much about Spider-Man's staying power as it does about this particular film. Peter Parker has been one of the most bankable figures in Hollywood for more than two decades, anchoring multiple live-action franchises across different studios and eras, and Brand New Day is proof the appetite hasn't cooled. Part of that comes down to timing. This is Holland's fourth solo adventure as the character but his first big-screen Spider-Man appearance since 2021's No Way Home, and the near five-year gap clearly stoked demand.The second weekend numbers underline how rare this run is. The film added $236 million USD overseas and $145 million USD domestically in frame two, hauls that would be strong opening weekends for most releases, let alone second-weekend totals. China leads all international markets with $186.7 million USD to date, followed by the United Kingdom at $87.4 million USD and Mexico at $65.8 million USD.Now the conversation turns to how high it can go. With comic book fans stacking repeat viewings and little competition on the calendar ahead, Brand New Day is closing in on $2 billion USD worldwide, a tier only seven films have ever reached, among them Avatar, Avengers: Endgame and Titanic. Having already claimed the year's box office crown and a top-12 spot on the all-time chart, Holland's Spider-Man looks set to keep climbing well into the fall. items.title: The Dallas Mavericks Are Offering 32 Years of Season Tickets for This 1-of-1 Cooper Flagg Card
items.text: The Dallas Mavericks Are Offering 32 Years of Season Tickets for This 1-of-1 Cooper Flagg Card Summary The Dallas Mavericks have publicly offered a trade package to whoever pulls Cooper Flagg's one-of-one debut patch autograph cardThe bounty is built like a real NBA trade, bundling season tickets, memorabilia and VIP experiences into a single offerThe 1-of-1 Topps card carries a game-worn patch from Flagg's first NBA game and could sell for millions The Dallas Mavericks want Cooper Flagg's one-of-one debut patch autograph card badly enough to structure the pitch like a front-office trade. On Thursday, as the card officially hit packs, the franchise announced a proposed deal aimed at whoever is lucky enough to pull the Topps 1-of-1, stacking the offer with perks a normal marketplace can't match.The centerpiece is time. The finder would land two premium lower-level season tickets for the next 32 years, a nod to Flagg's jersey number, alongside a signed, game-worn rookie jersey and a postgame photo with the forward. From there the package tips into full experience territory: a road trip to watch the Mavericks take on the Boston Celtics with airfare, hotel and game tickets covered, a private photo shoot with both the Rookie of the Year trophy Flagg won last season and the Larry O'Brien Trophy, and a VIP tour of the team's practice facility with a meet-and-greet. A "private basketball experience" for up to 10 guests at American Airlines Center closes out the seven-item haul.Dallas is playing it partly for laughs, with the fine print noting the offer is subject to a definitive written agreement and that "this is a proposed trade." The catch is that the card itself is the kind of asset that makes a fan think twice before accepting perks over a payday.Flagg signed the piece at the third annual Fanatics Fest last month, and he admitted the moment got to him. "I want to do my best," he said, before advising whoever ends up with it to hold on because "it will gain value as I go through my career." That advice tracks with the projections. Geoff Wilson, founder of Sports Cards Investor, told ESPN that he expects the card could clear the $1.11 million USD that Paul Skenes' 1-of-1 rookie debut patch card fetched at auction last year, potentially reaching $1.5 million USD.There's precedent for exactly this standoff. items.title: The Malcolm Todd Style Guide
items.text: The Malcolm Todd Style Guide The mindset behind Malcolm Todd's wardrobe can be summed up in one simple sentiment: if everything in his closet is cute, every outfit will ultimately be okay. "I could dress myself with my eyes closed if everything's cute," Todd, the starring musician in Gap's new GapDenim campaign, tells Hypebeast.That guiding ethos has informed a myriad of distinct Malcolm Todd™ looks: a "Roommates" music video outfit in which colorful barrettes contrast with a grey wife beater, a shirtless The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon debut in just boxer shorts, dark denim jeans, and flip-flops, and an Instagram feed (and burner account) full of fit checks."I'll wear dress pants and sandals. I'll go to the bar in sandals," says Todd when asked for a fashion hot take. "I just like to let my toes breathe. Dogs out. There's nothing wrong with that." He's also a firm believer in the power of "a little funny accessory" in shaping an outfit. "A necklace or some funny glasses goes a really long way," he adds. "Being a little bit random is refreshing." Todd's willingness to experiment melds with his affinity for classic silhouettes — loose button-down shirts, thick-framed eyewear, and, of course, really good denim — to shape his unique personal style.Having found comfort in his own effortless, Americana-esque-but-with-a-slight-edge personal style aesthetic, it makes perfect sense that Todd, alongside Obsession's Inde Navarrette, finds himself fronting Gap's "Denim on your own" music video.The musician was tasked with reworking Robyn's classic dancefloor cut, "Dancing On My Own," which Todd found to be a healthy exercise in creativity. "To me, making music is all about being fearless," explains Todd, that exact fearlessness allowing him to step into the role of a model and dancer with utmost swagger. "This felt a little less natural at first, but everyone on set helped me feel comfortable in trying things that I'd never done before."Ahead of his largest headlining tour yet, the musician sat down with Hypebeast to chat all things personal style and "Denim on your own."How would you describe your personal style, and how does it tie into your music and creative output?Malcolm Todd: The biggest correlation between my style and my music is authenticity. I feel enabled to wear whatever I feel, and I feel enabled to write whatever I feel. items.title: ILKW Upgrades Its Beloved SNOWMAN Lamp With 260 Hours of Battery Life
items.text: ILKW Upgrades Its Beloved SNOWMAN Lamp With 260 Hours of Battery Life Summary ILKW introduces the SNOWMAN12 Portable Lamp with a playful, architectural aesthetic.It features a bolder, contrasting two-tone body and expanded 12cm shade.At around $71 USD, the fixture delivers up to 260 hours of wireless illumination. South Korean lighting studio ILKW (ILKWANG Lighting) has expanded its iconic lighting lineup with the SNOWMAN12 Portable Lamp. Building upon the beloved, whimsical silhouette of its predecessors, this newly available lighting fixture seamlessly merges playful geometry with functionality.Aesthetically, the lamp distinguishes itself from previous iterations through a bolder, more pronounced form factor. The most notable design shift is its expanded shade, which now boasts a 12cm diameter. To support this wider canopy, the design team introduced a substantial, two-tone body that utilizes contrasting materials and colors to give the product a highly distinctive presence.Explaining this deliberate evolution, Creative Director Sunman Kwon noted that the expanded shade necessitated a heavier body, leading to the integration of a "balloon-like base plate to bring balance to the overall form." This careful attention to proportion ensures that the lamp retains the charm of the original SNOWMAN series while feeling significantly more grounded and architectural.Beyond its visual updates, the SNOWMAN12 is engineered for untethered versatility, boasting a battery life of up to 260 hours on a single charge. According to the brand's Senior Manager of Development Minhyuk Cho, the new model features vastly improved battery performance and light output compared to the brand's existing portable products, resulting in a fixture that "lasts longer, shines brighter, and enables freer use."Retailing at 100,000 KRW (approx. $71 USD), the SNOWMAN12 is currently available for purchase through ILKW's official webstore and select global stockists. The garments are designed for real-world wear, combining understated sophistication with practical functionality, making them versatile staples for everyday wardrobes.The FW26 collection is currently available via the Margaret Howell webstore as well as its offline boutiques. items.title: The Hirshhorn Sculpture Garden Prepares to Reopen Following a $68M USD Redesign
items.text: The Hirshhorn Sculpture Garden Prepares to Reopen Following a $68M USD Redesign The Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden in Washington, D.C., will officially reopen its revitalized 1.3-acre outdoor sculpture garden on October 31, 2026, following a major four-year, $68 million USD transformation.Spearheaded by renowned Japanese artist and architect Hiroshi Sugimoto, who previously redesigned the museum’s lobby, the project marks the most comprehensive overhaul of the campus since its 1974 debut. Sugimoto’s design thoughtfully honors the original modernist vision of architect Gordon Bunshaft while addressing critical infrastructural needs, expanding public accessibility, and creating a seamless physical connection between the museum building, its central plaza, and the garden via a reopened underground tunnel that had been closed for half a century.When the gates open, the redesigned landscape will feature 60 sculptures, nearly double its previous capacity, alongside rotating exhibitions. The curatorial arrangement will bridge classic modernism with contemporary practice, spanning iconic works from founding donor Joseph Hirshhorn's collection by masters like Auguste Rodin, Alberto Giacometti, Barbara Hepworth and Henry Moore, which will be showcased alongside dynamic new acquisitions by artists such as KAWS, Izumi Kato, Lauren Halsey and Raven Halfmoon. Additionally, the space introduces a flexible, enlarged central reflecting pool that can be drained to function as a performance amphitheater, as well as dedicated exhibition zones - beginning with Yoshitomo Nara: Sentinels of Stillness - reinforcing the Hirshhorn’s commitment to dynamic, accessible public art on the National Mall.Hirshhorn MuseumIndependence Ave SW &, 7th St SW,Washington, DC 20560, United States Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Danny Boyle’s Rupert Murdoch Feature 'Ink' Sets Winter Theatrical Debut Ahead of Netflix Release
items.text: Danny Boyle’s Rupert Murdoch Feature 'Ink' Sets Winter Theatrical Debut Ahead of Netflix Release Summary Danny Boyle's upcoming feature 'Ink' will debut in select theaters on December 11 before streaming on Netflix on January 8 2027Adapted from James Graham's Tony-winning play the story follows Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb as they launch British tabloid 'The Sun'Jack O'Connell Guy Pearce and Claire Foy lead the ensemble cast slated to open the 83rd Venice International Film Festival Netflix has officially confirmed the release schedule for Ink, Danny Boyle’s forthcoming Rupert Murdoch-focused feature. First reported by Ryan Gajewski and John DiLillo, the film is scheduled to open in select theaters on December 11, 2026, before launching on Netflix across the United States and Latin America on January 8, 2027.Adapted by playwright James Graham from his own Tony-winning stage production, the drama explores the high-stakes evolution of modern tabloid journalism. The storyline focuses on media mogul Rupert Murdoch (Guy Pearce) hiring editor Larry Lamb (Jack O’Connell) to reshape British newspaper The Sun into a populist media powerhouse. Claire Foy joins the lead cast as Jules Davies.Produced by StudioCanal, Media Res, and House Productions alongside Boyle, Tracey Seaward, Tessa Ross, and Michael Ellenberg, the project chronicles the disruption of traditional media long before the digital era. Prior to its theatrical and streaming debuts, Ink will host its world premiere in competition as the opening film of the 83rd Venice International Film Festival on September 2, followed by a screening at the Toronto International Film Festival.Ink arrives in select theaters on December 11, 2026, before streaming globally on Netflix starting January 8, 2027. items.title: Teruhiro Yanagihara’s First Lighting Range for &Tradition Balances Light and Shadow With Elemental Simplicity
items.text: Teruhiro Yanagihara’s First Lighting Range for &Tradition Balances Light and Shadow With Elemental Simplicity Summary &Tradition debuts Numbra, its first lighting collection by Teruhiro Yanagihara.The TY1 Pendant features a 122cm linear silhouette of oak and aluminium.The TY3 Portable Lamp offers a compact, rechargeable format with a 10-hour battery. Danish design brand &Tradition has introduced Numbra, its first lighting collection by Japanese designer Teruhiro Yanagihara. Featuring the TY1 Pendant and TY3 Portable Lamp, both designs emphasize elemental simplicity, combining lacquered oak with tumbled aluminium for a minimal yet expressive aesthetic.The Numbra TY1 Pendant is rooted in the idea of the straight line, presenting a long, linear silhouette that balances clarity with warmth. Within an interior setting, the TY1 acts as an elegant, floating centerpiece, ideal for anchoring dining spaces or living rooms with its tranquil, minimalist silhouette. Crafted from solid lacquered oak panels and tumbled aluminium fixtures, the pendant integrates an acrylic diffuser and stainless steel core to create a soft, dimmable glow. Measuring 122cm in length, it is designed for communal spaces, offering a 15W LED light source with 700 lumens and a warm 2400K temperature. Beyond its visual appeal, the pendant is made with sustainability in mind, with FSC-certified wood, water-based lacquer and designed for disassembly to ensure repairability and recycling.Complementing the pendant, the Numbra TY3 Portable Lamp translates this same design language into a compact, battery-powered format. Built for adaptability, the TY3 brings quiet elegance and gentle illumination to various settings, transitioning effortlessly from a bookshelf or bedside table to an evening terrace. Standing at 25.5 cm tall, it features a three-step dimmer, a rechargeable battery with up to 10 hours of use and a magnetic USB charging system. Like the pendant, it is crafted from oak, aluminium and sandblasted acrylic, reinforcing Yanagihara’s focus on material honesty and tactile simplicity.Visit the &Tradition website for more information regarding the Numbra series' price range and availability. items.title: NovelKeys Dresses Its CLASSIC-TKL in "Underscore" Trim for a Timeless Retro Desk Setup
items.text: NovelKeys Dresses Its CLASSIC-TKL in "Underscore" Trim for a Timeless Retro Desk Setup Summary NovelKeys has introduced the CLASSIC-TKL Underscore Edition, a fully assembled take on its popular CLASSIC-TKL boardThe release leans into a timeless, retro-leaning aesthetic anchored by warm beige keycaps and muted colorwaysBuyers can choose from three earth-toned finishes named Clay, Boulder and Lichen, each ready to type on straight out of the box NovelKeys has given its CLASSIC-TKL keyboard a refined makeover with the new Underscore Edition, a fully assembled build that trades the tinkering for a clean, retro-minded look. Rather than reinvent the board, the release keeps the same chassis longtime fans already know and wraps it in timeless colorways designed to sit comfortably on any desk.The retro appeal starts with the keycaps. The Underscore Edition is built around a set of warm, classic beige GMK CYL keycaps, the kind of understated cream tone that recalls the vintage computing palettes of decades past. It's a deliberately nostalgic choice, and one that sets the mood for the rest of the board's restrained styling.That aesthetic carries across three colorways, each tuned to a slightly different vibe. Clay keeps things neutral and unobtrusive, letting the beige keycaps read as uniform and elegant. Boulder pushes into what NovelKeys calls the darker side of beige, an earthier, warmer tone that stays understated while adding a little depth. Lichen is the most playful of the trio, dusty overall but with just enough of a pop to stand out from the other two.Beyond the finish, this is very much a ready-to-go package. The Underscore builds on the CLASSIC-TKL chassis and arrives assembled with a full complement of NovelKeys' better components, including pre-tuned TypePlus stabilizers, NovelKeys x TypePlus Classic Blue switches, a color-matched premium cable, a gold badge and lightbar, and a custom Underscore silicone base. A hot-swap circuit board keeps the door open for switch swaps down the line, but the whole point is that it works the moment the box is opened.The result is a keyboard that puts look and convenience first, delivering that timeless, pared-back retro character without asking the buyer to source parts or assemble anything themselves.The NovelKeys CLASSIC-TKL Underscore Edition is available now online. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: A LEGO Fan Built a 1,400-Piece Replica of a Classic 1980s Bedside Radio With Hidden Internal Circuitry
items.text: A LEGO Fan Built a 1,400-Piece Replica of a Classic 1980s Bedside Radio With Hidden Internal Circuitry Summary A fan designer has unveiled the Legosonic BSR-12, a 1,400-piece LEGO submission meticulously modeled after vintage bedside radio alarm clocks from the late 1970s and early 1980sThe build prioritizes tactile realism with spring-loaded toggle switches that click, gear-driven sliders, a sliding tuning needle and an overbuilt internal circuit board featuring brick-built resistors and capacitorsCurrently designated as a Staff Pick on the LEGO Ideas platform, the nostalgic model must reach a milestone of 10,000 community votes to be considered for official production as a LEGO set A fan-designed LEGO Ideas project is capturing the nostalgia of analog electronics with a highly detailed replica of a classic bedside radio. Developed by creator 91-Brickdesigns, the Legosonic BSR-12 features roughly 1,400 pieces and meticulously mimics the tactile nature of early 1980s hardware. Before modern smartphones consolidated everyday bedside functions, nightstands were dominated by chunky boxes with clicking dials, heavy buttons and softly glowing displays. The Legosonic BSR-12 channels that exact vintage energy to build a 1:1 scale tribute to an era when gadgets felt weighty and distinct.While the Legosonic BSR-12 does not play actual music, the design includes several functional mechanisms to satisfy the urge to fidget. The creator engineered spring-loaded toggle switches that produce an authentic clicking sound alongside gear-driven sliders that offer smooth physical resistance. The front panel boasts a functional time-setting dial system utilizing chrome buttons, a flip-clock style display permanently frozen at 20:58 and a small wheel that moves a red tuning needle across fake FM and AM bands.The dedication to realism extends far beyond the exterior shell. Popping the top cover reveals a fully built internal circuit board hidden beneath. These internal guts feature color-coded brick-built resistors, capacitors and a centralized chip positioned exactly where one would sit on a real printed circuit board. A sliding ventilation grille on the side exposes a concealed speaker cone. Turning the device around reveals a proper spec plate reading "Made in Two Tiles, Legany" alongside an AC input and a retro power switch that grounds the entire piece in 1983 aesthetics.This project capitalizes on a growing consumer appetite for retro electronics that emphasize physical in

items.text: Timberland Revives an Archival '90s Hue for the “Concrete” Collection Name: Timberland Concrete CollectionMSRP: $140 - $220 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: TimberlandTimberland's Concrete Collection revives the brand’s archival “Concrete” colorway. This timeless, nuanced finish is designed to live at the intersection of work, nature and city life, capturing the uncompromising rhythm of the streets while maintaining the rugged aesthetic Timberland is known for. Spanning several iconic silhouettes, the collection adapts this industrial-yet-natural hue across both men’s and women’s footwear, delivering a cohesive, street-ready look.Leading the men's offerings is the Heritage 6-Inch Waterproof Boot, which proudly revives the classic '90s "Concrete" tone across its premium upper. This iconic workwear staple retains its signature robust construction and weather-ready capabilities, completely immersed in the smooth, neutral grey finish. Alongside the classic boot, the Men’s Euro Hiker bridges the gap between scenic outdoor routes and slick city streets. The hybrid hiker is engineered with utilitarian functionality in mind, utilizing an EVA footbed and midsole for responsive cushioning, a steel shank for rigid arch support, and a heavy-duty rubber outsole designed to deliver uncompromising traction across diverse urban and natural environments.For women, the collection elevates traditional designs through the bold, fashion-forward Stone Street lineup. items.title: Aston Martin Unveils Three Bespoke DB12 S Models at Pebble Beach to Honor Its 1950 Le Mans Racing Heritage
items.text: Aston Martin Unveils Three Bespoke DB12 S Models at Pebble Beach to Honor Its 1950 Le Mans Racing Heritage Summary Celebrates the 75th anniversary of the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance with three one-off models inspired by 1950s Le Mans DB2 racersFeatures a distinct color-coded identity for each car set against Carbon Black paintwork to denote historical racing team registrationsIncludes the public debut of the limited-production Vanquish 25 celebrating a quarter-century of the flagship V12 grand tourer Aston Martin has unveiled a trio of bespoke DB12 S models created by its Q by Aston Martin customization division to honor the 75th anniversary of the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. Collectively known as the VMF collection, the one-offs pay tribute to the original 1950 and 1951 Le Mans DB2 racing team. Those historic factory and private entries were famously identified on the track by their distinct grille colors and British registration plates beginning with VMF.By focusing on these obscure mid-century registry numbers rather than broad heritage pastiches, the brand delivers a deeply rooted homage aimed squarely at dedicated motorsport enthusiasts. Each modern interpretation wears a Carbon Black exterior to emphasize its specific accent color. VMF 63 features Rosso Red details, VMF 64 uses Speed Yellow and VMF 65 sports Ellwood Blue highlights across its grille vanes and carbon fiber side strakes. Design modifications also include a silhouette of the historic DB2 on the Aeroblade rear spoiler and commemorative 75 graphics on the fenders.The color coordination extends directly into the cabin. The customization team added contrast stitching that matches each respective exterior theme. DB2 silhouettes are embroidered into the front seatbacks while rear passengers see exclusive 75 roundels. The driver environment receives a color-matched start-stop rotary controller and painted paddle-shifter tips to finalize the curated aesthetic.Underneath the bespoke bodywork, the grand tourer retains its aggressive performance upgrades. The coupe is powered by an AMG-sourced twin-turbo 4.0-liter V8 producing 690 horsepower. The powertrain pushes the vehicle from zero to 60 mph in just 3.4 seconds and allows a top speed of 202 mph. The mechanical package includes a revised eight-speed gearbox, carbon-ceramic brakes, recalibrated adaptive dampers and a stiffened chassis.These special editions debuted in Monterey alongside the public premiere of the Vanquish 25. items.title: BAPE and mastermind JAPAN Rework Vintage Grunge for Their 19th Collaboration
items.text: BAPE and mastermind JAPAN Rework Vintage Grunge for Their 19th Collaboration Summary BAPE and mastermind JAPAN have returned for their 19th collaboration, titled mastermind A BATHING APE 19TH, built on a Vintage and Grunge conceptThe lineup spans a denim jacket and pants, an argyle knit cardigan, a crewneck sweat, a tee and an original BAPEX watchBoth houses' signature icons run throughout, with BAPE's STA and mastermind's SKULL worked into patchwork, knitwear and graphics BAPE and mastermind JAPAN have joined forces once again for “mastermind A BATHING APE 19TH,” the 19th chapter in a long-running partnership between the two Japanese labels. This time the collection takes "Vintage x Grunge" as its guiding idea, filtering the appeal of timeless vintage clothing through a contemporary streetwear lens.The collaboration's throughline is the marriage of each brand's defining iconography. Across the range, BAPE's STA emblem and mastermind's SKULL sit side by side, giving the collection a dual signature that reads instantly as the work of both houses rather than one dressing up in the other's clothes.That interplay is clearest on the denim. Both the jacket and the pants render the STA and SKULL motifs in patchwork, laid over faded, weathered washes meant to evoke well-worn vintage denim. The result leans into a hand-crafted, lived-in feel, with the two logos boldly embedded in the fabric rather than simply printed on top.The knit cardigan takes a more classic route. Drawing on the traditional argyle sweater, it pairs a muted argyle pattern on the front with STA and SKULL motifs finely knitted into the back, splitting the difference between preppy heritage and street sensibility. The crewneck sweat and tee, meanwhile, lean fully grunge: both carry sun-fade treatments and subtle distressing for a broken-in look, topped with a collegiate-style graphic that combines the APE HEAD silhouette with the SKULL for a vintage sportswear mood that the brands say deepens the more the pieces are worn.Anchoring the collection is the accessory that collectors will chase hardest. The BAPEX watch arrives in a refined color pairing suggestive of gold and onyx, and comes as a special serialized edition limited to just 100 pieces worldwide, positioning it as the clear centerpiece of the drop.“mastermind A BATHING APE 19TH” drops August 15 at BAPEXCLUSIVE AOYAMA and the BAPE webstore, with an in-store lottery beginning at 10:00 a.m. outside the Aoyama location for those shopping in pe

items.title: nonnative x Gramicci Reengineer the Easy Pant in Breathable Linen Oxford for Summer
items.text: nonnative x Gramicci Reengineer the Easy Pant in Breathable Linen Oxford for Summer Summary nonnative and Gramicci have built their latest collaboration around a linen-based oxford fabric blended with cottonThe capsule spans a wide-straight trouser called the WALKER ST EASY PANTS and a relaxed WALKER EASY SHORTSBoth pieces come in three muted colorways designed to highlight linen's soft, textured hand nonnative and Gramicci have returned with a new collaboration that puts fabric front and center, reworking their easy-wearing staples in a linen-based oxford cloth. The capsule centers on two relaxed silhouettes engineered for warm-weather comfort, arriving in a trio of understated tones.At the heart of the release is the material itself. Both brands opted for an oxford weave built on a linen foundation and blended with cotton, giving the cloth a coarse, tactile surface with plenty of visual character. That linen content does more than shape the look. Because the yarn touches less of the skin and pulls moisture efficiently, the fabric is designed to stay comfortable even when temperatures climb and things get sweaty, making it a considered pick for peak summer.The capsule breaks down into two shapes. The WALKER ST EASY PANTS takes a wide, straight-leg cut, while the WALKER EASY SHORTS carries the same loose, unrestricted attitude in a cropped form. Together they offer a full-length and short option built from the same breathable base, covering the range from city days to warmer escapes.Color is kept deliberately low-key across the board. The pieces come in Natural, Khaki Brown and Black, each chosen to draw out the gentle, slightly irregular tone that linen naturally carries. Rather than reaching for anything bold, the palette lets the texture and hand of the fabric do the talking.The nonnative x Gramicci collaboration drops August 15 at the nonnative shop, as well as Gramicci's directly-operated stores and online store. items.title: Pokémon and Crocs Unveil the Classic Clog "Poké Ball" for 30th Anniversary

The release marks the first installment of several planned 30th-anniversary drops between both brands, with subsequent iterations set to feature Pikachu, Gengar, and a Jigglypuff Classic Platform Clog.The Pokémon x Crocs Classic Clog "Poké Ball" officially launches on August 28, 2026. items.title: Wood Wood FW26 “Field Studies” Explores Nordic Silence and Textural Contrasts
items.text: Wood Wood FW26 “Field Studies” Explores Nordic Silence and Textural Contrasts Summary Wood Wood releases its FW26 "Field Studies" collection, exploring the Nordic Highlands through contrast-driven design.Highlighted looks feature oversized wool coats, '70s shearling leathers, two-tone bouclé knits, and reworked Nordic tartans.The Double A line adds streetwear energy with barrel pants, nylon coach jackets and bold graphics. Copenhagen-based label Wood Wood has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, titled "Field Studies," taking creative cues from the rugged landscapes and silent stillness of the Nordic Highlands.Led by Creative Director Brian SS Jensen and Head of Design Gitte Wetter, the seasonal lineup explores the tension between local rural communities and city-dwelling outsiders. This thematic narrative translates into a relaxed, layered visual aesthetic, captured in a lookbook featuring models gathered in timber-paneled cabins and rustic outdoor settings. The mainline assortment balances traditional Scandinavian design with functional outdoor wear, offering a rich color palette of pine greens, earthy browns and washed plums offset by vibrant accents of olive and soft pink.Key outerwear styles include oversized wool coats, padded cropped jackets, technical puffers and '70s-inspired leather jackets complete with shearling collars. Rather than projecting outward, the scents breathe inward, evoking serenity, resilience and renewal, like pauses between breaths that carry both stillness and presence.Built around the central concept of "What Stays," the line moves away from aggressive projection to offer an alcohol-free, water-based formulation designed to wear close to the skin and hair for up to six to eight hours. Enriched with nourishing ingredients like organic aloe vera water, rice-derived vegan ceramides, and a sugarcane complex, the non-sticky formula delivers a weightless, breathable veil that cares for the body while enveloping it in scent. The collection spans ten distinct fragrances composed as "inner memories" — from the clarity of "The Quiet Between" (featuring shimmered tomato leaf and galbanum) to the grounded, meditative calm of "The Ground Remembers" (anchored by hinoki and labdanum) and the cocooning warmth of "I’ll Stay Until You Sleep" (softened with tuberose and vanilla).Housed in clear glass bottles featuring clean architectural lines, a minimalist metallic cap and a golden, coat-of-arms crest emblem, the visual presentation of each scent highlights the crystal-clear purity of the water-based liquid inside.Completing the sensory experience, each fragrance comes packaged in a softly textured, patterned box accompanied by a dedicated protective drawstring pouch, inviting wearers to carry their scent ritual effortlessly throughout the day. items.title: The New Balance 1890A Hybrid Gets a "Cow Print" Makeover Built on a 2002 Sole
items.text: The New Balance 1890A Hybrid Gets a "Cow Print" Makeover Built on a 2002 Sole Name: New Balance 1890A “Cow Print”Colorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: Holiday 2026The New Balance 1890A is back in a "Cow Print" colorway that leans fully into the silhouette's fashion-forward side. A Wallabee-adjacent hybrid at its core, this version reworks the model's material palette to land squarely in lifestyle territory, trading technical detailing for a richer, more tactile mix.Construction is where the 1890A earns its unusual reputation. The model fuses a moc-toe upper with the sole unit pulled from the New Balance 2002, an odd-couple pairing that splits the difference between a casual slip-on shape and a cushioned runner base. It's a deliberately hybrid build, and this makeup pushes that identity toward the dressier end of the spectrum.To get there, New Balance stripped away the mesh and technical overlays found on earlier iterations of the shoe. In their place sits a more contemporary material story anchored by the cow print itself. Brown and off-white spotting covers the toe box and the surrounding underlays, while hairy suede overlays add texture across the upper and off-white leather wraps the collar for contrast. The result reads far closer to formal footwear than to a performance sneaker.That framing is no accident. The 1890A "Cow Print" plugs into a broader shift toward boot and dress-shoe cues across the sneaker space, a wave New Balance is riding on multiple fronts, including a 327 pack rendered in the same animal-print language. items.title: Ghibli Park Is Bringing ‘Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind’ to Life in a Brand New Zone
items.text: Ghibli Park Is Bringing ‘Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind’ to Life in a Brand New Zone Summary Ghibli Park is adding an area themed around Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind, a film Studio Ghibli had previously kept out of the parkStudio Ghibli itself proposed the Nausicaä concept during planning for the new expansion, a reversal from its earlier stanceThe zone will be built as the park's second entirely indoor area, a decision tied to Japan's punishing summer heat Ghibli Park is expanding once again, and this time it's finally opening the door to Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind, a Studio Ghibli landmark the Aichi Prefecture theme park had long treated as untouchable. The new area marks a notable change of heart from the studio, which had previously blocked efforts to give the film a presence at the park.The reversal is striking because of how firmly Ghibli had held the line. According to Aichi governor Hideaki Omura, the prefecture had floated the idea of a stronger Nausicaä presence before, only to be turned away. "Studio Ghibli would not let us touch Nausicaä," he said at the press conference announcing the expansion. What makes the about-face even more surprising is that, during conceptual talks for the new section, it was Studio Ghibli itself that put the Nausicaä theme on the table.That history gives the choice real weight. Released in Japanese theaters in 1984 and adapted from a manga Hayao Miyazaki had begun two years earlier, Nausicaä is widely regarded as the de-facto first Studio Ghibli film. Its production predated the studio's formal founding, but the creative team behind it went on to form Ghibli's founding core, and the project gave Miyazaki his first real shot at realizing an ambitious vision with a proper budget. Granting it a permanent home fills one of the more conspicuous gaps in a park that has steadily worked through the Miyazaki canon, from the Totoro-themed Dondoko Forest to Mononoke Village and the witch-focused Valley of the Witches.On the practical side, the Nausicaä zone will sit within Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park in Nagakute, roughly 45 minutes from downtown Nagoya, on a stretch of the West Gate Plaza near the Koi no Ike pond and across the water from Ghibli's Grand Warehouse. The flat plot means little reshaping of the land will be required, and current photos suggest minimal greenery would be lost in development. A concept sketch also hints that the plaza's existing tusk-shaped clock will remain in place.Design-wi

items.title: Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan Face Unimaginable Trauma in Gripping 'Josephine' Teaser Trailer
items.text: Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan Face Unimaginable Trauma in Gripping 'Josephine' Teaser Trailer Sumerian Pictures has officially released the first teaser trailer for Josephine, the acclaimed psychological thriller starring Channing Tatum and Gemma Chan. The film marks the directorial effort of writer-director Beth de Araújo and arrives following a competitive seven-figure festival acquisition.Rooted in Araújo’s lived experiences, the work of autobiographical fiction follows parents (Tatum and Chan) who struggle to navigate the aftermath of a traumatic event while supporting their eight-year-old daughter, Josephine (newcomer Mason Reeves), after she witnesses a crime in Golden Gate Park. The production emerged as a major standout at the Sundance Film Festival, where it claimed both the Grand Jury Prize and the Audience Award—a dual achievement previously held by Oscar-winning films such as CODA and Minari.Following its premiere, the feature screened in competition at the Berlin International Film Festival and is set to continue its rollout at the Toronto International Film Festival. The film is produced by Araújo, Tatum, Chan, David Kaplan, Josh Peters, Marina Stabile, Mark H. Rapaport, and Crystine Zhang, with Emanuel Nuñez and Jordan Rapaport serving as executive producers.Josephine officially opens in theaters on November 20. Read more at Hypebeast

As his bank accounts are locked out, his phone service is disconnected, and the imposter takes over his life, Moon-jae is thrust into a psychological game where he is forced to prove his own existence while uncovering the mysterious figure intent on taking everything he owns.The teaser video provides a tense preview of the chaotic identity theft and psychological unraveling driving the narrative, showcasing intense chases, high-stress police confrontations, and moody urban visuals. items.text: Tesla Reveals First Physical Cybercab Prototype With Built-In Starlink V5 Integration Summary Tesla revealed a gold-painted Cybercab prototype at Giga Texas featuring a Starlink V5 dish integrated into the rear roof.The integrated dish delivers speeds exceeding 375 Mbps, enabling 4K streaming, productivity tasks, and gaming for passengers. Tesla officially revealed the first physical Cybercab equipped with built-in Starlink internet. The company transitioned from digital renderings teased last month to real-world hardware when its dedicated robotaxi account posted images of a gold-painted prototype parked outside Gigafactory Texas. The vehicle features a low-profile satellite dish mounted flush within the rear roof panel. The seamless aesthetic integration maintains the car's minimalist exterior while fundamentally shifting how autonomous fleets secure data access on the move.The physical arrival of this technology signals a deeper operational synergy between Elon Musk’s automotive and aerospace ventures. Hardware specifications point to the newly launched Starlink V5 dish. The receiver is capable of download rates exceeding 375 Mbps. High-speed data opens the door for premium in-car digital experiences. Passengers can stream 4K video, handle productivity tasks or game seamlessly while the vehicle navigates to their destination.First Cybercab with @Starlink integration pic.twitter.com/8TI6LYSFjl— Tesla Robotaxi (@robotaxi) August 10, 2026Questions immediately surfaced regarding the necessity of a satellite connection for a self-driving car. The Cybercab relies entirely on Tesla’s onboard AI4 computer to navigate streets without human input. An active internet connection is never required for safe driving operations. Tesla Vice President of AI Software Ashok Elluswamy clarified that the satellite link serves secondary functions. The robust connection provides a critical backbone for fleet management, remote customer service and real-time navigation updates.Current robotaxi testing focuses heavily on dense urban markets like Austin and Miami where traditional cellular coverage remains strong. Adding a satellite terminal to a $30,000 vehicle introduces extra cost and weight to the production line. However, the hardware ensures total connectivity in rural dead zones where 5G or LTE signals drop out completely.The hardware deployment signals a much broader strategy across the entire automotive lineup. items.title: YouTube Doubles Partner Program Requirements Starting February 2027
items.text: YouTube Doubles Partner Program Requirements Starting February 2027 Summary YouTube is doubling the eligibility requirements for new creators to join its Partner Program, requiring 8,000 watch hours or 20 million Shorts views starting February 1, 2027.Existing partners are grandfathered into the program but must maintain a rolling threshold of 10 million Shorts views every 90 days to continue receiving revenue from the Shorts feed. YouTube announced it will significantly raise the bar for monetization to keep pace with platform growth. The Google-owned company is making its most significant adjustments to the YouTube Partner Program since 2018. New applicants will still need 1,000 subscribers to qualify. However, the required qualified watch hours over the past year will increase from 4,000 to 8,000 and the required Shorts views over 90 days will jump from 10 million to 20 million. These stricter entry thresholds officially take effect on February 1, 2027.The video giant cited massive consumption metrics as the catalyst for the updated barrier to entry. The platform currently registers over 200 billion daily Shorts views and more than one billion hours of daily watch time on televisions. By raising the threshold, YouTube puts heavier pressure on emerging creators to prove they can consistently draw large audiences before unlocking programmatic ad revenue. This shift marks a reversal from the company's recent strategy of lowering barriers to attract smaller talent.While the changes make it more difficult for new entrants to access ad revenue, existing program members remain unaffected for long-form content but face new performance mandates. All current partners must maintain 10 million Shorts views over a rolling 90-day window to remain eligible for revenue sharing from the short-form feed. Channels dropping below that mark will see their Shorts revenue paused until they cross the threshold again.Alongside the tightened requirements, YouTube is expanding its Premium Lite subscription tier to all global markets where the standard service operates. The ad-light tier funnels 60% of its net revenue into a dedicated creator pool compared to 30% from standard subscriptions. Payouts are distributed based on member watch time, with creators retaining 55% of revenue for long-form videos and 45% for Shorts.Company leadership noted that subscribers typically generate more revenue for partners than ad-supported viewers. items.title: Why London’s Most Exclusive Clubs Are Banning Meta’s Wearable Tech
items.text: Why London’s Most Exclusive Clubs Are Banning Meta’s Wearable Tech Summary Major United Kingdom hospitality chains and entertainment venues are restricting or banning the use of Meta smart glasses on their premises.Proprietors cite concerns over covert surveillance and the violation of guest privacy as the primary reasons for the crackdown on camera-equipped eyewear. The rollout of camera-equipped wearable tech is hitting a major roadblock in the UK. Venues ranging from high-end London dining rooms to massive pub chains are adapting their house rules to ban Meta smart glasses. The resistance highlights a growing cultural conflict between modern lifestyle technology and public privacy expectations. While the hardware offers hands-free livestreaming and point-of-view content creation, hospitality leaders are drawing a hard line against the potential for covert recording in social spaces.Wetherspoons stands as one of the largest chains enforcing the restriction across its 800 locations in England and Ireland. Founder Tim Martin stated that the devices breach the general code against filming customers and employees without direct permission. He described the ban as a common-sense approach to protecting personal space from surreptitious surveillance. The chain equates the discreet recording capabilities to the disruptive audible playing of videos, asserting that patrons caught using the smart glasses will be violating fundamental pub rules.The crackdown extends well into the premium hospitality sector. Renowned restaurateur Jeremy King has instituted a complete ban across his high-profile London establishments, including Arlington, The Park and Simpsons in the Strand. King emphasized his stance against any invasion of guest privacy that extends beyond natural eyesight. Private members' club Soho House implemented similar restrictions and now asks patrons to remove the hardware entirely. The shared sentiment across these distinct tiers of hospitality underscores a widespread rejection of normalized surveillance in dining environments.Entertainment operators are also joining the movement to protect attendee privacy. ATG Theatres requires guests to remove the frames during performances and Monopoly Events instituted an outright ban at its Comic-Con gatherings following complaints of nonconsensual filming. items.title: Tesla Design Chief Stands by “Very Soon” Release Schedule for Next-Gen Roadster
items.text: Tesla Design Chief Stands by “Very Soon” Release Schedule for Next-Gen Roadster Summary Tesla design chief Franz von Holzhausen teased a "very soon" launch for the next-gen Roadster after years of missed production targets.Despite holding $250,000 USD Founders Series deposits since 2017, volume production is unlikely to start before 2027 or 2028. Tesla design chief Franz von Holzhausen reaffirmed a highly ambiguous "very soon" timeline for the upcoming next-generation Roadster. The executive made the claim during a recent appearance on Jay Leno’s Garage while showcasing his custom V8-swapped Pontiac Solstice. When pressed by Leno regarding the actual status of the long-awaited electric supercar, von Holzhausen doubled down on the vague release window. The unyielding response prompted the former late-night host to dryly note that the highly touted vehicle has been in active development for just shy of a decade.First revealed to the public in November 2017, the disruptive electric hypercar has missed countless production and demonstration targets. The brand originally promised to begin building the vehicle by 2020. That deadline slipped to 2022, then 2023 and subsequently 2024. CEO Elon Musk recently established a demonstration date of April 2026 before shifting expectations once again to August. Current reports indicate that the overarching aesthetic design is complete, but integrating an optional SpaceX cold gas thruster system remains a formidable technical hurdle. Internally dubbed A71, this aerospace hardware is intended to deliver unprecedented acceleration alongside potential vertical lift capabilities. The thruster package simply was not ready for a spring showcase.Continuous engineering delays highlight a broader operational reality for the pioneering automaker, where ambitious performance promises frequently outpace actual manufacturing timelines. Despite repeated setbacks over the years, Tesla maintains the exact same original hardware specifications for the base model. The aggressive initial pitch includes a zero to 60 mph launch in 1.9 seconds, a 250 mph top speed and a staggering 620 miles of driving range per charge. Pricing currently sits at $200,000 for the standard variant.Early adopters continue to shoulder the most significant financial burden of this drawn-out development process. items.title: Apple Is Building a Hardware-Level “Reference Image” Tool To Combat AI-Generated Photos
items.text: Apple Is Building a Hardware-Level “Reference Image” Tool To Combat AI-Generated Photos Summary Apple's iOS 27 beta 5 code reveals a hardware-level feature designed to cryptographically prove photos originated from an authentic iPhone sensor.Capturing images in a dedicated Reference mode embeds unique hardware telemetry, verified privately via Private Cloud Compute without exposing raw photos. Synthetic imagery continues to blur the lines of reality across the digital landscape. Apple is quietly building a hardware-level countermeasure to combat generative fakes. Unearthed in the recent iOS 27 beta 5 release, the tech giant is developing a system called Apple Reference Image. The upcoming feature aims to provide cryptographic proof that a photograph originated from a genuine iPhone camera sensor rather than an artificial intelligence generator.Getting the provenance data requires deliberate action from the photographer. Users must enable a dedicated Reference mode within the camera settings before snapping a picture. Shooting normally leaves out the necessary hardware-tied metadata. The specialized capture method embeds unique sensor information directly into the file to establish a verifiable baseline for authenticity.Authentication does not happen automatically. Photographers choose when to verify their captures. The system leverages Private Cloud Compute to handle the heavy lifting without compromising user privacy. The raw image never reaches Cupertino servers. The phone transmits only the required sensor telemetry and metadata for validation. The cloud network cross-references the sensor data and assigns the photo a unique digital ID. If a specific camera component is later flagged as compromised, Apple retains the ability to revoke previous authentications to maintain systemic integrity.Sharing verified media extends the chain of trust to other users. Anyone receiving an authenticated photograph via AirDrop or Messages can locally check its validity on their own device. The sender retains control over how much provenance data transfers alongside the file. A new Transfer with Provenance option also exists for hardwired USB exports to Mac or PC setups. This ensures the digital paper trail survives the jump from mobile to desktop environments.The initiative arrives as tech leaders scramble to label synthetic content. items.text: The 208-MPH Roofless Supercar: Eccentrica Restomod Breaks Cover Summary Eccentrica unveiled the V12 Roadster, a carbon-fiber, open-top re-engineering of the first-series Lamborghini Diablo.It features a 550-hp naturally aspirated 5.7-liter V12 mated to a six-speed gated manual transmission.Only 19 bespoke units engineered by former Lamborghini CTO Maurizio Reggiani will be produced. Eccentrica is proving that raw 1990s nostalgia hits best without a roof. Every single vehicle incorporates over 3,500 bespoke components, transforming the raw poster car of the era into an elemental, driver-focused machine. Led by former Lamborghini CTO Maurizio Reggiani - the legendary architect behind the Murciélago, Aventador and Huracán - Eccentrica’s engineering team completely reshaped the Diablo’s original silhouette. The bodywork is constructed entirely from carbon fiber over a steel spaceframe, featuring a widened track and recalibrated proportions. Beneath the panels, structural carbon fiber reinforcements stiffen the chassis for the open-top application, paired with double wishbone suspension, custom semi-active dampers, hydraulic rack-and-pinion steering, and a high-performance Brembo braking setup.Mechanical upgrades target raw performance and driving engagement. Power comes from an altered 5.7-liter engine that delivers 550 horsepower and 443 pound-feet of torque. The powertrain receives redesigned thermal management systems and optimized airflow efficiency. Custom ECU mapping sharpens throttle response to suit aggressive driving styles. Drivers manage the immense power delivery through a traditional six-speed gated manual gearbox. The lack of a roof does not compromise ultimate velocity. The supercar reaches a tested top speed of 208 mph.Handling characteristics receive equal attention from the engineering team. The reinforced chassis pairs with semi-active dampers to modernize the suspension geometry. Hydraulic power steering replaces older systems to provide precise feedback on modern roads. items.title: KSUBI Channels Roadside Americana With Fall 2026 “Strangers in Paradise”
items.text: KSUBI Channels Roadside Americana With Fall 2026 “Strangers in Paradise” Summary KSUBI Fall 2026 “Strangers in Paradise” collection draws on roadside Americana grit.The range highlights resin-dipped denim, Western tailoring, tomboy silhouettes and Y2K-inspired elements.Available now via the brand's online store and physical flagships around the world. KSUBI’s Fall 2026 collection, titled “Strangers in Paradise,” builds on the brand’s rebellious DNA with a narrative rooted in roadside Americana. Inspired by motels, racetracks and backroom gyms, the collection is grounded in a raw contrast of grit and glamour. It evokes a spirit of polished resistance, blending distressed textures with refined Western tailoring and sport-inspired silhouettes built for outsiders on the move.The menswear range channels boxing gyms and amateur speed culture, with distressed denim, resin-dipped finishes and archival hand-sketched artwork dominating the apparel. Heavy hardware is offset by flocked velvets and fur, while motor patches and oil-washed textures reinforce the collection’s lived-in aesthetic. Meanwhile for womenswear, the collection leans into Western pointed yokes, low-slung tomboy denim, laced mini skirts and Y2K-inspired eveningwear that transitions effortlessly from street to club.The "Strangers in Paradise" collection is currently available to shop via KSUBI's website as well as physical flagship stores in New York, Los Angeles, Miami, Chicago, Sydney and Melbourne. The dark narrative game comes from Assassin’s Creed series creator Patrice Désilets.In 1666: Amsterdam, players step into the role of Noa, "the Collector," who wields witchcraft to uncover "Originals"—demonic entities hiding behind human faces. The narrative follows Noa’s Commencement as she inherits the mantle of the Collector and unravels a mystery spanning centuries across a city shaped by secrets, power, and memory.The Early Access version includes the first piece of the campaign, which is expected to offer approximately 15 hours of gameplay. items.text: Seiko and TRADMAN’S BONSAI Recreate the Texture of Aged Pine Bark on a Presage Dial Summary Seiko teams up with TRADMAN’S BONSAI for a 2,000-piece Presage Classic Series watch collaboration.Housed in a gold-tone case, the timepiece sports a deep Matsuba-Iro green dial with an aged pine-bark texture.Available for pre-order now with deliveries beginning in September. Seiko has partnered up with TRADMAN’S BONSAI for a collaborative timepiece, unveiling the Seiko Presage Classic Series x TRADMAN’S BONSAI Limited Edition. The collective, known for blending horticultural tradition with contemporary design, lends its vision to this timepiece, making it a rare expression of Japanese craftsmanship.aesthetic concept draws direct inspiration from the crescent-shaped "moon" pot - a classic bonsai vessel symbolizing harmony and balance - capturing the serene imagery of a black pine illuminated under moonlight. The dial is executed in Matsuba-Iro, a rich, deep green shade derived from pine needles that historically signifies longevity, resilience and immortality.To impart texture and character, a newly developed embossed pattern coats the dial face, replicating the rugged, tactile surface of aged pine bark. Framing this display beneath a dual-curved sapphire crystal, elegantly curved hands sweep across the textured face, set against a gold-colored plated case and matching bracelet. An additional strap embossed with a traditional three-pronged pine pattern is also included to further emphasize the watch’s connection to nature.At the heart of the timepiece is Seiko's in-house 6R51 automatic movement, which operates with a daily accuracy rating of +25/-15 seconds and offers around three days of power reserve. Retailing at £1,250 GBP (approx. $ 1,688 USD) and limited to 2,000 units, the Presage Classic Series x TRADMAN’S BONSAI timepiece is now available for pre-order via Seiko Boutique website, with deliveries beginning in September, 2026. items.title: Kith and BMW Reconnect for Chapter IV Apparel and Lifestyle Collection
items.text: Kith and BMW Reconnect for Chapter IV Apparel and Lifestyle Collection Summary Kith and BMW reunite for Chapter IV, anchoring their 15th-anniversary apparel range around BMW’s archival Inka Orange palette.Releasing on August 17, highlighted styles include AVIREX leather jackets, moto outerwear, Nelson fleece, Monogram leather bags and a 169-part 1:18-scale 1972 BMW 3.0 CSi die-cast model. Following up on Ronnie Fieg's recent reveal of the one-of-one 1972 BMW 3.0 CSi and 1987 BMW M6 E24 restorations, Kith and BMW have officially unveiled the accompanying Chapter IV apparel and lifestyle collection.Arriving as part of Kith’s 15th-anniversary celebrations, the extensive range translates the automotive duo’s shared history through a curated, four-chapter color story. The collaborative palette draws directly from BMW’s heritage archives — incorporating the E30 M3’s Cinnabar Red, Kith-exclusive Vitality Green, elusive Techno Violet and the vibrant Inka Orange seen across the newly restored grand tourers.The product assortment spans heavy outerwear, casual sportswear, refined leather goods, and custom automotive accessories. Outerwear highlights include a multi-paneled leather jacket crafted in partnership with AVIREX, alongside the Braun and Dewitt leather moto jackets, souvenir silhouettes and casual track tops.Everyday essentials feature signature fleece cuts such as the Nelson Quarter Zip, Braxton Track Zip, and Nelson Hoodie, paired with BMW archival graphic tees, upscale knitwear and matching track pants. On the accessories side, Kith introduces Monogram-embossed leather overnight bags, travel duffles, watch holders, and ‘47 Sheep Suede Drivers Caps, complemented by co-branded BMW X5 floor mats, license plate holders, and a detailed 1:18-scale die-cast model of the Inka Orange 1972 BMW 3.0 CSi built from 169 parts.The full Kith for BMW Chapter IV collection releases globally on August 17, 2026, and will be available across all Kith flagship stores, online and via the brand's App. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Amsterdam Surf Association Launches Its FW26 “SAFETY” Collection
items.text: Amsterdam Surf Association Launches Its FW26 “SAFETY” Collection Summary Amsterdam Surf Association drops FW26 "SAFETY," bridging high-exposure coastal surf conditions with urban workplace pressures.Available now, the drop features burn-out dual-layer tees, polycotton shirting, reversible bombers, and wax comb knit details. Amsterdam Surf Association has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 collection, titled “SAFETY,” exploring the thematic tension between coastal survival and urban workplace pressures. Bridging high-exposure surf conditions with the daily rush of city life, the seasonal lineup balances functional protection with effortless daily comfort.The range features versatile outerwear and tailored sportswear, highlighted by reversible bomber jackets, a classic cotton trench coat, adaptable flannels and the signature Coach Jacket updated in "Green Check" and a new mixed-wool fabric. To complement the return of the bestselling Work Trousers, the brand introduces a matching Zip Up Shirt, while workwear and surf-inspired detailing - such as wax comb-patterned knit accents, breathable mesh elements and distressed finishes - run throughout the collection.Standout design features include waffle-sleeved shirts and specialized T-shirts crafted with a unique burn-out process, where top cotton fibers are dissolved to reveal a second layer of contrasting color underneath. The apparel range is animated by a bold color palette of high-visibility orange, army green, and pool blue, set alongside washed waffle jerseys and faded logo tees adorned with subtle beaded textures.The Amsterdam Surf Association FW26 "SAFETY" collection is released and is shoppable via the brand's official webstore. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Selten and Watch Ho & Co. Channel Hong Kong’s Dim Sum Culture Into an Endearing Timepiece
items.text: Selten and Watch Ho & Co. Channel Hong Kong’s Dim Sum Culture Into an Endearing Timepiece Summary Selten and Watch Ho & Co. drop the 100-piece "Yum Cha" edition watch.Features a hand-engraved Grand Feu enamel dial mimicking a bamboo dim sum steamer.Powered by a manual-wind Sellita movement, priced at $4,950 USD. Independent watch brand Selten has teamed up with watch community platform Watch Ho & Co. to introduce a deeply personal métiers d’art timepiece: the Yum Cha edition. Created to mark Watch Ho & Co.’s third anniversary, the release translates founder Jackie Ho’s cherished childhood memories of visiting traditional Hong Kong tea houses with his grandparents into horology. Instead of taking design cues from conventional motorsport or military tropes, the collaboration centers on the warmth, family rituals and rich culinary heritage of dim sum culture.The highlight of the timepiece is its hand-engraved, fine-silver Grand Feu enamel dial, designed to mirror the intricate weave of a traditional bamboo steamer basket. Crafted under a microscope by Selten's in-house master engraver and enamelist, Master Qin, each dial requires 16.5 hours of painstaking labor, involving roughly 3,500 individual hand cuts and multiple high-temperature firings. Finished in a rich honey-gold to amber fumé gradient, the dial recalls the warm patina acquired by wooden steamers after decades of use and is framed by custom diamond-cut hands shaped like tea leaves.Housed in a 38mm stainless steel case measuring 9.95mm thick with a prominent top-hat sapphire crystal, the watch is powered by the manual-wind Sellita SW210-2 M Power+ movement, offering a 65-hour power reserve and regulated to within ±6 seconds per day. The aesthetic theme continues onto the solid engraved caseback depicting a sentimental family meal, as well as its presentation packaging, which includes a genuine handcrafted bamboo steamer, bamboo coasters, and a warranty card styled like a classic Hong Kong dim sum order sheet. Capped at just 100 pieces globally, the Watch Ho & Co. x Selten Yum Cha Edition retails for $4,950 USD. For more information, visit Selten's dedicated webpage for the timepiece via its website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: XLARGE and RHC Ron Herman Team Up for 35th Anniversary Apparel Drop
items.text: XLARGE and RHC Ron Herman Team Up for 35th Anniversary Apparel Drop Summary XLARGE and RHC Ron Herman link up for a collaborative capsule introducing eco-friendly "XLARGE FABRIC" recycled T/C twill.It features Twill Jackets, Work Shirts, Pants, Shorts, and a Japanese-made co-branded OG Logo Tee.Launches August 15, 2026, exclusively at RHC Ron Herman stores and online. In celebration of XLARGE’s upcoming 35th anniversary, the West Coast streetwear imprint has teamed up with RHC Ron Herman for a special collaborative drop. Anchoring the release is the debut of XLARGE FABRIC, a newly developed, eco-friendly textile crafted from a recycled blend T/C twill that combines rugged durability with wrinkle-resistant, easy-care functionality and clean breathability. Reinterpreting XLARGE’s 1991 Los Angeles workwear roots through RHC Ron Herman's refined lens, the partnership bridges 1990s nostalgia with modern daily wearability.The capsule collection offers a comprehensive wardrobe made from the signature fabric alongside premium daily essentials. Key styles include a zip-up Twill Jacket, a short-sleeved Twill Work Shirt, relaxed Twill Pants and matching Twill Shorts, each presented in clean White, Navy, and Black colorways. Completing the capsule is a special white OG Logo Tee crafted in Japan from soft, high-quality cotton and stamped with a co-branded gorilla graphic.The XLARGE x RHC Ron Herman collection will release on August 15, 2026, exclusively via RHC Ron Herman and Ron Herman "R" physical stores and online. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: South2 West8 and SUICOKE Reunite for a Weather-Ready Camp Moccasin
items.text: South2 West8 and SUICOKE Reunite for a Weather-Ready Camp Moccasin Name: South2 West8 SUICOKE Moccasin eVentColorway: Beige, BlackSKU: TY960B, TY960AMSRP: ¥40,700 JPY (approx. $255 USD)Release Date: August 14Where to Buy: NepenthesHailing from Hokkaido, Japanese outdoor label South2 West8 has reunited with renowned footwear brand SUICOKE to deliver an updated iteration of their collaborative Camp Moccasin - eVent. The upper is crafted from premium cow suede, giving the shoe a refined, matte finish that translates into everyday wear with ease. The collaboration is offered in two versatile, tonal colorways — a soft, earthy beige and a sleek, understated black. Both iterations maintain the classic visual profile of a traditional camp moccasin while cleverly concealing a suite of high-performance technical upgrades within.Beneath its traditional exterior, the shoe's construction is heavily fortified to handle unpredictable weather and diverse terrains. The interior is outfitted with an eVent lining, providing waterproof and breathable capabilities. Grounding the design is a heavy-duty Vibram DECEMBER outsole, a rugged unit specifically developed to tackle the demanding conditions of urban hiking. This robust sole delivers uncompromising traction and stability across both slick city streets and light outdoor trails. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: General Motors Pulls the Plug on Chevrolet Retail Operations in China
items.text: General Motors Pulls the Plug on Chevrolet Retail Operations in China Summary Chevrolet will end retail sales in China after a 98.8% decline over the past decade.A renewed strategic agreement between GM and SAIC Motor targets the launch of at least 30 new energy vehicle models by 2030 to bolster Buick and Cadillac. General Motors is officially pulling the plug on Chevrolet retail operations in China. The American automotive giant will end the brand's domestic presence after 21 years in the region. Once a dominant player in the Chinese market, Chevrolet experienced a massive 98.8% sales collapse over the past decade. Annual volume plummeted from a peak of more than 760,000 units in 2014 to fewer than 9,000 deliveries last year. The withdrawal highlights a broader shift in consumer appetite as local buyers rapidly pivot toward domestic electric options.Despite the retail exit, local manufacturing operations will continue. General Motors plans to leverage its existing SAIC-GM joint venture to build Chevrolet models exclusively for international export. The automaker will utilize the established Chinese production infrastructure to supply tailored vehicles to emerging global markets without maintaining a costly domestic retail network.The decision reflects a larger strategic realignment for General Motors in a highly competitive sector. With new energy vehicles now capturing a vast majority of the country's auto sales, Chevrolet struggled to transition its domestic lineup. The brand relied heavily on gas-powered models like the Blazer, Equinox and Malibu XL. Consequently, the company will dedicate its resources to expanding its more successful Buick and Cadillac portfolios where demand for premium and electric options remains viable.To secure its foothold in the luxury sector, General Motors recently extended its partnership with SAIC Motor for another two decades. The renewed agreement extends through 2047 and outlines an aggressive roadmap for technological transformation. The collaborative enterprise aims to launch at least 30 new energy vehicles by 2030 while deploying advanced regional technology solutions tailored specifically for Chinese consumers. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Leaks Reveal Internal Debate Surrounding Apple’s Reported “iPhone Ultra” Branding
items.text: Leaks Reveal Internal Debate Surrounding Apple’s Reported “iPhone Ultra” Branding Summary Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple staff widely use "iPhone Ultra" for the upcoming foldable smartphone.Branding Hierarchy Debate: Analysts question the "Ultra" name, noting foldables prioritize unique form factors over raw performance specs.Pro-Tier Hardware Advantages: Traditional Pro Max models are expected to maintain superior cameras, cooling, chassis durability and battery life. Apple employees are reportedly using the name "iPhone Ultra" to refer to the company's highly anticipated foldable smartphone. According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the internal shorthand has been widely adopted across the tech giant's ranks. This shift replaces the colloquial "iPhone Fold" moniker that previously circulated among external leakers. The insight surfaced on X, formerly Twitter, where Gurman noted that despite the widespread internal usage, final retail branding remains unconfirmed ahead of the device's expected debut at an upcoming September hardware event.The naming convention came to light during an online exchange with Creative Strategies analyst Max Weinbach. Weinbach expressed skepticism about the "Ultra" branding and argued that the designation contradicts established product hierarchy. Across the company's ecosystem, from premium M-series silicon to top-tier wearables, the Ultra label historically signifies the absolute most capable version of a lineup. Because the foldable device prioritizes a unique form factor over raw performance, critics question whether it truly outclasses standard Pro configurations.Industry observers note that the foldable smartphone will likely lack the robust feature set of the iPhone 18 Pro Max. Traditional high-end models are expected to retain superior camera systems, more durable chassis designs, better thermal cooling capabilities and extended battery life. While the foldable device will feature unmatched display technology and a premium A-series processor, positioning it directly above the Pro tier presents a complex marketing challenge. As the most expensive mobile device in the brand's history, premium pricing alone could ultimately justify the elite nomenclature.Despite the internal consensus among employees, Apple operates with notorious secrecy. items.title: norda’s FW26 Lineup Highlights Marbled Midsoles and Iridescent Accents
items.text: norda’s FW26 Lineup Highlights Marbled Midsoles and Iridescent Accents Name: norda FW26 Footwear CollectionMSRP: $145 - $355 USDRelease Date: Available NowWhere to Buy: nordaFor Fall/Winter 2026, norda introduces a wide spectrum of new colorways across its performance silhouettes, each designed to balance technical innovation with seasonal aesthetics. Leading the lineup is the ultra-lightweight 005 in Zephyr, which captures a sense of fast, fluid motion through a shimmering silver base and sharp metallic accents. Following this is the 005 Scoria - a ruggedly chic, volcanic-inspired variation - and the 005 Stealth Black, which offers a murkier, more subdued interpretation of raw speed utilizing tonal gradients and pre-faded treatments.The collection comprehensively updates the brand's bio-circular Dyneema®-equipped silhouettes with a variety of organic and mineral-inspired themes. The 001A Almond centers around light shades grounded by striking black and reflective silver accents, while the 001A Scoria incorporates a melange of mauve and grey paired with reflective details and marbled midsole treatments. Transitioning to verdant and earthy hues, the 001A Serpentine utilizes a medley of faded green shades, leading directly into the rich brown tones and black accents of the 001A Star Anise. Adding a unique textural element to the trail, the low-to-the-ground 002 Travertine features gridded and abstract printed details that mimic the porous nature of natural limestone, before the primary sequence rounds out with the 008 Scoria recovery slide, complete with dual-density foam and a custom Vibram® ECOSTEP soleplate.In a separate highlight for the brand's all-terrain speed and stability category, the seasonal lineup introduces the 055 G+ Star Anise and the 055 Thistle. The 055 G+ Star Anise pairs its rich, Asian fruit-inspired brown tones with an all-new thermoregulating and hydrophobic graphene membrane, ensuring optimal warmth and water resistance alongside a highly propulsive 100% Arnitel® TPEE midsole. Meanwhile, the 055 Thistle draws its aesthetic inspiration from prickly flowering plants, utilizing a rugged blend of mauve and grey shades. Both of these robust silhouettes feature an integrated knit collar and a bespoke Vibram soleplate equipped with Megagrip Elite® and Litebase® technologies, delivering unparalleled performance and durability for demanding outdoor environments.
