items.title: Mercedes-AMG Teases High-Performance Electric SUV Sibling to the GT 4-Door Coupe
items.text: Mercedes-AMG Teases High-Performance Electric SUV Sibling to the GT 4-Door Coupe Summary Mercedes-AMG dropped a teaser image of a high-riding crossover sibling to the AMG GT 4-Door Coupe EV.Expected to run on a 106-kWh battery pack, top trims could deliver up to 1,150 horsepower across dual and tri-motor setups. Mercedes-AMG is preparing to expand its flagship performance EV lineup. The German automaker dropped a teaser on Instagram revealing a mysterious vehicle draped under a dark sheet. Positioned as a high-riding sibling to the all-electric AMG GT 4-Door Coupe EV, the upcoming model marks a significant shift for the performance wing. The brand accompanied the shadowy image with a bold statement declaring the vehicle was born in Affalterbach and built to challenge existing expectations.Visual cues from the teaser point directly to the aggressive design language established by the sedan counterpart. Familiar taillights shine through the cover alongside the characteristic LED headlight bar and three-pointed star styling. The hidden silhouette diverges from the sleek, low-riding profile of the current generation. The new crossover rides considerably taller and features a prominent hatchback shape that prioritizes utilitarian presence without sacrificing aesthetics. This move signals a deliberate strategy to capture the highly competitive luxury crossover segment while maintaining track-ready credentials.Underneath the dramatic exterior styling, the new vehicle will likely share the robust mechanical foundation of its stablemates. Industry expectations point to a massive 106-kWh battery pack serving as the core of the electric architecture. The power output should mirror the staggering figures of the current GT lineup. The top-tier GT63 trim produces 1150 horsepower while the mid-range GT55 generates 805 horsepower. Even the entry-level GT53 delivers a formidable 536 horsepower to the wheels.Mercedes first signaled its intent to develop a dedicated electric performance SUV late last year. The automaker used identical messaging regarding its Affalterbach origins during a December announcement. Developing a crossover derivative allows the brand to maximize its technological investments while meeting consumer demand for high-riding luxury vehicles. The formal launch of this highly anticipated model appears imminent as the company finalizes its next generation of electrified machines. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: FCC Filings Reportedly Confirm “Sonos Ace Ultra” Headset Ahead of Fall Launch
items.text: FCC Filings Reportedly Confirm “Sonos Ace Ultra” Headset Ahead of Fall Launch Summary Sonos is reportedly developing a high-end over-ear headset dubbed the Sonos Ace Ultra for a September launch.FCC filings suggest the unannounced model will launch in five colors: Greige, Shadow Black, Agave, Blush, and Sand.Reports indicate the headset will leverage expanded voice controls to interact with smart lighting and broader AI ecosystems. Sonos is developing a high-end successor to its first over-ear headphones. According to a Bloomberg report and a recent FCC filing, the audio company plans to release a premium model dubbed the Sonos Ace Ultra. The hardware reveal aligns with a September product launch event, signaling a swift follow-up to the brand making its initial leap from wireless speakers into the wearable audio market.The upcoming release departs from the standard monochromatic finishes seen on the original 2024 model. Documents spotted by Lowpass regarding a product designated as S52a indicate the new headphones will launch in five distinct colors. Consumers can expect options including Greige, Shadow Black, Agave, Blush and Sand.The Ace Ultra represents a strategic shift for the brand under Chief Executive Officer Tom Conrad. The executive acknowledged that the initial headset arrived without enough whole-home integration to stand out in a crowded market. Moving forward, Sonos aims to tie its hardware directly to broader artificial intelligence ambitions. The company views conversational computing and predictive intelligence as major opportunities in the home audio sector.Future devices will serve as hardware nodes that work seamlessly across rooms and understand daily household routines. The brand has already laid the groundwork for this ecosystem by expanding Sonos Voice Control to operate Philips Hue lighting and Lutron Caseta smart home configurations. The new headphones will reportedly support advanced voice commands to better connect with these connected systems and cutting-edge artificial intelligence models.This renewed focus on smart features arrives as competitors ramp up their own capabilities. Apple launched the upgraded AirPods Max 2 in March with stronger noise cancellation and Live Translation powered by the H2 chip. Siri will also gain new functionality on those headphones through the upcoming iOS 27 update. items.title: 'Barbie 2' Reportedly in Jeopardy Amid Stalled Negotiations With Warner Bros. Discovery
items.text: 'Barbie 2' Reportedly in Jeopardy Amid Stalled Negotiations With Warner Bros. Discovery Summary Contract negotiations for a 'Barbie' sequel have reportedly stalled between Warner Bros. Discovery and the original creative teamDemands from Greta Gerwig, Margot Robbie, and Ryan Gosling include significant increases in upfront compensation and backend profit participationWarner Bros. has approximately four months to place a follow-up into active development before the IP rights revert to Mattel Warner Bros. Discovery and the core creative team behind the record-breaking blockbuster Barbie have hit a major impasse regarding the development of Barbie 2.The creative coalition—consisting of director and co-writer Greta Gerwig, co-writer Noah Baumbach, lead actor and producer Margot Robbie, and co-star Ryan Gosling—remains uncommitted to a follow-up after their original deals included no sequel options. While Warner Bros. Discovery chief David Zaslav and film heads Michael De Luca and Pamela Abdy have reportedly delivered more than six offers over three years, including an unprecedented financial package, negotiations led by CAA have reached a deadlock primarily over backend participation terms.The standstill puts the future of the multibillion-dollar franchise at immediate risk. Warner Bros. has an estimated four-month window to place another film into active development before the theatrical rights to the doll revert to Mattel. Should the negotiations fall through completely, Mattel would face a full creative reboot without access to Gerwig's established cinematic universe. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: SpaceXAI and Cursor Launch “Grok Bot” Autonomous AI Teammates Across Desktop and Mobile
items.text: SpaceXAI and Cursor Launch “Grok Bot” Autonomous AI Teammates Across Desktop and Mobile Summary SpaceXAI and Cursor launched Grok Bot, an app equipping AI agents with cloud computers to execute tasks across web applications.Agents learn routines by watching users complete tasks once, operating quietly in the background until approval is required. SpaceXAI and Cursor are taking their impending merger to the next level with the release of Grok Bot. Available today for macOS, iOS, Windows and Linux, the new application introduces autonomous AI agents designed to function as digital coworkers rather than simple chat interfaces. The software bypasses traditional API constraints by providing each bot with its own persistent cloud computer. This structural shift allows the agent to sign into web applications and software tools just like a human operator would, navigating complex interfaces to execute actual work.Users interact with the software exactly as they would message a colleague on a mobile device or desktop. The setup process eliminates the need for intricate automation coding. Instead, a user can train an agent by having it watch a task being performed once. The bot saves the workflow as a routine, adapts to specific preferences and learns to handle edge cases over time. Once assigned a job, the agent operates entirely in the background and only surfaces to ask for final approval or when a critical judgment call is required.The platform encourages scaling by allowing users to deploy multiple bots simultaneously. A single user can assign specialized roles across different agents such as having one handle sales outreach while another manages expense reporting or bug reproduction. These autonomous teammates can even be placed into shared group chats where they pass tasks between themselves. By coordinating handoffs without human micromanagement, the system transforms single-user setups into highly efficient operational teams.Initial access to the early beta is strictly gated for power users. The service requires an active subscription to SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra or Cursor Teams Premium. An Android release and an enterprise waitlist are currently in development as the unified company continues to push the boundaries of functional artificial intelligence. items.title: Reports Claim Apple Is Building Pro-Grade Manual Camera Controls Into iOS
items.text: Reports Claim Apple Is Building Pro-Grade Manual Camera Controls Into iOS Summary Apple’s upcoming iPhone 18 Pro is rumored to introduce a major camera hardware updated highlighted by a variable aperture main sensor and a wider aperture for the telephoto lens.The flagship smartphone is also anticipated to feature a revamped Camera Control button to complement the new photographic capabilities. Apple is reportedly preparing a monumental overhaul for the iPhone 18 Pro camera system by introducing a variable aperture for the main lens. Described by industry analysts as the most significant leap in camera hardware in recent memory, the upcoming flagship aims to redefine mobile photography. The centerpiece of this hardware evolution is the rumored variable aperture on the primary sensor. This mechanical adjustment would allow the device to physically alter its light intake rather than relying solely on software-based computational processing. By natively controlling the depth of field, users can achieve genuine optical bokeh, tailored focus and enhanced adaptivity across diverse shooting environments. The technology promises to dramatically improve performance in low-light conditions and dedicated Portrait mode settings.In addition to the main sensor upgrades, the iPhone 18 Pro telephoto camera is slated to receive a wider aperture. Zoomed lenses on smartphones have historically struggled in dimly lit scenarios due to restricted light-gathering capabilities. These physical limitations often result in grainy or soft images when shooting subjects from a distance at night. By physically opening the aperture on the telephoto module, the tech giant is directly addressing one of the most prominent weaknesses in its current photographic lineup. This enhancement ensures users can capture sharp and high-quality zoomed photographs even when ambient lighting is less than ideal.Matching professional-grade equipment requires more than just advanced glass. The company is expected to introduce a suite of Pro-exclusive software features designed to mirror the intricate controls found on dedicated standalone cameras. The default Camera app has maintained a deliberately basic layout optimized for point-and-shoot simplicity for years. New reports indicate a strategic pivot to empower mobile photographers with advanced manual settings directly within the native ecosystem. items.title: Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington Star in Gripping Teaser Trailer for Netflix's 'Animals'
items.text: Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington Star in Gripping Teaser Trailer for Netflix's 'Animals' Summary Netflix has officially released the dialogue-free teaser trailer for the upcoming thriller 'Animals'The film stars Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington as parents entangled in a web of deception following the kidnapping of their sonDirected, produced, and co-written by Affleck alongside Artists Equity, the film arrives on Netflix and in select theaters on October 9 Netflix has officially released the first teaser trailer for Animals, an upcoming kidnapping thriller starring and directed by Ben Affleck. The project marks the latest high-profile production from Affleck and Matt Damon’s Artists Equity banner.The tense, dialogue-free teaser follows a Los Angeles mayoral candidate (Affleck) and his wife (Kerry Washington) whose comfortable family life unravels after an ominous phone call reveals their young son (Christopher Woodley) has been abducted. Forced to scramble to raise ransom payments, the couple is pushed into making desperate, high-stakes decisions to save their family.In addition to directing and starring, Affleck co-wrote the screenplay with Connor O. McIntyre and Billy Ray. Produced alongside Matt Damon and Luciana Damon, the feature also features an ensemble supporting cast including Steven Yeun, Gillian Anderson, Adriana Paz, Ray Fisher, Matt Gerald, Jacob Estrada, and Luis Gerardo Méndez.Animals officially premieres in select theaters and streams globally on Netflix on October 9. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Electronic Arts and Bit Reactor Announce 'Star Wars Zero Company'
items.text: Electronic Arts and Bit Reactor Announce 'Star Wars Zero Company' Summary Electronic Arts and Bit Reactor have unveiled 'Star Wars Zero Company' a new single-player turn-based tactics gameSet during the Clone Wars era players command a specialized mercenary squad led by a customizable officer named HawksThe title officially launches on August 27 for PC PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S Electronic Arts and developer Bit Reactor have officially announced Star Wars Zero Company, introducing the sci-fi franchise's first dedicated single-player turn-based tactical video game. The upcoming title is developed in partnership with Lucasfilm Games.Set during the Clone Wars era, the gameplay puts players in control of Hawks, a customizable former Galactic Republic officer voiced by Jonathan Freeman or Erica Luttrell. Leading Zero Company—a crew of galactic mercenaries including a Clone Trooper, a Mandalorian, and a Jedi Padawan—players are tasked with hunting down Kundri Fathom (Rekha Sharma), the leader of a Separatist-aligned cult known as the Infinite Coil. Iconic figures such as Anakin Skywalker (voiced by Matt Lanter) appear on the story's periphery, utilizing a narrative framework inspired by the AMC historical drama Turn.Drawing mechanical inspiration from turn-based staples like XCOM, the title integrates tactical positioning, choice-driven progression, and character-driven mission design engineered to be accessible for both franchise fans and tactical genre enthusiasts.Star Wars Zero Company officially launches on August 27 for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Warner Bros. Officially Confirms ‘Hogwarts Legacy 2’ Is in Development
items.text: Warner Bros. Officially Confirms ‘Hogwarts Legacy 2’ Is in Development Summary Warner Bros. confirms 'Hogwarts Legacy 2' is in development after the original’s over 40 milion sales.The sequel game anchors WB’s strategy alongside 'Harry Potter', DC, 'Mortal Kombat' and 'Game of Thrones.'Release expected 2027–2028, with previews likely at major gaming events. Warner Bros. has officially confirmed that a sequel to Hogwarts Legacy is in development, following the massive success of the 2022 original game. The first Hogwarts Legacy became a global phenomenon, selling over 40 million copies and outperforming major titles like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 in its launch year.As revealed in Warner Bros. Discovery's Q2 earnings report and shareholder letter, Hogwarts Legacy 2 is a key part of its refocused strategy, which centers on four major franchises: Harry Potter, Game of Thrones, Mortal Kombat and DC. Executives have long hinted at a sequel, with development reportedly coordinated alongside storylines from the upcoming Harry Potter HBO series. Given the original’s billion‑dollar success and enduring fan demand, the sequel is positioned as a cornerstone release for WB Games.While specific plot details, gameplay features and platforms remain unannounced, industry watchers expect the game to expand on the Wizarding World’s open‑world design and narrative depth. With major gaming events like Gamescom 2026 and The Game Awards on the horizon, fans anticipate a first look at the sequel soon, with insiders suggesting a release timeframe of 2027 or 2028. items.title: THE NORTH FACE PURPLE LABEL and JOURNAL STANDARD Unveil Corduroy FW26 Capsule
items.text: THE NORTH FACE PURPLE LABEL and JOURNAL STANDARD Unveil Corduroy FW26 Capsule Summary THE NORTH FACE PURPLE LABEL and JOURNAL STANDARD have unveiled an exclusive capsule for Fall/Winter 2026The release updates the Field Berkeley Jacket and Wide Tapered Field Pants in a modern corduroy constructionBoth pieces are currently available for pre-order ahead of an official September release THE NORTH FACE PURPLE LABEL and JOURNAL STANDARD have officially unveiled their exclusive Cord Field Berkeley Jacket and Cord Wide Tapered Field Pants capsule for Fall/Winter 2026. The collaborative drop between the nanamica-produced outdoor sub-label updates the popular seasonal models in a textured corduroy construction.Designed to bridge natural environments and city life, the capsule focuses on combining a classic corduroy aesthetic with contemporary comfort and ease of wear. items.title: Levi’s Vintage Clothing to Re-Release the Archival 1942 501 Jeans
items.text: Levi’s Vintage Clothing to Re-Release the Archival 1942 501 Jeans Summary Levi's Vintage Clothing is releasing a limited reproduction of its historic 1942 501 JeansThe model captures a brief wartime transition period featuring a buckle back cinch and heavyweight Shrink-to-Fit selvedge denimThe unwashed denim drops August 13 at Levi's Store Kyoto and via lottery on the official web store for 66,000 JPY Levi's® Vintage Clothing has officially announced the limited release of its archival 1942 501® Jeans. Recreated directly from the brand’s historical archives, the reproduction honors an elusive transitional reference produced for only a brief period prior to wartime material rationing simplifications.The 1942 Levi's model serves as a bridge between early heritage elements and updated wartime garment specifications. Built with a thicker "Shrink-to-Fit™" selvedge denim, the design retains labor-intensive pre-war features that were eventually phased out, led by a classic back cinch fitted with a metal buckle.The construction accurately replicates period-correct craftsmanship, incorporating an inverted yoke seam, hidden rivets, single-needle arcuate pocket stitching, and a classic two-horse leather patch. The signature single-sided capital "E" red tab details the back pocket. Each pair is delivered unwashed in its raw state, complete with a reproduction of the original paper flasher and decorative dollar bill insert.The Levi's® Vintage Clothing 1942 501® Jeans will be available in limited quantities at Levi's Store Kyoto starting August 13, alongside a lottery release hosted on the brand's official online store for ¥66,000 JPY. items.title: Seiko Pays Homage to Japan’s First Wristwatch With Two Exquisite Presage Craftmanship Timepieces
items.text: Seiko Pays Homage to Japan’s First Wristwatch With Two Exquisite Presage Craftmanship Timepieces Summary Seiko introduces two Presage Craftsmanship watches honoring the 1913 Laurel - the very Japanese wristwatch.The models feature traditional white Enamel and deep black Urushi lacquer dials.Pre-orders are open now, with deliveries commencing in September. Seiko has unveiled two new Presage Classic Series Craftsmanship timepieces that pay tribute to the 1913 “Laurel”, Japan’s first wristwatch. Designed as a tribute to the brand’s pioneering watchmaking heritage, the new models reinterpret the iconic design through two distinct traditional Japanese decorative arts: hand-applied enamel and centuries-old Urushi lacquer. By fusing traditional artistic heritage with modern horology, these releases serve as a celebration of the origins of Japanese wristwatch design.The first model, the Enamel Laurel Dial, presents a lustrous white enamel face set beneath a dual-curve sapphire crystal. It stays faithful to the 1913 original with vintage-inspired Arabic numerals, a running subdial at 6 o’clock, and the signature red 12 o’clock marker.Complementing it is the Urushi Lacquer Laurel Dial, which features a deep black dial executed using traditional Japanese lacquer techniques, paired with a refined gold-toned case and retro-styled detailing. Both timepieces are fitted with sustainably sourced, Leather Working Group (LWG)-certified black leather straps. Under the hood, both models are powered by Seiko’s in-house Calibre 6R5H automatic movement. Operating with an accuracy rating of +25/-15 seconds per day, the caliber delivers a robust power reserve of around 3 days.The Seiko Presage Classic Series "Craftsmanship" Enamel Laurel and Urushi Lacquer Laurel models will be available for pre-order starting August 13, 2026, via the Seiko Boutique webstore, with official deliveries commencing in September. Prices for the collection range from £1,250 to £1,400 GBP (approx. $1,680 - $1,882 USD). Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Porsche Brings Back the Manual Transmission on the 2027 911 Carrera S
items.text: Porsche Brings Back the Manual Transmission on the 2027 911 Carrera S Summary Porsche announced the 2027 911 Carrera S with a manual transmission as a driver-focused special edition produced exclusively for the North America market.The sports car features a 473-horsepower twin-turbo flat-six engine paired with a six-speed manual gearbox and rear-wheel-drive configuration. The 2027 Porsche 911 Carrera S with MT Package marks the highly anticipated return of a three-pedal setup to the 992.2 generation. Developed specifically to answer immense demand from purists, this new release arrives as a North American exclusive. Global automotive trends continue skewing heavily toward automatic transmissions driven by technological advancements and congested city streets. Porsche bucks that movement entirely. By delivering a manual gearbox specifically for the US and Canada, the Stuttgart manufacturer proves this region remains a critical stronghold for analog driving enthusiasts who prioritize engagement over outright acceleration.Engineers took the minimalist formula established by the 388-horsepower Carrera T and amplified it significantly for this more potent model. Power comes from a 3.0-liter twin-turbo flat-six engine pushing 473 horsepower exclusively to the rear wheels. Drivers engage with that output through a six-speed manual transmission finished with a tactile walnut-crowned shifter. While opting for the stick shift might technically result in slower zero-to-60 times compared to dual-clutch variants, buyers seeking this package care far more about the visceral driving experience. The MT Package also equips the vehicle with a comprehensive suite of dynamic hardware. Standard chassis upgrades include PASM Sport suspension, rear-wheel steering and the aggressive Sport Chrono pack.Visual and structural enhancements separate this exclusive trim from the standard lineup. The exterior boasts a retuned SportDesign front fascia and titanium exhaust tips. Enthusiasts will immediately notice the standard center-lock wheels, marking the first time this motorsport-derived hardware appears on a Carrera S model. A subtle scarlet "S" badge sits on the tail to honor owners who historically modified their own cars with red lettering. Inside the cabin, standard four-way Sport Seats Plus keep occupants secure during spirited driving. Curb weight sits at a respectable 3,327 pounds. items.title: MGM+ Reveals Jon Hamm-Led True-Crime Thriller Series 'American Hostage'
items.text: MGM+ Reveals Jon Hamm-Led True-Crime Thriller Series 'American Hostage' Summary MGM+ has unveiled the official teaser trailer for the upcoming psychological thriller series 'American Hostage'Jon Hamm stars as 1970s radio broadcaster Fred Heckman who becomes entangled in a 63-hour hostage negotiationCo-created by Shawn Ryan and Eileen Myers the eight-episode drama premieres on September 20 MGM+ and Sony Pictures Television have debuted the first official trailer for American Hostage, an upcoming eight-episode psychological thriller series fronted by Jon Hamm. The television adaptation brings the real-life 1970s broadcast standoff to the screen following its origin as a narrative podcast.Hamm reprises his audio role as Fred Heckman, a prominent Indianapolis WIBC news reporter who becomes unexpectedly thrust into a high-stakes 63-hour crisis. The plot centers on hostage-taker Tony Kiritsis, portrayed by Giovanni Ribisi, who dials into Heckman’s live call-in show while holding a victim at gunpoint with a 12-gauge shotgun, demanding an immediate public platform.Co-created and scripted by Mad Dogs duo Shawn Ryan and Eileen Myers, the narrative captures the internal debate within the newsroom before deciding to air the live confrontation. The production features a supporting ensemble including Kristoffer Polaha, William Jackson Harper, Mireille Enos, Jonathan Tucker, and Kat Cunning, with Hamm, Ryan, and Myers also serving as executive producers.American Hostage officially premieres September 20, 2026, on MGM+, running for eight episodes through its finale on November 1. items.title: Rare 1973 Two-Player Computer Space Arcade Machine Hits RR Auction
items.text: Rare 1973 Two-Player Computer Space Arcade Machine Hits RR Auction Summary A rare fully functional 1973 two-player Computer Space arcade cabinet is currently up for sale via RR AuctionOwned by Earthworm Jim programmer David Perry the unit features a sparkly green fiberglass body and original rotational joysticksBidding is live and set to conclude on August 20 with estimates exceeding $20,000 USD Nutting Associates' rare 1973 Two-Player Computer Space Arcade Machine has officially hit the auction block via RR Auction. The vintage arcade cabinet comes directly from the personal collection of game programmer and Gaikai co-founder David Perry.Released in mid-1973 following the 1971 single-player original designed by Syzygy Engineering founders Nolan Bushnell and Ted Dabney, the two-player iteration represents a monumental piece of early video game history prior to the mainstream rise of Atari. Built with a retrofuturistic silhouette wrapped in a sparkly green fiberglass shell, the cabinet features a control panel equipped with a 25-cent quarter slot, a coin return button, a red "Start Game" button, a green "Two Player Operation" button, and two original rotational joysticks topped with red "Fire Missile" buttons.Preserved in working condition with minor body scuffing, the machine includes its original functional screen and interior lighting. The rare cabinet is being offered as part of RR Auction's broader Steve Jobs & the Computer Revolution: The Apple 50th Anniversary Auction Part Two event.The two-player Computer Space arcade machine is currently open for bidding on RR Auction, with the listing set to officially close on August 20, 2026, at 7 PM ET. items.title: How X’s “Under the Hood” Settings Feature Tackles Long-Standing Shadowban Rumors
items.text: How X’s “Under the Hood” Settings Feature Tackles Long-Standing Shadowban Rumors Summary X expanded its open-source GitHub codebase by 10 to 15 times, releasing core ranking mechanics under an Apache v2 license.A new settings feature allows active creators to download JSON files detailing any visibility-limiting account labels applied over the past month. X is pulling back the curtain on its content distribution mechanics with a massive update to its open-source ranking algorithm. The platform expanded the codebase powering its default "For You" timeline and released the files under an Apache v2 license. This latest push increases the available code by 10 to 15 times compared to previous transparency efforts. Engineers and researchers can now access intricate details regarding model configuration, filters and the core ranking systems. These components dictate exactly which parameters weigh different signals to decide what content surfaces on a user screen.Alongside the code dump, the company introduced an "Under the Hood" transparency tool designed to tackle long-standing rumors of shadowbanning. Users who post at least 10 times in a given month can navigate to their app settings and download a JSON file outlining aggregate statistics. This file explicitly reveals if any visibility-limiting labels have hit their account or specific posts over the past calendar month. Non-technical creators can feed this data into a large language model alongside the GitHub repository code to decode exactly how the recommendation engine treats their content.X Vice President of Product Keith Coleman noted that the release provides the core ranking logic that pulls and ranks posts for any given timeline. External researchers have already utilized the release to train and run the Phoenix scoring system locally. While the platform invites developers to submit pull requests to improve the algorithm, certain proprietary safeguards remain locked away. Systems relying on Grok to predict rule violations are deliberately excluded to prevent bad actors from reverse-engineering moderation filters and flooding the feed with spam.This unprecedented level of algorithmic transparency shifts the power dynamic between social media platforms and their user bases. By equipping creators with both the underlying recommendation code and personal account data, X transforms a traditionally opaque tech ecosystem into an inspectable environment. items.title: Heinz Celebrates Personal Condiment Rituals With 3-Setting “Love Lid” Launch
items.text: Heinz Celebrates Personal Condiment Rituals With 3-Setting “Love Lid” Launch Summary Heinz has introduced a limited-edition customizable ketchup cap called the Love Lid that allows users to adjust the amount of sauce dispensed per squeeze/Developed in partnership with Wieden+Kennedy London and Beta Design Office, the patented lid features a rotating dial with Like, Love and Crazy Love settings.The accessory is available as part of a special grilling-season bundle exclusively through online channels in the US and the UK. The Heinz Love Lid arrives as a customizable ketchup cap engineered to give consumers precise authority over their condiment portions. Designed as a direct replacement for the standard closure on any 20-ounce Heinz bottle, the accessory transforms a basic packaging element into an interactive tool. The project was developed in partnership with Beta Design Office and creative agency Wieden+Kennedy London.Functionality sits at the core of the new design. The patented closure utilizes a rotating dial mechanism to cycle through three settings: Like, Love and Crazy Love. Turning the dial raises an internal core that physically widens or narrows the dispensing aperture. Users who select the highest setting receive a generous cascade of ketchup, while the lowest option restricts the flow to a controlled ribbon. Beyond its mechanical precision, the two-part cap is constructed entirely from recyclable polypropylene. This material choice ensures the upgraded component aligns with standard environmental packaging footprints.The naming conventions go beyond simple marketing terminology to reflect authentic consumer behaviors. A dipping scenario for french fries naturally demands a different volume of ketchup compared to dressing a hot dog. By treating these culinary moments as distinct events, the brand brings attention to a frequently overlooked packaging component. Nina Patel, vice president of global Heinz at the Kraft Heinz Company, highlighted that people harbor deeply personal rituals regarding their sauce application. The company aims to celebrate that spectrum of preferences by ensuring fans can achieve the exact condiment ratio their meal requires.This release builds on previous experimental packaging concepts from the brand. Earlier innovations include the Heinz Dipper, a specialized fry box featuring a built-in sauce compartment. Both projects demonstrate a corporate curiosity surrounding functional design that connects directly with consume

items.title: Porsche Reportedly Abandons Plan to Shift Taycan Production to Leipzig
items.text: Porsche Reportedly Abandons Plan to Shift Taycan Production to Leipzig Summary Porsche is reportedly planning to discontinue production of the Taycan by 2030 instead of relocating assembly from Zuffenhausen to Leipzig.Despite earlier statements from CEO Michael Leiters denying short-term cancellations, shifting market demands and the success of the new Macan EV are prompting a strategic pivot. Porsche could be preparing to pull the plug on its inaugural battery-electric pioneer. A new report from German business publication WirtschaftsWoche indicates the automaker plans to end Taycan production entirely by 2030. The decision marks a massive strategic shift for the marque. Executives reportedly abandoned earlier initiatives to transfer the manufacturing of the electric sedan from its current dedicated line in Zuffenhausen to the Leipzig facility.The reversal follows a turbulent financial period for the storied manufacturer. The operating profit plummeted from €5.64 billion to €413 million over the past year. Sales numbers for the electric four-door parallel that steep financial decline. Porsche moved 11,510 units in 2025 compared to 21,302 the year prior. Internal cannibalization plays a distinct role in this downturn. The highly anticipated launch of the Macan EV gave prospective electric vehicle buyers a fresh alternative and aligned perfectly with luxury consumer preferences heavily favoring large SUVs over low-slung sport sedans.Management and the Porsche works council have allegedly reached an agreement in principle to phase out the model line by the end of the decade. While the paperwork remains unfinalized, the internal consensus points toward trimming product complexity. The manufacturer is currently recalibrating its electrification roadmap to recommit resources to proven combustion and hybrid architectures.This rumored expiration date contrasts with recent public messaging from leadership. CEO Michael Leiters recently stated the company had no immediate plans to kill the vehicle. The brand even invested heavily in a refreshed 2027 model featuring simulated manual gear shifts designed to court traditional driving enthusiasts. A six-year runway toward 2030 leaves a wide gap between short-term survival and ultimate discontinuation.Axing the flagship electric vehicle represents a monumental symbolic retreat for a brand that built its modern identity around high-performance electrification. The Taycan set a cultural template for luxury EVs by proving b

items.title: Koenigsegg Debuts Race-Style Sequential Shift System Inside the CCGT1
items.text: Koenigsegg Debuts Race-Style Sequential Shift System Inside the CCGT1 Summary Koenigsegg unveiled the CCGT1 at Monterey Car Week as a track-focused but road-legal hypercar designed to honor the brand's cancelled GT1 racing project from the mid-2000s.Limited to a production run of 70 units that are already sold out, the vehicle features a twin-turbo V-8 producing up to 1600 horsepower and debuts the Koenigsegg Sequential Shift interface. Revealed during the 2026 Monterey Car Week, the Koenigsegg CCGT1 represents a high-performance evolution of the CC850 architecture. The manufacturer built this street-legal model to revive the spirit of its original GT1 competition car. That mid-2000s project paired a lightweight chassis with a naturally aspirated V-8 but was cancelled before competing due to FIA regulation changes. Today, the modern tribute delivers endurance racing characteristics to a homologated platform. All 70 planned units are already sold.Powering the new hypercar is a 5.0-liter twin-turbo V-8 engine that delivers 1280 horsepower on standard pump fuel and 1600 horsepower on E85 biofuel. Engineers equipped the powertrain with a bespoke roof scoop and enhanced cooling systems to handle sustained circuit abuse. The vehicle also debuts the Koenigsegg Sequential Shift system. This interface utilizes a nine-speed Light Speed Transmission paired with a manual clutch pedal for takeoff. Subsequent gears are managed via a race-style sequential shifter positioned near the steering wheel utilizing ignition-cut technology for clutchless operation. Buyers preferring a different feel can option the Engage Shift System to swap the sequential stick for a six-speed gated manual with an automatic mode.Aerodynamics guided the exterior design process. Nearly every body panel is unique to this model to maximize cooling and downforce. The active rear wing automatically adjusts 30 degrees between low drag, air brake and high downforce modes. A redesigned front splitter and a bespoke rear diffuser help generate 1764 pounds of downforce at 155 mph. The exterior introduces a proprietary material called Ghost Fibre. Developed as a crystal-white aramid and carbon matrix, this material boasts ballistic protective characteristics while being lighter and more sound-absorbent than traditional carbon fiber.Buyers looking for peak circuit performance can specify a factory-supported Track Package for the first time in the company's history. This modular upgrade includes a carbon roll

items.title: “Instagzam?” Internet Reacts to Instagram’s Fresh New Text Logo
items.text: “Instagzam?” Internet Reacts to Instagram’s Fresh New Text Logo Summary Instagram replaced its iconic cursive text-logo with a bolder half-cursive, half-print design.The refresh introduces three custom typefaces - Instagram Sans, Instagram Pen and Instagram Mono - for global rollout.Users criticized stylized letters like "g" for looking like "Instagzam," prompting response from Adam Mosseri. Instagram has officially retired the signature cursive wordmark that defined its visual identity for the past decade. Unveiled as the app's first major text-logo update since 2016, the new design introduces a hybrid typographic approach that merges half-cursive flow with structured print lettering. The redesign features bolder strokes and highly stylized curves on specific characters, particularly tweaking the letters "s," "r" and "g." While the iconic multicolored gradient camera icon anchoring user home screens remains firmly in place, the text residing at the top of the app interface has undergone a distinct modernization.The sweeping refresh serves as the foundation for a broader brand identity shift unfolding across Meta’s digital ecosystem. According to the company's design team, the final typographic style emerged after designers explored hundreds of potential directions, ranging from rigid all-caps concepts to literal handwriting samples. Jasmine Probst, Instagram's director of product design, noted that the chosen script reflects individuality while injecting bolder, simpler elements with unexpected touches. To support the overhaul, the brand is introducing three custom typeface families: Instagram Sans, Instagram Pen and Instagram Mono. The signature gradient will also transition to a more restrained application across the user interface as the full design system rolls out globally through 2026.Initial public reception to the overhaul has been notably polarized, proving that even a conservative design evolution generates an immediate cultural stress-test. Countless users and digital design critics have flooded comment sections across social media, pointing out that the updated lettering’s aggressive stylization makes the logo read closer to "Instagzam" than its actual name. Instagram head Adam Mosseri leaned into the controversy, purposefully sharing the announcement to his personal channels to crowdsource hot takes from the community. While purists mourn the loss of the warm and familiar aesthetic, the strategic update fundamentally modernizes the visual pre

items.title: IWC Marks Mercedes-Benz’ 140th Year With a Limited-Edition Big Pilot’s Watch Perpetual Calendar
items.text: IWC Marks Mercedes-Benz’ 140th Year With a Limited-Edition Big Pilot’s Watch Perpetual Calendar Summary IWC marks Mercedes‑Benz’s 140th anniversary with a limited Big Pilot’s Watch Perpetual Calendar ProSet, restricted to 140 pieces.Powered by Calibre 82665, the watch features a forward/backward crown‑set calendar, gold accents and a historic 1926 logo caseback. IWC has unveiled the Big Pilot’s Watch Perpetual Calendar ProSet 140 Years Mercedes‑Benz edition, a limited timepiece created to celebrate the German automaker’s 140th anniversary. The release deepens a rich partnership that began with Mercedes-AMG in 2004 and expanded to the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS Formula One Team in 2013. Capped at a fittingly limited run of just 140 pieces, the commemorative timepiece pays homage to both brands’ shared dedication to engineering, high performance and pioneering design.Housed in a brushed and polished 42mm stainless steel case measuring 14mm in thickness, the watch pairs a matte black dial with solid gold appliqués and gold-plated hands. The layout features four subdials displaying the date, day, month, and a four-digit year, along with IWC’s signature Double Moon® phase display at 12 o’clock, which requires a one-day correction only once every 1,040 years.Flipped over, the sapphire-glass case back reveals the historic 1926 logo that marked the initial merger between Daimler Motoren-Gesellschaft and Benz & Cie., combining the iconic three-pointed star with Benz's classic laurel wreath. The piece comes fitted on a black rubber strap equipped with IWC's tool-free EasX-CHANGE® system.At the heart of the timepiece is the IWC-manufactured 82665 caliber, which introduces the brand's groundbreaking Perpetual Calendar ProSet module. Protected by four patents, this revolutionary gear-driven mechanism allows the perpetual calendar to be adjusted both forward and backward using a single position of the crown — eliminating the need for extra pushers or complicated setting menus. Crafted using microscopic LIGA lithography technology, the movement also features a silicon hairspring, a nickel-phosphorus escapement, and a ceramic-reinforced Pellaton automatic winding system that delivers a 60-hour power reserve.The Big Pilot’s Watch Perpetual Calendar ProSet 140 Years Mercedes‑Benz edition is now available for inquiry via IWC's official website and boutiques. items.title: Xbox Unveils 'Gears of War: E-Day' Limited Edition Controllers
items.text: Xbox Unveils 'Gears of War: E-Day' Limited Edition Controllers Summary Xbox is celebrating the upcoming release of 'Gears of War: E-Day' with two new limited edition controllersThe lineup includes a textured emergence hole design and a customizable Design Lab option featuring Luke Preece's artBoth accessories will be showcased at Gamescom on August 25 ahead of their respective fall launches Xbox has officially announced the launch of two new limited-edition controllers arriving alongside the highly anticipated console exclusive, Gears of War: E-Day. Designed to commemorate the return of the iconic franchise, the collection offers fans immersive hardware inspired by the game’s gritty atmosphere.Leading the announcement is a 3D-molded, laser-etched standard Xbox controller, which takes visual cues from the franchise's infamous emergence holes. The design features cracked asphalt textures, transparent red elements on the D-pad and face buttons, and matching red triggers. To complete the setup, an accompanying 8BitDo charging dock is also available, designed to power the peripheral during downtime.The second option is a specialized Xbox Design Lab gamepad, set to launch on September 30. This version features exclusive Lancer artwork by heavy metal illustrator Luke Preece, offering a sleek, graphic-forward aesthetic. While the Design Lab edition allows for further customization of triggers and buttons, it trades the 3D-molded asphalt texture of the standard version for a clean, bespoke canvas. Both controllers are scheduled to be displayed at Gamescom on August 25.The 3D-molded Gears of War: E-Day controller is available for pre-order now, with the Design Lab version following on September 30 and the game title launching October 6, 2026. items.text: New Balance Formally Unveils the Made in USA 2040v5 Summary New Balance has officially announced the revival of its high-end 2040 series with the Made in USA 2040v5The premium silhouette features nubuck construction full-length carbon fiber plates and multi-era cushioningThe sneaker drops in North America on August 20 for $400 USD followed by a global release in May 2027 Name: New Balance Made in USA 2040v5Colorway: Castlerock/Mood Indigo-BlacktopSKU: U2040509MSRP: $400 USDRelease Date: August 20, 2026Where to Buy: New BalanceNew Balance has officially unveiled the New Balance Made in USA 2040v5, resurrecting one of the most premium performance-oriented lineages in its American-made catalog. The fifth iteration of the 2040 series—which originally debuted in 2012—positions itself at the peak of the brand's luxury offerings.Constructed around craftsmanship and high-spec utility, the 2040v5 bridges technical running technology with luxury lifestyle execution. The upper is built with premium nubuck paneling, providing a refined tactile feel across the silhouette. Underfoot, the shoe is equipped with a full-length carbon fiber plate for enhanced stability and propulsion.To deliver optimal energy return and shock absorption, New Balance combines cushioning systems across multiple eras of its running archive. The midsole unit integrates FuelCell foam alongside ABZORB SBS and ENCAP technologies, delivering a multi-layered platform designed for high-level comfort. Rather than targeting fleeting footwear trends, the silhouette serves as a dedicated showcase of domestic manufacturing and material quality.The New Balance Made in USA 2040v5 officially releases in North America on August 20, 2026, for $400 USD via New Balance and select retailers, with a broader global launch scheduled for May 2027. Descente has officially unveiled its flagship "Mizusawa Down" Fall/Winter 2026 collection, introducing a refined evolution of its iconic outerwear lineup. Crafted at the brand's newly rebuilt Mizusawa factory, the seasonal delivery updates classic models with modernized shell fabrics, reworked functional details, and enhanced practical utility designed to withstand harsh winter conditions.Retaining the signature non-quilted thermal bonding and seam-taped waterproofing that made the series famous, the FW26 range continues to merge minimalist urban style with extreme weather performance. The lineup is led by Descente’s timeless core models alongside seasonal additions. Key styles include the flagship "MOUNTAINEER" and its relaxed "Oversized MOUNTAINEER" variant, featuring the proprietary Parahood system and dual-zip ventilation. The versatile "ANCHOR" down jacket, "ANCHOR-HC" coat, and "SHUTTLE-L" also return with updated materializations and streamlined fits. items.text: Teaser for 'American Horror Story: 13' Reassembles Iconic Cast for Crossover Season Summary FX has dropped the official teaser trailer for 'American Horror Story' Season 13 confirming the return of franchise staplesShowrunner Ryan Murphy describes the new 13-part series as an Avengers-style crossover spanning previous fan-favorite seasonsThe show premieres September 24 on FX and Hulu featuring 13 half-hour episodes airing through October 29 FX has officially lifted the curtain on American Horror Story: 13, releasing a teaser trailer that sets the stage for an unprecedented crossover season. The upcoming installment marks the long-awaited return of series icon Jessica Lange alongside an ensemble of returning fan favorites.The newly released teaser highlights returning legends across the anthology’s history, including Jessica Lange as Constance Langdon (Murder House), Evan Peters as Kai Anderson (Cult) and Rubber Man, as well as Sarah Paulson, Angela Bassett, and Emma Roberts reprising their respective roles as Cordelia Goode, Marie Laveau, and Madison Montgomery from Coven. Co-creator Ryan Murphy teased that the season will function as an "Avengers"-level crossover combining worlds from Murder House, Asylum, Coven, Freak Show, and Cult, with several actors portraying multiple legacy characters within the same scene.The official cast roster features Kathy Bates, Billie Lourd, Gabourey Sidibe, Leslie Grossman, Joey Pollari, John Carroll Lynch, Mena Suvari, Jamie Brewer, John Waters, Madelaine Petsch, and Tig Notaro. Formatted as 13 half-hour episodes, the broadcast schedule kicks off with three episodes on premiere night, followed by three more in week two, before transitioning to weekly double-episode drops leading up to the finale.American Horror Story: 13 officially premieres Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 9 p.m. ET on FX and Hulu. items.text: Olaolu Slawn Unveils "The Slawn x Rolex Multiverse" 12-Piece Custom Watch Collection Summary British-Nigerian artist Olaolu Slawn has revealed a custom 12-piece Rolex collection co-designed alongside global cultural iconsThe project features one-of-one timepieces created with figures across rap football art and fashion with two mystery collaborators remainingEach watch will release individually throughout August following the project website launch on August 18 Olaolu Slawn has officially announced "The Slawn x Rolex Multiverse," a project consisting of 12 one-of-one custom Rolex timepieces co-designed alongside cultural leaders from sports, music, art, and fashion. First reported by Will Lavin, the collection expands on the British-Nigerian artist’s previous hand-painted watch releases with an array of unique collaborative designs.The 11 confirmed co-creators span a broad cross-section of global street culture and fine art. The roster includes footballers Ronaldinho and Mario Balotelli, rap heavyweights Gunna and Lil Yachty, Corteiz founder Clint419, Fuckthepopulation founder Zac FTP, Japanese graphic designer VERDY, visual artist and photographer Gabriel Moses, artist Cedric Christie, nightlife operator David Grutman, and Nigerian skate collective Motherlan. Two mystery collaborator slots remain unrevealed within the 12-piece lineup.Revealed via a lo-fi webcam-style video teaser, each timepiece in the capsule features a distinct bespoke aesthetic, ensuring no two models share a design. The drop builds upon Slawn’s 2024 hand-painted Rolex DateJust "Berlin" series, which sold out in four minutes and currently commands high market resale values."The Slawn x Rolex Multiverse" project website officially goes live on August 18, 2026, with the 12 one-of-one timepieces releasing individually at separate points throughout August. While preserving the familiar cursive aesthetic, the new iteration incorporates redrawn letterforms designed to deliver a cleaner, more refined overall shape.Speaking on the redesign, Mosseri emphasized the balance between modern evolution and brand heritage. "The wordmark at the top of the app hasn’t changed in 10 years, so it was time for a refresh. Cleaner and more modern, with references to the original and the simplicity and craft that’s always made it,” shared Adam Mosseri, Head of Instagram on his post. Take a look below. items.title: Inside Tololo Ugarte's Vaulted "Spyglass" Residence in Limache
items.text: Inside Tololo Ugarte's Vaulted "Spyglass" Residence in Limache Situated in Limache within the Valparaíso Region of Chile, Catalejo House is a striking architectural project designed by the studio Tololo Ugarte. The micro-house is nestled within a monumental landscape defined by an oasis of ancient quillayes and molles trees, some of which are over 300 years old. Designed to emerge organically from its context, the residence sits on an extension of highly fertile soil that is exceptionally sensitive to seasonal shifts. During the summer months, the surroundings take on a stark, desert-like appearance, while winter and spring bring forth dense, irregular vegetation that creates the illusion of the house floating amidst nature.Conceived as a "spyglass" micro-house, Catalejo functions as an architectural experiment that blurs the boundaries between the indoors and the majestic outdoors. A defining feature of the structure is its prominent circular, vaulted roof crafted from a combination of steel and wood, which facilitates a spacious, double-height interior. This distinct geometry establishes a direct spatial connection with the exterior environment, fostering a sense of continuity. By leveraging the unique attributes of the site, the interior layout transforms the surrounding landscape into living art, where each window acts as a dynamic frame capturing a new, ever-changing view of the ancient trees.The materiality and construction of the Catalejo house are deeply rooted in a philosophy of environmental integration and respect. Tololo Ugarte specifically selected materials intended to generate a mimesis with the surrounding landscape, allowing the built structure to seamlessly fuse with its natural context. This intentional camouflage serves to minimize the visual footprint of the architecture, ensuring that the monumental trees remain the focal point of the site. Ultimately, the residence proposes a new way of inhabiting spaces by inviting deep reflection on the relationship between humanity and nature, offering a continuous, evolving dialogue with the Chilean landscape. items.title: Dr. Margarita Lila Rosa Only Wants the Art World’s "Non-Commercial Realness"
items.text: Dr. Margarita Lila Rosa Only Wants the Art World’s "Non-Commercial Realness" Summary 'State of Art' is a new HypeArt series inviting artists, curators, collectors and other leading voices to weigh in on the ideas, debates and cultural shifts shaping contemporary art. Through intimate questions and personal recommendations, the series offers a closer look at what is exciting the art world, what needs to change and where things may be heading next. Dr. Margarita Lila Rosa approaches contemporary art as both a historian and an active participant in the cultural conversations shaping it. Based in Harlem, the public scholar, independent curator and art critic specializes in Afro-Latinx, Latinx and Black Atlantic history, tracing the ways migration, memory, identity and diasporic experience continue to reverberate through contemporary art.That perspective also makes Rosa less interested in simply following what the art world has deemed important. She looks for the works and exhibitions that linger emotionally, challenge familiar narratives or offer new ways of understanding the present. Sometimes that means finding surreal beauty in Bony Ramirez’s sculptural world, and other times it means wandering through the Venice Biennale with a dead phone and unexpectedly finding comfort in the recorded apologies of complete strangers.For the latest installment of Hypeart’s State of Art, Rosa reflects on the art that has stayed with her in 2026, from Ramirez’s El Cielo Del Mar to the late Koyo Kouoh’s Venice Biennale. She talks about why the latter felt less like an exhibition than a “praise dance,” calls for more poetry and less noise in contemporary art and explains why she’s giving the art world an A+ despite the increasingly difficult world surrounding it.What’s the one show from the first half of this year that you can't stop thinking about?Bony Ramirez’s "El Cielo Del Mar" still has a grip on me. It was an installation of large-scale sculptural works at the Historic Chapel of Green-Wood Cemetery in Brooklyn, curated by the incredible Anne-Laure Saives and scored by Elvin Tavarez. My mind is both puzzled and reassembled by Ramirez’s sculptural practice–his modular wooden pieces, often geometric or circular, are meant to mimic the simple wooden slabs that countryside houses are made of. Designed in collaboration with creative studio PlayLab Inc., the 806-square-foot space at 3300 W Sunset Blvd in Silverlake serves as a dedicated basecamp for the full RCOS line alongside RCI footwear.Tracing back to late 2021, Reese Cooper began developing a specialized outdoor line alongside his main REESE COOPER® runway collections. Built on ten years of Americana and outdoor design heritage, the label focuses on functional garments engineered to transition from rugged trail environments directly to everyday wear. After launching RCOS under the RCI umbrella in late 2024 and delivering four initial capsule collections through early 2025, Cooper assumed full control over production and development to maintain strict craft standards.The product assortment available at the retail outpost features durable garments engineered for harsh environments. items.title: Islam Makhachev Secures 17th Consecutive UFC Win Over Ian Machado Garry at UFC 330
items.text: Islam Makhachev Secures 17th Consecutive UFC Win Over Ian Machado Garry at UFC 330 Summary Islam Makhachev extended his historic winning streak to 17 consecutive fights at UFC 330 in PhiladelphiaThe pound-for-pound leader defeated Ian Machado Garry via unanimous decision with scores of 49-46 49-46 and 48-47Makhachev officially broke Anderson Silva's 13-year-old record for the longest win streak in UFC history UFC hosted UFC 330 at the Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, delivering a 12-bout fight card highlighted by two successful title defenses. The main event saw welterweight champion Islam Makhachev defend his belt against challenger Ian Machado Garry via unanimous decision. The 170-pound main event saw Makhachev earn official judges' scores of 49-46, 49-46, and 48-47 to secure his 17th consecutive Octagon victory.Despite facing heavy opposition and striking pressure on the feet from Machado Garry, Makhachev turned the tide in the second round with a brutal head kick that stunned the Irishman. The champion maintained authority across the remaining rounds to lock up his first official welterweight title defense.The five-round contest saw the Dagestani champion utilize relentless wrestling alongside opportunistic striking against his taller Irish opponent. In the second round, Makhachev gained crucial momentum by landing a heavy head kick knockdown that floored Garry. Despite surrendering seven total takedowns throughout the night, Garry fought well off the cage wall, enjoying his best momentum in the third round by stuffing takedown attempts and responding with heavy body kicks and head kick combinations before landing short shots in the clinch during the fourth.Makhachev executed a clinical fifth-round strategy to lock up the decision win. Shooting into Garry’s legs within the opening 90 seconds of the final frame, the champion dragged his opponent back to the mat and secured a body triangle from back control to dominate the remaining minutes.With the victory, the 34-year-old fighter officially surpassed middleweight legend Anderson Silva’s 16-fight winning streak, a record that stood untouched for over 13 years. The victory marks Makhachev’s first successful defense of the welterweight championship following his initial title win at UFC 322.The card featured additional major storylines across the lineup, including women's strawweight champion Mackenzie Dern defending her title via unanimous decision against Gillian Robertson. items.text: World Cup Winner Ferran Torres Is Officially Signing With Paris Saint-Germain Summary Paris Saint-Germain has officially completed the signing of Spanish forward Ferran Torres from BarcelonaThe total transfer package is valued at approximately €50 million EUR as Torres reunites with manager Luis EnriqueTorres arrives in Paris following Spain's World Cup victory where he scored the winning goal in extra time Paris Saint-Germain has officially completed the signing of World Cup winner Ferran Torres from FC Barcelona. The deal brings the 26-year-old Spanish forward to the reigning European champions for a total package of around €50 million EUR ($57.84 million USD).The move sees Torres reunite with PSG head coach Luis Enrique, who previously managed the forward during his tenure with the Spanish national team. Capable of playing across the front line and primarily utilized as a central striker over the past two seasons, Torres joins the club directly following his winning goal performance in extra time against Argentina in the World Cup final.Ferran Torres now joins Paris Saint-Germain ahead of the new season as the club prepares to defend its European title. items.title: Marvel Studios Reveals Next-Gen Mutant Cast for 'X-Men' Reboot at D23
items.text: Marvel Studios Reveals Next-Gen Mutant Cast for 'X-Men' Reboot at D23 Summary Marvel Studios officially revealed the new ensemble cast for its upcoming 'X-Men' reboot at the D23 ExpoSadie Sink Kit Connor Samara Weaving Christopher Abbott and Adam Driver star in the team-up featureDirected by Jake Schreier the film is scheduled to release in theaters following 2027's Avengers Secret Wars This post may contain spoilers for Spider-Man: Brand New Day.Marvel Studios has officially unveiled the core cast for its upcoming X-Men reboot on stage at Disney's D23 Expo. The grand presentation confirmed the new generation of actors stepping into the iconic mutant roles under the direction of Thunderbolts* filmmaker Jake Schreier.The official roster introduces Sadie Sink reprising her role as telepath Jean Grey following her debut in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, alongside Kit Connor as Cyclops, Samara Weaving as Emma Frost, Christopher Abbott as Professor Charles Xavier, Maya Boyd as Storm, and Inde Navarrette as Rogue. Rounding out the lineup, Adam Driver appeared via video message to confirm his casting as the villainous Mr. Sinister, initially teasing the audience as Magneto before revealing his true character name, Nathaniel Milbury.According to Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige, the ensemble met in person for the first time backstage before stepping out at D23. Grounded in comic lore, the narrative focuses on the awakening of the X-gene during puberty and Professor Xavier's mission to establish his School for Gifted Youngsters to protect and train young mutants against societal persecution.Marvel Studios' X-Men will officially release in theaters on May 5, 2028 following the debut of 2027's Avengers: Secret Wars. items.title: Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom Unleashes Sentinels in Explosive New 'Avengers: Doomsday' Trailer
items.text: Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom Unleashes Sentinels in Explosive New 'Avengers: Doomsday' Trailer Summary Marvel Studios unveiled the second trailer for 'Avengers: Doomsday' at Disney’s D23 fan conventionThe two-minute teaser showcases Robert Downey Jr.’s Doctor Doom going head-to-head with Thor and Mister FantasticThe ensemble film brings together the Avengers the Fantastic Four the Thunderbolts and classic X-Men stars Marvel Studios has officially debuted the second trailer for Avengers: Doomsday during Disney’s D23 fan convention, revealing a deeper look at the villainous return of Robert Downey Jr. The fresh look expands on the scale of the upcoming MCU crossover event.Introduced onstage by leads Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, and Hayley Atwell, the footage opens with Sue Storm (Vanessa Kirby) warning Earth’s heroes while detailed shots showcase Doom's villainous costume. The clip quickly escalates into a tense confrontation between Reed Richards (Pedro Pascal) and Doctor Doom among rubble, followed by Thor (Chris Hemsworth) promising that the villain will be begging for hell. As Thor strikes with his axe, Stormbreaker, Doom effortlessly blocks the weapon, repels the Asgardian with a beam of green energy, and raises a collection of classic X-Men Sentinels, declaring, “Hell answers to me, for I am Doom.”The high-octane sequence sets the stage for a massive cinematic crossover uniting the Avengers, the Fantastic Four, and the Thunderbolts against Doom's force. Beyond the core MCU lineup, the trailer highlights the official MCU integration of several legacy Fox X-Men stars, including Patrick Stewart as Professor Charles Xavier, Ian McKellen as Magneto, James Marsden as Cyclops, Kelsey Grammer as Beast, Rebecca Romijn as Mystique, Alan Cumming as Nightcrawler, and Channing Tatum as Gambit.Avengers: Doomsday officially arrives in theaters on December 18. items.title: Khakis Is for People Who Take Their Old Clothes Very Seriously
items.text: Khakis Is for People Who Take Their Old Clothes Very Seriously Am I the only one who can’t get enough of Khakis? The vintage-obsessed clothing brand from JKND Co. Ltd., the same Seoul-based creative group that brought us thisisneverthat, has been on a tear for a few seasons now. Beyond making some of the best washed and naturally aged military- and workwear-inspired garbs around, Khakis has racked up a string of banger collaborations with Merrell, New Balance, Reebok, and even nonnative. Its Seoul flagship has also quietly become a destination of its own, hosting several pop-ups with everyone, one of Japan’s latest understated, yet increasingly influential, fashion brands.For Fall/Winter 2026, Khakis is sticking with what got it here in the first place, once again digging through decades of military, workwear, and outdoor references to create clothes that feel convincingly pulled from another era. Rather than reinventing the wheel, the brand continues to obsess over the details — the right fit, the right fabrication, and, perhaps most importantly, the right amount of wear.I had the chance to speak with Creative Director Junhyung Seo during a trip to Seoul last fall, when he described Khakis as the adult version of thisisneverthat. It makes a lot of sense, considering Seo previously served as a designer at the latter. Where thisisneverthat leans into a more youthful street-meets-punk-meets-skate aesthetic, Khakis is for the shoppers who geek out over period-specific apparel. Maybe it’s your favorite style of polar fleece from decades ago, only in the color you always wished it came in. Or maybe it’s a red quilted down jacket that looks like something pulled from the catalog of a classic outdoor brand years ago.That’s ultimately what makes Khakis special. The brand has an affinity for not only getting the reference just right, but also nailing the fit, fabrication, and natural wear that made the original worth obsessing over in the first place.It’s an approach baked into the brand’s “Made to Last” and “Dead Gear” philosophies — “dead” in the sense of “deadstock.” In other words, if you want clothes that look like something you could’ve spent years hunting down at a thrift store, but didn’t because, one, it probably wouldn’t come in your size, or, two, you’d rather not deal with the pains of upkeep and extensive cleaning, you’ve found the right place. Expect deliveries from Khakis’ Fall/Winter 2026 collection to begin arriving at the brand’s online store, Seo

items.title: Supreme Just Turned Its Box Logo Archive Into a Leather Jacket
items.text: Supreme Just Turned Its Box Logo Archive Into a Leather Jacket Ask any normie on the street what signals the end of summer, and they’ll probably point to earlier sunsets or a change in temperature. But for those who wake up each morning thanking the fashion gods before throwing on their archival garbs and limited-edition sneakers, there’s a much clearer sign: Supreme’s seasonal Fall/Winter teaser.Sure, summer is (almost) over, and soon enough, so are drinks on terraces with the homies. But fret not. At least there’s already a grail-worthy piece of outerwear to look forward to as temperatures begin to drop.For Fall/Winter 2026, Supreme has teased what might be its most peak Box Logo design yet: a patchwork leather jacket stitched together from what appears to be Box Logos spanning the brand’s history. Among the designs worked into the jacket are some particularly recognizable iterations, including the Bandana, Skull Pile, Arabic, and even the Last Supper Box Logos.It’s essentially a wearable history lesson in one of streetwear’s most recognizable graphics, piecing together decades of Supreme lore into a single leather jacket.As with every Supreme seasonal teaser, there’s no official launch date just yet. items.text: Artist Philip Gefaell Crafts Custom 18K Gold Ash Charizard Ring for Pokémon's 30th Anniversary Summary Artist Philip Gefaell has unveiled the custom 18K gold Ash Charizard Ring to commemorate the 30th anniversary of PokémonCommissioned by a prominent Pokémon card collector the one-of-one high jewelry piece is set with natural VVS diamonds across 18K white and rose goldThe bespoke ring arrives alongside a custom-built presentation box featuring dedicated Pokémon motifs and Poké Ball references Artist Philip Gefaell has unveiled the custom Ash Charizard Ring, a bespoke piece of high jewelry commissioned to celebrate 30 years of Pokémon. Created for one of the franchise's leading card resellers and collectors, the custom ring transforms the bond between Ash Ketchum and Charizard into an intricate wearable sculpture.The structure of the ring is crafted from 18K white gold featuring a soft sunblasted matte finish, establishing an industrial, futuristic texture. Sculpted in highly polished 18K rose gold, Charizard wraps around a central "A" emblem—referencing Ash Ketchum—appearing to break out from the architectural frame of the piece. The body of the ring is set with natural VVS diamonds and features a digitized, slightly distressed geometric pattern that continues the visual language Gefaell developed for a previous Poké Ball Pendant commission.Completing the project, Gefaell created a custom presentation box designed specifically as an extension of the artwork. Built using a specialized Pokémon-inspired design language, the packaging incorporates Charizard motifs and a Poké Ball reference to turn the unboxing moment into an integral part of the experience. items.text: Grand Seiko Links Hawaii and Japan With an Ultra-Limited Honolulu Exclusive Summary Grand Seiko drops the 50-piece SBGA527 exclusively at Ben Bridge Honolulu.The 40mm High-Intensity Titanium 62GS watch features an ocean-inspired deep blue dial.Powered by the Spring Drive Caliber 9R65, priced at $7,600 USD Grand Seiko has introduced the SBGA527 Spring Drive Limited Edition, created exclusively for Ben Bridge Jeweler’s two Honolulu boutiques. The timepiece draws poetic inspiration from the Pacific Ocean, celebrating the "Goodwill Beach City Relationship" established between the white-sand shores of Shirarahama in Wakayama, Japan and Waikiki in Honolulu, Hawaii.Its deep blue dial reflects the clarity of Shirarahama’s coastal waters, detailed with hand-applied diamond-cut markers and faceted hands that play with incoming light. Styled after the iconic 1967 62GS design, the 40mm case and matching bracelet are crafted from lightweight, scratch-resistant High-Intensity Titanium and finished with distortion-free Zaratsu polishing.Underneath a box-shaped sapphire crystal, the timepiece is powered by Grand Seiko's in-house Spring Drive Caliber 9R65. The automatic movement offers a 72-hour power reserve, 100 meters of water resistance, and an average accuracy of ±15 seconds per month. Its signature seconds hand glides continuously across the dial, capturing the uninterrupted flow of time and the natural rhythm of ocean tides. Limited to just 50 pieces, the Honolulu-exclusive Grand Seiko SBGA527 retails for $7,600 USD and is available only at Ben Bridge’s Ala Moana Center and Kalakaua Avenue Grand Seiko Boutiques in Honolulu. items.text: Everything Dropping at Palace This Week Summary Palace Skateboards’ third delivery for Fall 2026 is led by an Ebbets Field Flannels collaboration spanning outerwear, jerseys and headwear.Palace's own "Highway to Heaven" moto jacket, "Pray For Us" hoodie, "Plaice" knit sweater and "Supplex" shell cap fill out the drop.The collaborative lineup is fronted by New York Cubans and Sankei Atoms coach jackets alongside polymesh V-necks and wool ballcaps. Continuing its weekly seasonal rollout, Palace Skateboards returns with its third delivery for its Fall 2026 collection, anchored by a major collaboration with heritage sportswear manufacturer Ebbets Field Flannels alongside a distinct selection of mainline apparel. The mainline drop leans heavily into biker-inspired racing graphics and religious iconography. Headlining the core offering is the "Highway to Heaven" jacket and matching long-sleeve jersey - available in black and pink colorways - featuring padded moto-style paneling, "24:7 POWER" lettering, and praying Virgin Mary line graphics. The theme continues with the "Pray For Us" hoodie with neon wire-style embroidery, while the "Plaice" knit sweater and matching mesh trucker cap feature a clever Palace-branded spin on the traditional Ichthys emblem. Lightweight headwear options, such as the oval-logo Supplex Shell Cap, round out the mainline assortment.Complementing the core delivery, the Palace x Ebbets Field Flannels capsule honors the archive graphics of two historic baseball franchises: the Negro League’s New York Cubans and Japan's historic Sankei Atoms. The accompanying campaign by Cuban-American photographer David Cabrera is shot on location in New York City, capturing Palace pro skater Shawn Powers alongside a cast of local NYC personalities to ground the historic baseball theme in authentic street culture.The actual collaborative lineup is led by jersey-lined nylon coach jackets outfitted with snap closures, drawstrings, and authentic team patches. Key pieces for the New York Cubans lineup include a grey wool ballcap with an interlocked "NY" monogram, a heavy fleece hoodie, and a polymesh V-neck jersey. Meanwhile, the Sankei Atoms collection showcases iconic Astro Boy graphics across bright blue and red mesh V-necks, graphic hoodies, cut-and-sew tees, and two-tone wool ballcaps. Palace Skateboards’ Fall 2026 Drop 3 and the Ebbets Field Flannels capsule will release through a staggered global rollout. The drop begins online and in-store on August 21,

While the two vehicles share a carbon-fiber monocoque, the street-legal version features entirely bespoke bodywork and replaces aggressive fixed wings with an integrated active rear aero system.Under the rear clamshell sits a 4.2-liter Cosworth V-12 producing 680 horsepower and 368 pound-feet of torque. The mid-mounted powerplant utilizes titanium valves, titanium connecting rods and silicon carbide-coated lightweight pistons to safely achieve a staggering 12,100-rpm redline. Engineers tuned the motor to deliver 80 percent of its peak torque at just 2,500 rpm for improved everyday drivability. Buyers receive a six-speed manual transmission as the sole gearbox option, complete with straighter cable routing to enhance shift feel. The engine bay also visually honors its 1990s predecessor by incorporating a polished Inconel exhaust setup surrounded by a 24-carat gold-plated heat shield.To transform the hardcore platform into a capable touring machine, the engineering team increased the ride height by 10 millimeters and softened the suspension setup to maximize mechanical grip. The exterior design incorporates traditional dihedral doors equipped with standard roll-down glass rather than the fixed Lexan windows found on the LM variant. It rides on a staggered wheel setup featuring 19-inch front and 21-inch rear alloys wrapped in Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 tires, with stopping power provided by cross-drilled Brembo brakes.Inside the cabin, the signature three-seat central driving position remains intact but gains thicker seat padding, enhanced sound insulation and a specially designed lightweight audio system. Founder Gordon Murray stated the special projects division exists to execute unique commissions that deviate from the rigid engineering formulas of the standard product lineup. items.text: PayPal Stock Fluctuates as Takeover Talks With Stripe Intensify Summary Stripe and Advent International are reportedly negotiating a multibillion-dollar acquisition of PayPal after an initial $53 billion USD offer was rejected.The proposed 50/50 joint venture aims to keep PayPal's operations intact rather than breaking up the enterprise. Acquiring PayPal and Venmo would give Stripe a consumer network processing $3.7 trillion USD annually, reducing reliance on major card networks. Stripe is reportedly collaborating with private equity investor Advent International to pursue a multibillion-dollar acquisition of PayPal. The ongoing discussions follow an initial $60.50 USD per share offer submitted in July. That preliminary proposal valued the legacy payment platform at approximately $53 billion USD, an amount the board ultimately rejected as inadequate. Current negotiations involve a potentially higher price per share to secure the historic merger. If the two parties reach an agreement, an official announcement could arrive in the coming weeks.Before the initial buyout proposal surfaced, PayPal was trading at historic lows with a market valuation hovering around $40 billion USD . This figure represents a staggering drop of roughly $320 billion USD from the peak valuation the platform achieved during the height of the global pandemic. Under the proposed joint ownership structure, Stripe and Advent would hold equal stakes in the acquired entity. The buyers reportedly intend to keep current operations intact rather than breaking the massive enterprise apart.The potential takeover arrives during a transitional period for the veteran payment system. Enrique Lores assumed the role of chief executive officer in March and immediately began attempting to orchestrate a strategic turnaround. Lores divided the sprawling corporation into three distinct units focusing on checkout processes, the Venmo mobile application and consumer cryptocurrency features. How this newly minted corporate structure would adapt to a massive acquisition remains unclear.Merging these two financial heavyweights would rapidly shift the global fintech landscape. The consolidated organization would stand as one of the largest payment processors on the planet by managing an estimated $3.7 trillion USD in yearly transaction volume.
