items.title: Aston Martin Unveils the 838-HP Valen as Its Most Powerful Front-Engined Supercar
items.text: Aston Martin Unveils the 838-HP Valen as Its Most Powerful Front-Engined Supercar Summary Aston Martin revealed the Valen at Monterey Car Week as a limited-production track-focused evolution of the Vanquish featuring a bespoke carbon fiber body and an 838-horsepower V-12 engine.Production is restricted to 150 units globally with a starting price of $2 million USD and the design replaces a traditional rear window with a camera-based view system. Aston Martin utilized its Q bespoke division to develop the Valen as the brand's most powerful front-engined production car in its 113-year history. The vehicle made its global debut at Monterey Car Week and showcases a radical departure from the typically classy grand tourer aesthetic. Under the sculpted hood sits a highly tuned version of the company's 5.2-liter twin-turbo V-12 engine. The powerplant delivers 838 horsepower and 738 pound-feet of torque. Aston Martin engineers paired this massive output with an eight-speed ZF automatic transmission featuring shift programming derived directly from the Vantage GT4 race car. The combination allows the supercar to accelerate from zero to 60 mph in exactly 3.0 seconds before reaching an electronically limited top speed of 214 mph.To manage the immense power the engineering team stripped 243 pounds from the standard Vanquish platform. Standard 21-inch magnesium wheels reduce unsprung mass and come wrapped in bespoke staggered Pirelli P Zero R rubber with ultra-wide 325-series tires in the rear. These tires incorporate Pirelli Cyber Tyre technology to share real-time friction data directly with the onboard dynamic control systems. A specialized titanium quad exhaust system dominates the rear architecture. Two tailpipes are mounted high on the fascia while two lower valved outlets integrate into the diffuser. The bespoke setup runs 50 percent louder than previous models and produces a high-frequency howl tuned to sound like mid-engine hypercar organ pipes.Exterior styling favors extreme aerodynamics over understated luxury. The front end sports a massive carbon fiber splitter and furrowed slim headlights. A solid tailgate replaces the rear window entirely and requires a digital camera system for rearward visibility. The quad exhaust consumes substantial space in the small trunk compartment so the manufacturer offers bespoke luggage. items.title: SpaceX Finalizes $60 Billion USD Acquisition of AI Coding Startup Cursor
items.text: SpaceX Finalizes $60 Billion USD Acquisition of AI Coding Startup Cursor Summary AI coding platform Cursor officially joined SpaceX following the final closing of a $60 billion USD deal.The merger grants Cursor access to SpaceX's Colossus GPU cluster to scale next-gen code generation models.Automated coding tools will optimize flight software for Falcon 9, Starship and Starlink network routing. AI coding startup Cursor has officially joined SpaceX following the final closing of a $60 billion USD acquisition deal originally announced in April 2026. Company representatives confirmed that the merger is now effective and moving forward after the aerospace manufacturer transitioned into a public company in June. This newly finalized transaction allows the development team to leverage unparalleled computing infrastructure to scale machine learning intelligence and create more capable code generation models for enterprise customers.The acquisition significantly expands the portfolio of SpaceXAI, a specialized division formed after absorbing Elon Musk's previous artificial intelligence venture xAI earlier this year. Leadership noted that the partnership has already yielded tangible technological results across multiple fronts. They pointed to the Wednesday release of Grok 4.6 as an early example of how the combined companies will integrate advanced large language models directly into mission-critical development workflows.Joining the SpaceX corporate ecosystem grants the coding platform immediate access to the largest fleet of GPUs on the planet. The Colossus computing network remains so expansive that the parent company rents out surplus capacity to major industry players like Anthropic and Google. Massive investments into high-performance cloud processing arrive as the data center operations navigate ongoing regulatory scrutiny and environmental litigation related to the gas turbines powering these hardware clusters.Internal integration plans reveal that automated software architecture will immediately optimize workflow tasks across various engineering divisions. Specialized machine learning tools are set to accelerate code generation for flight computers operating on Falcon 9 and Starship vehicles. Engineers will also deploy the technology to automate real-time network management for Starlink internet routing and streamline backend database systems across the broader hardware ecosystem. items.text: ChatGPT Eliminates Workspace Tab-Switching With Live Google Cloud Sync Summary ChatGPT now integrates with Google Drive, allowing paid subscribers to connect and directly edit cloud files.Users can generate custom multiple-choice tests with built-in hints and question navigation.Natural language prompts now allow users to join waitlists and book dining reservations natively. items.title: Leaks Reveal WhatsApp Is Testing Customizable Emoji Reaction Trays for iOS
items.text: Leaks Reveal WhatsApp Is Testing Customizable Emoji Reaction Trays for iOS Summary TestFlight builds reveal WhatsApp is developing customizable default reaction trays for iOS users.Reports indicate custom reactions will join premium perks like custom themes and expanded pinned chats.Backend updates on both iOS and Android signal an active pre-testing development phase. WhatsApp is building a new way for users to personalize their daily message reactions on iOS. New code references discovered in the latest WhatsApp TestFlight build reveal an active development phase for a default reactions setting. The messaging platform currently restricts its quick-reaction tray to a rigid set of six basic emojis. This future interface update will finally allow users to swap out any of those standard icons for their preferred choices directly from the full mobile keyboard.The current default lineup includes the thumbs up, red heart, face with tears of joy, surprised face, crying face and folded hands. While these icons cover the most common responses, the static selection often feels limiting for users who maintain vastly different communication styles across personal group chats and professional networks. Currently, accessing a different emoji requires tapping a secondary plus button and scrolling through the complete library or recent tabs. The upcoming modification will let individuals build a fully custom array tailored to their specific digital tone. Users will also maintain a dedicated toggle to instantly restore the original factory preset tray at any point.Personalized digital expression will likely come with a premium price tag. Independent findings from WABetaInfo indicate that the custom reaction capabilities will roll out as an exclusive feature tied to the emerging WhatsApp Plus subscription tier. The platform is aggressively expanding its monetary incentives to attract paying users. This customizable reaction tray is slated to join a broader package of planned subscription perks that reportedly includes unique visual app themes, premium sticker packs, custom home screen icons and the ability to pin up to twenty active conversations.Engineers have not yet enabled the expanded emoji options for current public beta testers. The iOS discovery follows the quiet integration of similar backend code references into the WhatsApp beta for Android last month. items.title: D.S. & Durga Bottles the Nostalgic Magic of 2000s New York Romance With “Ain’t That Sweet”
items.text: D.S. & Durga Bottles the Nostalgic Magic of 2000s New York Romance With “Ain’t That Sweet” Cult-favorite Brooklyn fragrance house D.S. & Durga is stepping into uncharted olfactive territory. Founded in 2008 by self-taught perfumer and musician David (D.S.) Seth Moltz and architect-turned-creative director Kavi (Durga) Moltz, the brand has built a global following by transforming unconventional ideas into rich, narrative-driven perfumes. Now, the duo is tackling a notoriously polarizing scent category with its newly unveiled "Ain’t That Sweet" — an amber fragrance billed as the ultimate gourmand for people who don’t usually wear gourmands.Inspired by the optimism of young love and the magnetic pull of NYC in the early 2000s, the scent bottles the energy of late-night romance and the annual migration of dreamers arriving in the city to find their purpose. The fragrance paints an intimate picture of a note left between lovers alongside a slice of dark, malty date cake and a glass of golden milk waiting on a kitchen counter for a midnight return. Built on top notes of myrrh and Sri Lankan cinnamon, the scent moves through a heart of date, praline and lily before drying down into a warm, grounded base of condensed milk, bourbon vanilla and nutmeg.True to D.S. & Durga’s ethos, the new release is treated as a multifaceted work of art. David, who views perfume and music as intertwined invisible art forms, composed an original "party soul" track specifically to score the campaign, while Kavi spearheaded a bold new packaging design utilizing the brand's signature "peach concrete" hue.Gourmands can often be polarizing or overly sugary, but you’ve described "Ain’t That Sweet" as a gourmand for people who don’t usually wear gourmands. How did you balance notes like date cake and golden milk to keep it sophisticated rather than overly sweet?David Moltz: I balanced the decadent date cake fumes with materials that are grounding and perfumey — musk, patchouli, real vanilla absolute. Sweet but not too sweet.The scent is rooted in early 2000s New York and the DIY Brooklyn scene. What specific memories or cultural moments from that era were you trying to bottle with this release?David: Well, we are rooted in that scene for sure! "Ain't That Sweet" recalls young romance in the city (now and then). The possibility of finding love. The early stages of courtship. The note left behind before texting all day was a thing. items.title: 8BitDo Launches the Retro-Inspired FlipPad G Classic Edition in Europe
items.text: 8BitDo Launches the Retro-Inspired FlipPad G Classic Edition in Europe Summary 8BitDo FlipPad G Classic Edition launches in Europe after CES 2026 preview.Retro‑inspired design features burgundy buttons, D‑pad, and full shoulder controls.Lightweight 31.5g controller, USB‑C hinge, priced at €29.99 EUR / £24.99 GBP. Following its initial preview at CES 2026, 8BitDo is officially bringing the FlipPad – G Classic Edition to European markets. Designed to transform everyday smartphones into dedicated retro handheld consoles, the ultra-compact mobile controller blends nostalgic design with modern clip-on functionality.Paying homage to classic handheld gaming heritage, the G Classic Edition features a light grey shell accented by signature burgundy face buttons, a black directional D-pad, and grey Start and Select buttons. The controller also incorporates four top-facing shoulder controls (L1, L2, R1, R2) alongside dedicated function keys, giving mobile gamers full tactical control in a pocket-sized form factor.Engineered for maximum portability and broad device integration, the FlipPad weighs a lightweight 31.5 grams. It connects directly via a USB-C hinge mechanism, offering seamless compatibility with devices running Apple iOS 26.2 and above as well as Android 13.0 and above.An accessible hardware upgrade for retro emulation and mobile gaming enthusiasts alike, the 8BitDo FlipPad – G Classic Edition retails for just under €29.99 EUR in the EU and £24.99 GBP in the UK. For more information, head over to 8BitDo's official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Awake NY and Jordan Brand Flip Bootleg Culture for AJ6 Collaboration
items.text: Awake NY and Jordan Brand Flip Bootleg Culture for AJ6 Collaboration Summary Awake NY x Air Jordan 6 celebrates AJ6’s 35th anniversary with bootleg-inspired luxury.The capsule collection features highlights such as Saffiano leather and nubuck sneakers, a matching tracksuit, and other ready-to-wear apparel.Releasing on August 24 via the brand, with raffle entry on August 23. To celebrate the 35th anniversary of the Air Jordan 6, Jordan Brand and Awake NY have joined forces for their third collaborative release, exploring street-level luxury through a distinctly New York lens.Inspired by founder Angelo Baque’s early memories of New York bootleg culture, the project subverts traditional notions of high fashion by leaning into design choices that evoke street market knockoffs — such as exaggerated color blocking, modified branding and raw, unconventional stitching. However, this bootleg illusion is counterbalanced by high-end craftsmanship, executed using premium Saffiano, Midnight Navy and Light Blue leathers paired with Game Royal nubuck, Sail accents, and vibrant Infrared 23 detailing. Signature AJ6 elements like the lace pocket, dual toggles, and visible Nike Air heel cushioning remain intact, subtly crowned by Awake NY's motif.Extending beyond footwear, the joint release features a full apparel capsule engineered to match the sneaker's bold aesthetic. Key ready-to-wear pieces include a co-branded tracksuit, an elevated polo shirt, and a range of everyday street staples. An online EQL raffle for the Awake NY x Air Jordan 6 sneaker opens on August 23, 2026. The full capsule will officially release on August 24, 2026, dropping online via Awake NY as well as in-store at its NYC location. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Kith Follows Up Chapter IV Collection With Two One-of-One BMW X5 Builds
items.text: Kith Follows Up Chapter IV Collection With Two One-of-One BMW X5 Builds Following closely on the heels of Ronnie Fieg’s milestone 15th-anniversary restoration project and the reveal of the extensive Chapter IV apparel and accessories collection, Kith and BMW have officially unveiled the automotive centerpieces of their latest reunion. For the fourth chapter of their ongoing partnership, the duo presents a conceptual bridge between the German automaker’s past and present, celebrating the legacy of its first-ever Sports Activity Vehicle through two bespoke, one-of-one builds: a meticulously restored 2000 BMW X5 E53 and an all-new 2027 BMW X5. The two models showcase Fieg's distinctive design lens applied across distinct eras of BMW's engineering lineage.Looking back, Fieg and BMW spent over a year executing a comprehensive rotisserie restoration of the first-generation 2000 BMW X5 E53. Finished in its original Titanium Silver Metallic, this bespoke model hides a massive powertrain conversion beneath its hood, featuring a custom-integrated 5.0-liter S85 V10 engine paired with a six-speed manual transmission. While retaining the factory all-wheel-drive system, the performance is drastically enhanced by a custom exhaust system, BMW M Sport brakes, and a recalibrated suspension. Inside, the fully customized cabin is draped in black leather with all-over Kith monogram embossing, complete with collaborative branding integrated seamlessly into the instrument cluster.At the opposite end of the timeline, the 2027 BMW X5 by Kith introduces the model’s fifth generation and marks the first entirely new X5 body design to debut in more than eight years. Emphasizing a minimalist, monolithic aesthetic, the vehicle features uninterrupted exterior surfaces devoid of seals and door handles, complemented by double-X headlights and an illuminated kidney grille. Operating on an updated inline six-cylinder B58 engine paired with a 48V mild hybrid system, the contemporary SAV pays homage to its predecessor with an exclusive Frozen Titanium Silver paint finish. The cabin mirrors the vintage build's luxury with monogram-embossed black leather, K&K Crest embroidery, BMW M Carbon Sport front seats, and a panoramic skyroof.The bespoke vehicles arrive as part of the Kith for BMW 2026 collection, which is currently available via Kith's webstore, app and flagships. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: McLaren Teams Up with Central Saint Martins in One-Of-A-Kind Fashion Collaboration
items.text: McLaren Teams Up with Central Saint Martins in One-Of-A-Kind Fashion Collaboration McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team is delving deeper into the world of fashion through a new collaboration with Central Saint Martins, University of the Arts London. The creative project, which kicked off earlier this year, saw the team task a cohort of MA Fashion students to reinterpret its 63-year heritage in a collection of runway looks. By turning the spotlight to the next generation of designers, seamstresses, and material technicians, it aims to look beyond streetwear and high-fashion drops typical in motorsport culture today to explore how racing history can serve as a source of inspiration in classrooms. For the starting point of the process, McLaren hosted a series of talks and presentations at the London university while its partner DELL Technologies gave them the tools, such as the XPS laptop, to bring ideas to life. The students went on to develop concepts around the team’s cutting-edge engineering in Formula 1 as well as the distinct aesthetics of uniforms worn by James Hunt and Ayrton Senna, with each of the 12 looks coming together to provide a statement of McLaren’s countless contributions to the sport. “Formula 1 is influencing culture in ways we've never seen before,” shared McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team Chief Marketing Officer, Louise McEwen, in an official statement. “Designed to Race explores that cultural influence through the eyes of the next generation of creative talent, who resolutely mirror our high-performance culture and commitment to detail. Working with Central Saint Martins has brought to life the connections between fashion and racing, allowing us to see our history reinterpreted in fresh and unexpected ways.”Meanwhile, Fabio Piras, Course Leader for MA Fashion at Central Saint Martins, said, “At Central Saint Martins, we believe the most valuable learning happens when students are challenged to apply their creativity in real-world contexts. This collaboration gave our students the opportunity to work with one of the most powerful brands in global sport, and one that has led the way in working with partners to design wearable, inclusive collections that have connected fans with the team over a number of years.” The collection is set to be revealed ahead of London Fashion Week at McLaren Technology Centre in Woking, UK. items.text: PLEASURES Explores “Somewhere In Between” for Fall 2026 Summary PLEASURES launches its Fall 2026 collection, blending familiar subcultural elements with raw, modern layering pieces.The campaign, shot on location in Hong Kong, takes on a photojournal-like style.Available now via the brand, the collection features textured outerwear, tactile knitwear, relaxed denim and signature graphic apparel. PLEASURES' Fall 2026 collection, titled “Somewhere In Between,” is conceptually centered around the tension between the familiar and the unknown. The lineup spans outerwear, knitwear, denim, headwear, and graphic-driven pieces, blending textures and patterns into silhouettes that feel both raw and understated. Designed for versatility in shifting climates, the collection is grounded in muted neutrals and darker tones, encouraging natural layering throughout the season.Photographed across Hong Kong, the accompanying lookbook adopts a photojournal-style approach, following models dressed in the collection in authentic everyday settings — from bustling neighborhood streets and local markets to quiet transitional moments. This visual narrative reinforces the brand’s ethos of embedding fashion within lived experience, presenting garments not as staged objects but as part of real urban life.The PLEASURES Fall 2026 collection is currently available to shop via the brand's website and select global retailers. Shot in Cornwall by Paul Hempstead, the features looks emphasizes durability and heritage.This season, Noah continues to refine timeless staples and silhouettes through elevated material choices — sourcing traditional wool cloths directly from England, Ireland and Scotland, alongside authentic yarns engineered to yield enduring, heirloom-quality sweaters.The assortment spans structured tailoring, heavy knitwear, classic sportswear and rugged daily pants. items.title: C2H4®’s Fall Delivery for 2026 Blends Modern Utility and Retro Nostalgia
items.text: C2H4®’s Fall Delivery for 2026 Blends Modern Utility and Retro Nostalgia Summary C2H4® unveils its fall delivery of its 012 collection, extending the brand’s annual release system with mid-century-inspired silhouettes.Key pieces include the Engineer Jacket, Textured Henley, Half-Zip Pullover and Padded Vest.Releasing today via the brand's website, priced $90 – $1,450 USD. Los Angeles and Shanghai-based menswear label C2H4® has officially unveiled its fall delivery of its annual 2026 012 Collection. Expanding upon the brand’s year-round design philosophy, the release continues C2H4®'s shift away from traditional seasonal calendars in favor of a single, continuous annual collection. This seasonal delivery builds on the collection's initial June debut, translating mid-century interior design principles into contemporary menswear that emphasizes refined proportions, long-term durability and the organic intimacy formed between a garment and its wearer over time.Drawn from the aesthetics of 1950s and 1960s interior architecture and furniture design, the collection achieves a subtle balance between retro nostalgia and modern urban utility. Commenting on the collection’s core vision, founder and designer Yixi Chen notes: “Timeless design is at the core of our brand, which can be seen throughout our 012 Collection. Drawing inspiration from interior design of the 1950s and 1960s alongside the influence of Los Angeles, the collection reflects an ongoing process of aesthetic refinement. Through a balance of silhouettes, materials, colors, and details, the styles transcend seasons and can be worn for years to come."Key styles spotlighted for the drop include the Mechanic Washed Engineer Jacket, Moccasin Memory Textured Henley, Uptown Memory Half-Zip Pullover, and the Lake Tahoe Cabin Gentle Padded Vest. Each piece embodies the brand’s philosophy of harmonizing design logic with humanistic values, offering garments that evolve naturally with time rather than remaining pristine.Ranging $90 USD for basic essential tops up to $1,450 USD for technical, heavy-duty outerwear, the comprehensive line caters to versatile daily styling. The C2H4® 2026 Collection fall drop officially launches globally on today at 9 a.m. PST. The entire offering is available to shop directly through the official C2H4® webstore. items.title: Is a Remaster of ‘The Simpsons: Hit & Run’ in the Making?
items.text: Is a Remaster of ‘The Simpsons: Hit & Run’ in the Making? Summary The Simpsons creator Matt Groening let slip at D23 that The Simpsons: Hit & Run is "coming back in some form."The 2003 cult-classic open-world adventure remains unavailable on current platforms, making a remaster or port highly requested by fans. More than two decades after its initial release, The Simpsons: Hit & Run might finally receive the revival fans have been demanding. During a dedicated panel at D23, series creator Matt Groening dropped a massive hint regarding the future of the beloved 2003 title. When asked about a potential sequel or remaster, Groening stated that the original game is "coming back in some form." The comment immediately sparked excitement across the gaming community.The spontaneous announcement did not go unchecked. Current showrunner Matt Selman quickly jumped into the conversation to add a skeptical "or not" to the end of the statement. The tense body language and rapid correction suggested that Groening accidentally revealed a tightly guarded secret before the publisher was ready to make an official announcement. Fans immediately dissected the exchange, viewing the awkward back-and-forth as soft confirmation of an unannounced project currently in development.Radical Entertainment originally developed the open-world adventure in close collaboration with the animated television show cast and writers. The studio crafted a distinct GTA style experience where players control different members of the family as they investigate a strange alien plot sweeping across Springfield. Launching on the PlayStation 2, Xbox and GameCube, the title earned a massive cult following thanks to spot-on voice acting and chaotic driving mechanics. Fans consider it a high watermark for licensed video games.Despite immense lasting popularity, the classic Springfield adventure remains completely inaccessible on modern hardware. The game is entirely absent from the PlayStation Plus classics catalog and missing from the extensive Xbox backward compatibility program. Players currently have to rely on physical retro discs or PC emulation to revisit the iconic streets. A direct port or a full high-definition remaster would easily solve this preservation issue. Developers would not even need to record new audio, as the original vocal performances remain perfectly intact.Disney has yet to provide formal release details or clarify the situation following the slip-up on stage. items.title: Porsche Fits Green Hell Race Livery to the 911 GT3 100 Jahre Nürburgring
items.text: Porsche Fits Green Hell Race Livery to the 911 GT3 100 Jahre Nürburgring Summary Porsche introduced the limited edition 911 GT3 "100 Jahre Nürburgring" to commemorate the upcoming centenary of the legendary German race circuit.Restricted to 100 units exclusively for the German market, the model highlights a "Green Hell" aesthetic complete with protective green film and gold center-lock wheels. Porsche unveiled the 911 GT3 100 Jahre Nürburgring at the Porsche Sixt Carrera Cup Deutschland to celebrate the upcoming 100th anniversary of the legendary circuit. The sports car manufacturer is restricting production to just 100 units strictly for the German market. The highly exclusive model serves as a rolling tribute to the 20.8-kilometer Nordschleife where the brand has rigorously tested its production vehicles for decades. The deep historic tie to the track underscores why the automaker dedicated a specific model to the milestone.Customers can order the commemorative Porsche 911 GT3 in either White or GT Silver Metallic. Both paint options come accented by green protective film sections on the nose and rear bumper. The contrasting color treatment directly references the early markings used by factory race teams to distinguish their cars on the track. The Green Hell theme continues with green mirror housings and matching wing endplates. The vehicle rolls on California Gold center-lock wheels while sporting historic Nürburgring emblems and white recovery point arrows. Buyers can customize the doors and hood with a race number ranging from 0 to 999 rendered in a typeface inspired by trackside graffiti.The motorsport motif carries heavily into the cabin. Opening the doors reveals illuminated sills reading "Welcome to the Green Hell" in bright white lettering. A green rear roll cage dominates the space behind the lightweight sports bucket seats. The driver seat features a green backing layer visible through graduated perforations alongside an embroidered track outline on the headrest. Drivers can select between a seven-speed PDK transmission or a six-speed manual gearbox topped with a walnut shift knob borrowed from the Carrera T.Those looking to maximize performance can add an optional Manthey Kit. The color-matched upgrade package introduces revised suspension geometry and aggressive aerodynamic components that produce 1,190 pounds of downforce at 177 mph. items.title: Rocket Lab Expands Footprint to Six Global Pads With New Alaska "GHOST" Complex
items.text: Rocket Lab Expands Footprint to Six Global Pads With New Alaska "GHOST" Complex Summary Rocket Lab unveiled GHOST, a deployable launch system packing rockets, ground support, and range control into standard shipping containers.Debuting at Alaska's Pacific Spaceport Complex with two pads, GHOST expands Rocket Lab's footprint to six global launch pads. Rocket Lab has unveiled a new full-suite launch infrastructure system called GHOST that can be transported, deployed and operated virtually anywhere on the planet. By packing ground support, range control and the rockets themselves into standard shipping containers, the aerospace company aims to bypass current spaceport bottlenecks. The system is specifically engineered to support the brand's Electron orbital rocket and its HASTE hypersonic test vehicle.The modular technology will make its operational debut in 2027 at the Pacific Spaceport Complex in Kodiak, Alaska. Designated as Rocket Lab Launch Complex 4, the site will feature two pads dedicated to high-frequency campaigns. This expansion brings the company's total footprint to six operational pads across two hemispheres, complementing existing infrastructure in New Zealand and Virginia. The Alaska deployment serves a massive $266 million multi-launch agreement with the U.S. Space Force covering 12 suborbital missions with an option to add six more.Beyond simply increasing launch cadence, the Global Hypersonic & Orbital Spaceport Technology offers strategic redundancy for military operations. Recent global conflicts have heavily depleted American missile reserves, sparking a surge in Department of Defense demand for high-speed hardware testing. The current domestic space infrastructure faces severe strain from record-breaking orbital activity. By allowing mobile launch pads to be set up rapidly in undisclosed locations, the new platform provides a failsafe against potential attacks on fixed spaceports during future orbital conflicts.Company founder and CEO Sir Peter Beck highlighted the platform's strategic value for national security. He noted that creating a deployable system packages proven reliability into a flexible format capable of serving vital programs globally. The overarching flat-pack approach to spaceports addresses the massive launch capability crunch while cementing the brand's position as a dominant force in the responsive orbital logistics sector. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Junha Kahm Reimagines Flat-Pack Seating With a Chair That Fits in a Shopping Basket
items.text: Junha Kahm Reimagines Flat-Pack Seating With a Chair That Fits in a Shopping Basket Summary Junha Kahm introduces the Facade chair, featuring a permanent stainless steel frame and eight interchangeable PETG panels.Designed for easy logistics, the entire seating system breaks down into components small enough to fit inside a standard shopping basket. South Korean industrial designer Junha Kahm introduces a highly flexible seating solution that rethinks how furniture ages with its owner. The Facade modular chair prioritizes longevity through repairable components rather than simply focusing on material sourcing. Its distinct system separates the object into two fundamental elements. A brushed stainless steel tube frame acts as the permanent foundation while eight semi-rigid PETG panels attach via straightforward bolts and threaded inserts.This approach directly mirrors industrial architecture. The metal framework functions as a core structure while the outer panels serve as replaceable exterior cladding. Users can effortlessly swap out individual sections if they become damaged or if a space requires a completely different aesthetic. Translucent panel options allow the underlying metal to remain visible. Opaque versions dramatically shift the mood of the piece. A warm amber orange configuration channels relaxed terrace seating, whereas crisp white panels deliver a minimal studio look.Engineering details push the concept beyond a superficial visual exercise. The core utilizes a strict one-to-two proportion ratio that provides distinct visual discipline. Each of the eight panels shares identical symmetry, meaning the top and bottom components mirror each other exactly across both the seat and backrest. This deliberate standardization significantly reduces manufacturing complexity and ensures replacement parts remain genuinely accessible over time.Precision dictates the structural connections holding the silhouette together. White PETG rounded elbow joints sit at the frame intersections to provide a visual softness that directly contrasts the rigid brushed metal. The rear legs feature a strict 14-degree splay supplemented by slight three-degree and eight-degree variations at other connection points. These calculated angles grant the silhouette a subtle forward lean that feels highly intentional rather than rigid.Practicality remains at the forefront of the user experience. items.title: Lamborghini Packs GT3-Derived Traction Control Into the Revuelto SV
items.text: Lamborghini Packs GT3-Derived Traction Control Into the Revuelto SV Summary Lamborghini debuted the 1,050-horsepower Revuelto SV at Monterey Car Week.It features active cooling overhauls, GT3-derived traction control, and carbon aero.Production is strictly limited to 1,963 units honoring Lamborghini's founding year. Lamborghini has officially unveiled the Revuelto SV during Monterey Car Week. The Italian automaker's flagship V-12 hybrid powertrain receives a massive power increase for the Super Veloce variant, jumping to 1,050 horsepower and 1,051 lb-ft of torque. This performance boost stems from a more energy-dense 7.3 kWh battery pack that provides an extra 190 kW to the electric motors. The resulting metrics are staggering, with the wedge-shaped supercar clearing 62 mph in a claimed 2.4 seconds and 124 mph in 6.7 seconds before topping out beyond 214 mph. Production is strictly capped at 1,963 units to honor the founding year of the brand.Harnessing that much electrical power presents a unique engineering hurdle. Revuelto product line director Alessandro Farmerschi identified temperature management as the primary developmental challenge. Early track prototypes suffered from power de-rating due to excessive heat build-up within the hybrid system. To resolve this without compromising the aggressive design, engineers constantly repositioned the radiators and reshaped the fenders. The team completely overhauled the aerodynamics by replacing the active rear wing with a massive fixed carbon fiber component and incorporating enlarged side air inlets to force cold air into the engine bay.The intense focus on heat dissipation heavily influenced the chassis upgrades. Lamborghini equipped the Revuelto SV with a Brembo-derived CCM-R Plus braking system constructed from long carbon fibers pressed into a uniform rotor surface. When paired with new adjustable passive dampers and bespoke Bridgestone Potenza Race R tires, the braking setup achieves a reported 23 percent improvement in cooling efficiency and drops disc temperatures by 12 percent.Consistent repeatability separates a true track weapon from a standard street vehicle. To give drivers total command over the extreme mechanical grip, the automaker introduced a Pilota driving mode and an exclusive 6D sensor borrowed from the Urus Performante SE. items.title: BYD Opens Milan Design Studio to Spearhead European Luxury Expansion for Denza
items.text: BYD Opens Milan Design Studio to Spearhead European Luxury Expansion for Denza Summary BYD opened a dedicated Milan studio led by Wolfgang Egger to craft Denza models tailored specifically for European luxury buyers.The studio doubles as a bespoke commissioning boutique, leveraging local material suppliers for sustainable, high-end cabin finishes. BYD is officially bringing the fight to Europe's luxury heavyweights. The Chinese automotive giant has established a dedicated studio for its premium Denza brand at its European headquarters in Milan. Spearheading the initiative is design chief Wolfgang Egger, an industry veteran whose resume includes pivotal stints at Alfa Romeo, Audi and Lamborghini. The primary mission of the new Italian hub is to capture local tastes and translate them into a design language capable of challenging established titans like Porsche and BMW on their home turf.Denza faces a demanding challenge to break the deep brand loyalty European buyers traditionally hold for regional marques. The company plans to disrupt the market by leaning heavily on striking aesthetics and boundary-pushing automotive technology. The marque recently introduced the Z9 GT, a highly anticipated shooting brake positioned to rival the Porsche Panamera. This grand tourer boasts a unique tank-turning functionality and will soon be joined by the ultra-premium Z electric sports car. Denza is also bringing the rugged Bao 5 SUV to the continent. Beyond visual appeal, the automaker differentiates itself through advanced engineering like the trick magnetorheological suspension found in the tri-motor U9. Egger believes that designing these progressive vehicles directly in the market they intend to dominate will give the automaker a crucial competitive edge.Selecting Milan as the operational base was a highly strategic move for the global brand. The city serves as a premier global fashion capital, allowing the automotive design team to forge relationships with tier-one material suppliers and top-tier luxury houses. Egger highlighted that the team will explore innovative, sustainable materials for future cabins. The current Z9 already features repurposed bamboo door cards, signaling a clear shift toward eco-conscious luxury. By immersing themselves in the Italian design ecosystem, the crew aims to secure premium leather alongside advanced recycled composites.The Milan headquarters will also play a critical role in elevating the overall consumer experience. items.title: REVERSIBLE Is Making Designer Shopping Smarter With Its "Luxury, For Less" Campaign
items.text: REVERSIBLE Is Making Designer Shopping Smarter With Its "Luxury, For Less" Campaign Anyone who has ever opened fifteen browser tabs to track down one pair of designer sneakers at the right price, in the right size, from a retailer that actually ships to their country, knows the problem. REVERSIBLE, the fashion discovery and shopping platform, was built to collapse that process into a single screen. The platform aggregates real-time inventory, pricing and availability from over 500 retail partners worldwide, and its current "Luxury, For Less" campaign sharpens that proposition further by spotlighting exclusive markdowns across some of fashion's most coveted labels.One Platform, Hundreds of RetailersOnline designer shopping has a visibility problem. The same coveted piece can appear at wildly different price points depending on which retailer, boutique or resale marketplace lists it, and most shoppers never see the full picture. REVERSIBLE was built to close that gap. The platform aggregates real-time inventory, pricing, shipping details, return policies and active promotions from authorized retailers and selected boutiques worldwide, currently spanning over 500 partners and more than one million styles from labels like Balenciaga, sacai, Rick Owens, Gucci and Guidi. Rather than functioning as another storefront, REVERSIBLE operates as a discovery layer that sits on top of the existing retail landscape, pulling everything into one searchable, comparable view.Price Comparison That Actually WorksREVERSIBLE's core utility is its multi-retailer price comparison. On any product page, shoppers can see every available listing for a given item, broken down by retailer, size and price. A pair of Miu Miu Gymnasium sneakers, for example, might sit at $494 USD from one shop and $1,100 USD from another depending on size and stock. A Loewe cotton cargo trouser listed across nine retailers will display each store's pricing and inventory in a single scroll. The platform also tracks price history over selectable windows of one month, three months, six months, one year or all time, charted against the original retail price. If a piece that retailed at $1,650 USD is now listed at $495 USD after weeks near $900 USD, that trajectory is immediately visible, turning what would otherwise be an impulse buy into an informed decision.Sizing, Stock and Alerts Across Every ListingBeyond price, REVERSIBLE surfaces sizing and availability data from every connected retailer on one page. items.title: LEGARE Debuts With a Double-Balance Titanium Watch
items.text: LEGARE Debuts With a Double-Balance Titanium Watch Summary LEGARE debuts with the Chapter 1 AGP Inverted watch.Reimagines a 1932 double-balance pocket watch mechanism by Albert-Gustave Piguet.Features a 37.5mm titanium case; limited to 50 pieces at around $110,000 USD. LEGARE has officially launched its debut creation: the Chapter 1 AGP Inverted, a watch that reimagines Albert‑Gustave Piguet’s 1932 double‑balance pocket watch. Founded by Wei Koh and Guillaume Tetu, the Neuchâtel‑based brand positions itself as a “horological archaeologist,” reviving forgotten ideas and imagining how they might have evolved into contemporary watchmaking.The Chapter 1 AGP Inverted pays tribute to Piguet’s intellectual curiosity while establishing LEGARE’s mission to explore lost possibilities in mechanical timekeeping. Housed in a Grade 5 titanium case measuring a compact 37.5mm in diameter and 9.95mm thick, the watch features an open, inverted movement layout that brings its twin regulating organs directly to the dial side.Two independent balance wheels beat at 21,600 vibrations per hour, connected by a mechanical differential that continuously averages their rates to transmit a single output to the flame-blued hands. To maintain sleek proportions, the caliber utilizes side-angled lever escapements typically reserved for tourbillon construction. Its open architectural design is framed by a sapphire minutes ring and displays intricate finishing throughout, including hand-grained surfaces, mirror-polished bevels and perlage.Offered in two distinct executions, the LEGARE Chapter 1 AGP Inverted watch is limited to just 25 individually numbered pieces each. The "Elegant" edition showcases untreated German silver with Côtes de Genève paired with a hand-stitched gray Alcantara strap, while the "Darth" edition presents a dark monochromatic look crafted from frosted, black rhodium-plated brass paired with a blue Cordura fabric strap.Powered by the manual-wind Caliber LC1-AGP01 with a 50-hour power reserve, each version is priced at $146,100 SGD (approx. $110,000 USD) and produced through a specialized network of Swiss manufacturing partners located within 100 kilometers of Neuchâtel. For more details, visit LEGARE's official website. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Yung Lean Is Opening 'Collected Works 2016–2026,' His First Major Art Exhibition
items.text: Yung Lean Is Opening 'Collected Works 2016–2026,' His First Major Art Exhibition Summary Jonatan Leandoer Håstad AKA Yung Lean will unveil his first major art show, 'Collected Works 2016–2026,' next monthThe exhibition is on from September 25 through October 11 at Torsgatan 22 in Stockholm, SwedenOn view will be paintings, drawings, sculptures, installations, and a new short film created over the last decade, many of which being shown for the first time Jonatan Leandoer Håstad, better known as Yung Lean, is ready to show you his art.The Swedish rapper and artist is officially entering the art game and bringing it home for his first major exhibition, Collected Works 2016–2026, next month with a collection of artworks he’s been quietly making for the last decade.Håstad’s been making wooden sculptures, paintings, and drawings since he was a kid, he says, but it wasn't until recently he decided to bring it into the public eye. The move follows his live painting installation at Thibaut Grevet’s TTGT Studio during Paris Fashion Week with adidas Originals, alongside a tease of the project via a wheatpaste poster and a studio shot on Instagram.The upcoming exhibition will take over Stockholm’s Torsgatan 22 from September 25 through October 11, and will feature paintings, collages, works on paper, sculpture, dioramas, and site-specific installations. After the showcase, a curated selection of works, namely sculptures, will go under the hammer in an international online auction with Bukowskis.Inside the industrial ex-Gasworks, the works will take shape in a series of immersive environments: a salon, television room, and screening room, with large-scale installations and sculptural seating interspersed throughout.There’s also a new film. Executive produced by and starring Håstad, the short follows two lovers moving through a dreamlike landscape set along the back roads of Sweden. Perhaps a primer for Romain Gavras’ Sacrifice, which he acts in, set to hit Netflix soon.“Ever since I can remember I dreamed of colors,” the artist expressed. “Just like my songs, the work is made through stream of consciousness. I go where the hand takes me. My paintings mean nothing and also everything. Here they are.”Stay tuned for more information. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: Mercedes-Benz’s C-Class Gets an EV-Inspired Facelift for 2027 Summary Mercedes-Benz refreshed the gas-powered 2027 C-Class with an illuminated six-point grille and star-shaped LED headlights.The cabin adds MB.OS with AI assistance, Dolby Atmos sound, and returns physical steering wheel controls.Featuring a 255-hp turbocharged inline-four with 48-volt assistance, the sedan arrives in US showrooms in early 2027. Mercedes-Benz is blurring the visual lines between its internal combustion and electric lineups with a comprehensive refresh for the 2027 C-Class. While the brand recently introduced an entirely new electric variant, this latest update focuses on the traditional gas-powered sedan. The strategic facelift brings the ICE model closer in aesthetic alignment with its battery-powered siblings while remaining a distinct entity. The move signals a transitionary period for the German automaker as it navigates a split market by unifying its design language across multiple powertrains.The most dramatic shifts occur at the front of the vehicle. An illuminated six-point grille now dominates the fascia and heavily mirrors the bright face introduced on the GLC EV last year. Star-shaped LED headlights have trickled down to become standard fare even on base models. Buyers can further enhance the exterior with newly available wheel designs and fresh paint color options. The rear maintains a familiar profile but integrates triangular lighting elements into the taillights to complete the modernized aesthetic.Inside the cabin, the updated C-Class intentionally avoids the massive Superscreen layout found in fully electric counterparts. The interior retains a more conventional iPad-like central touchscreen and standard digital gauge cluster. This restrained layout now houses the latest MB.OS architecture to enable over-the-air updates and a highly responsive AI-backed MBUX Virtual Assistant. Physical interactions receive a welcome upgrade as tactile controls return to the steering wheel for essential functions like adaptive cruise control and volume adjustments. Audiophiles can also spec a 15-speaker Burmester 3D surround sound system equipped with Dolby Atmos.Under the hood, the United States market will receive the M254 Evo engine as standard. The hardware also sports a 6.31-inch OLED display and a 50-megapixel main camera. Customers can choose from multiple colorways, including Cobalt Blue, which honors ethical mining efforts in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Construction relies heavily on fair-trade and recycled materials to maintain a 100 percent e-waste-neutral footprint.Network compatibility is fully certified for both T-Mobile and AT&T. items.title: Reddit Tests AI-Voice Video Feature That Turns Classic Text Threads Into TikTok-Style Clips
items.text: Reddit Tests AI-Voice Video Feature That Turns Classic Text Threads Into TikTok-Style Clips Summary Reddit is testing an experiment that transforms traditional text threads into TikTok-style portrait videos with AI voice narration.Inspired by popular third-party narrators, CEO Steve Huffman introduced the feature to natively capture background listening audiences. Reddit has officially begun a limited experiment to modernize its platform experience by turning existing text threads into multimedia content. The company is utilizing AI voices to narrate original posts and selected replies. These audio transformations are presented as TikTok-style portrait videos. To maintain the core identity of the site, original text threads remain entirely untouched. Users can access the legacy format or the new viewing mode via a slider toggle at the top of eligible posts.The visual presentation mimics short-form content heavily consumed on other applications. Switching to the media format yields a portrait-oriented clip where artificial intelligence reads the discussion aloud. The screen displays screenshots of the text while lighting up words in a karaoke style as they are spoken. A disclaimer reading "Real conversation voiced by AI" sits at the bottom of the screen to ensure transparency. Reddit deliberately limits these early tests to text-only discussions without multimedia elements like photos or GIFs.CEO Steve Huffman signaled this strategic pivot during the company's Q2 2026 earnings call. He noted the massive popularity of third-party creators on rival networks who narrate Reddit stories for millions of views. The platform now aims to cut out the middleman by providing a native solution. Executives want to offer background listening options for individuals who prefer consuming content while commuting or exercising. This move reclaims engagement that previously leaked to competing social platforms.The trial is currently rolling out across desktop browsers before hitting iOS and Android devices. Administrators are manually selecting English-language posts for the initial phase to ensure quality control. Curated examples include an eight-year-old r/boardgames discussion regarding road trip games and a recent thread questioning soccer timekeeping rules. Platform engineers plan to evaluate user reception and scale the offering to a broader range of communities if the early metrics prove successful. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Euro 7 Regulations Threaten Future of Audi’s 2.5-Liter Turbocharged Engine
items.text: Euro 7 Regulations Threaten Future of Audi’s 2.5-Liter Turbocharged Engine Summary Audi Sport is actively exploring ways to keep its legendary 2.5-liter five-cylinder engine alive for another generation.Strict Euro 7 emissions rules demand costly hardware overhauls that are difficult to justify on a niche, low-volume engine. The distinctive roar of the Audi RS3 might not be silenced just yet. For half a century, the odd-cylindered inline-five engine has served as a cultural hallmark for Audi. While the recent RS3 Competition Limited release felt like a swan song for the iconic motor, Audi Sport boss Rolf Michl recently revealed that internal evaluations are still underway to secure its survival for another generation. The brand recognizes the historical gravity of the powerplant and its unique soundtrack. Michl noted that the compact RS model serves as a vital emotional entry point for the high-performance lineup.The primary hurdle threatening the engine is the looming implementation of Euro 7 emissions standards. These strict new European regulations take effect in late 2026 and demand sweeping hardware overhauls. Compliance requires completely reworked particulate filters, specialized sensors and advanced catalytic converters. Audi CEO Gernot Döllner previously questioned the financial viability of such massive investments. The 2.5-liter turbocharged engine currently exists in a highly restricted production run. It only powers two low-volume vehicles: the Audi RS3 and the Cupra Formentor VZ5. Recouping development costs on such a niche footprint remains a massive corporate roadblock.Automakers face mounting pressure to balance heritage with an increasingly electrified and highly regulated market landscape. To keep the inline-five alive, Audi must find a way to justify the expense. One potential technical solution involves hybridizing the drivetrain. This strategy helped extend the life of the V6-powered RS5 but naturally introduces unwanted weight and complexity to a compact chassis.A more enthusiast-friendly approach relies on sheer production volume. The Audi RS3 shares the ubiquitous MQB platform architecture with countless other Volkswagen Group vehicles. Expanding the engine application to additional models could easily offset the steep Euro 7 compliance costs. Industry rumors suggest a highly tuned VW Golf R could eventually utilize the five-cylinder motor to celebrate the original R32 anniversary. Audi Sport moved roughly 36,000 cars globally last

items.title: Sony CEO Confirms PlayStation 6 Launch Date Remains Indefinitely Delayed
items.text: Sony CEO Confirms PlayStation 6 Launch Date Remains Indefinitely Delayed Summary Sony CEO Hiroki Totoki confirmed the company has not yet set an internal launch window or pricing strategy for the PlayStation 6, citing a global memory crisis complicating hardware timelines.Rising component costs fueled by the massive demand for RAM in artificial intelligence data centers have already pushed PlayStation 5 prices to record highs. Sony CEO Hiroki Totoki has confirmed that the tech giant remains unable to lock down a launch date for its next-generation console. While industry analysts previously anticipated a PlayStation 6 debut by 2027, the volatile semiconductor market and a widespread global storage crisis have forced the manufacturer to hit the brakes. Sourcing components has become increasingly difficult as the booming artificial intelligence sector dominates the supply chain, consuming massive amounts of RAM for data centers and driving up manufacturing costs across the consumer tech landscape.This economic squeeze is already reshaping the current generation's pricing model. Historically, consoles become more affordable late in their lifecycles, but the PlayStation 5 has bucked that trend entirely. In April, Sony hiked the hardware's cost to unprecedented levels, pushing the standard disc edition to $649.99, the Digital Edition to just under $600 USD and the premium PS5 Pro to a staggering $900 USD. Prioritizing business survival and profitability over fixed release cycles, the company appears reluctant to commit to PlayStation 6 pricing or production until the memory market stabilizes.Compounding the hardware delays is a controversial mandate regarding game preservation. A recent announcement confirmed that Sony will permanently cease production of physical game discs for all new titles starting in January 2028. Moving toward a strictly digital ecosystem makes it highly unlikely that the PlayStation 6 will even feature a disc drive, effectively locking out backwards compatibility for existing physical libraries and 4K Ultra HD Blu-rays.The aggressive pivot has fractured the community, sparking widespread backlash from game preservation advocates and long-time fans who feel alienated by the brand's recent direction. In response to the digital-only mandate and soaring hardware prices, frustrated players are organizing a "PSBlackout" protest. Scheduled to run from August 23 - 30, 2026, the week-long economic strike encourages gamers to unplug their systems

items.title: Apple Accidentally Leaks Camera-Equipped AirPods in macOS Tahoe Update
items.text: Apple Accidentally Leaks Camera-Equipped AirPods in macOS Tahoe Update Summary Apple inadvertently leaked a demonstration video for unreleased camera-equipped AirPods within the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate.The footage showcases a new Siri integration called Visual Intelligence that identifies physical objects and saves them for future reference. Apple accidentally revealed its highly anticipated foray into AI-powered wearables by leaving a demonstration video for camera-equipped AirPods tucked inside the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate. Developer Aaron Perris first spotted the 13-second instructional clip on X before MacRumors corroborated the discovery. The footage shows a user holding up a book while a voiceover introduces the Visual Intelligence feature. Siri states that "your world becomes saveable" and encourages users to ask the assistant to log interesting physical objects for later. While the exterior lenses remain hidden in the clip, the earbuds closely mirror the design language of the current Pro models but feature a noticeably thicker stem to house the new hardware. Here is your first look at AirPods with Cameras in action using Visual Intelligence.This video file came from macOS 26.7 RC pic.twitter.com/yo7RI4MCeu— Aaron (@aaronp613) August 18, 2026Industry insiders like Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman previously hinted at these upgraded wearables. Gurman noted the devices will utilize low-resolution sensors to supply visual context for Apple Intelligence. Rather than acting as traditional cameras for photography, these lenses serve as a constant feed for the smart assistant. The leaked video confirms this utilitarian approach to the hardware. A system alert embedded in the software warns users to ensure their AirPods remain uncovered for the most accurate environmental readings. This specific warning strongly suggests the presence of infrared sensors or basic obstruction detection for users with longer hair.This massive leak provides the most substantial evidence to date that Apple is ready to expand its spatial computing ambitions beyond the Vision Pro headset. Internal code strings label the device under the codename B790. Additional reports indicate this model is distinct from a separate camera-equipped wearable slated for a 2027 release. Given the timing of the macOS Tahoe 26.7 release candidate, the tech giant is heavily expected to officially unveil the new hardware alongside the iPhone 18 lineup at its upcoming September e

items.text: NEIGHBORHOOD Delivers Elaborate Yet Rugged Staples for FW26 Summary NEIGHBORHOOD has revealed the lookbook for its FW26 collection, which will be released via the brand's website and stockists on August 22, 2026.The lineup features leather jackets, embroidered bombers, varsity jackets, button-ups, and distressed knit sweaters, created with the brand's “Craft With Pride” ethos in mind. NEIGHBORHOOD has revealed its Fall/Winter 2026 lookbook, previewing its latest seasonal range ahead of its release later this week. Doubling down on its signature fusion of motorcycle subculture, heavy-duty military workwear and punk aesthetics, the range is grounded in a dark, atmospheric palette dominated by black, charcoal, faded indigo and rich earth tones.This season’s range highlights versatility, offering pieces that adapt seamlessly to both urban and outdoor environments while staying true to the brand’s “Craft With Pride” ethos. The lineup is led by an array of outerwear, spanning leather jackets, wooly winter coats, denim shirt jackets, varsity jackets to work jackets and bombers adorned with elaborate embroideries.The collection also features a selection of button-ups, sweatshirts and distressed knit sweaters, alongside ample bottom wear selections that complement the outerwear pieces. The FW26 collection officially launches on August 22, 2026, with availability through NEIGHBORHOOD’s online store and select global retailers. View this post on Instagram A post shared by NEIGHBORHOOD®︎ (@neighborhood_official) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: MAAP and Public Possession Team up for Volume II Cycling and Lifestyle Collection
items.text: MAAP and Public Possession Team up for Volume II Cycling and Lifestyle Collection Summary MAAP and Public Possession have reunited for Volume II of their collaborative cycling and lifestyle apparel collectionThe capsule spans technical on-bike performance wear alongside off-bike garments graphic tees and accessoriesThe full assortment is available now online and through select global retail locations MAAP and Public Possession have officially launched their second collaborative collection, dubbed Volume II. Bringing together the Australian cycling outfit and the Munich-based music and clothing label, the release bridges cycling performance, sound, and subculture across a full selection of on- and off-bike apparel.The comprehensive collection explores the intersection of cycling subculture, travel, and music heritage. For on-bike performance, the technical lineup features MAAP’s ProAir 3.0 and Emerge Jerseys, Team Bib Evo Cargo Bibs, and Long Sleeve Mesh Tees. Meanwhile, the off-bike offerings introduce casual sportswear options including short- and long-sleeve graphic tees, crewnecks, hoodies, and rain pants. One graphic tee notably plays with visual perception, incorporating an intentional typo design reading "I Want To To Ride My Bicycle."Rounding out the capsule is an array of functional accessories designed for both riding and daily use, including cycling caps, musettes, socks, water bottles, and an oversized tote bag. To celebrate the launch and showcase their shared love of sound, the duo also released an exclusive collaborative mix hosted on Soundcloud.The MAAP x Public Possession Volume II collection drops August 18, 2026, available now via MAAP, Public Possession, the Public Possession Munich store, and global MAAP LaB retail locations. items.title: UNDEFEATED & Jordan Brand Level-up With the Air Jordan 5
items.text: UNDEFEATED & Jordan Brand Level-up With the Air Jordan 5 SummaryThe UNDEFEATED x Air Jordan 5 "Moon Fossil" officially releases in February 2027, continuing their historic partnership.Maintaining a military-inspired aesthetic, it features a tan canvas upper, reflective tongue, distinctive stitching, and olive green co-branding.UNDEFEATED and Jordan Brand are making a 2027 return with an Air Jordan 5 reinterpreted in a "Moon Fossil" colorway. The legendary partners made history in 2005 with Jordan's first-ever collaboration by releasing a military-inspired Air Jordan 4. After reprising the AJ4 with a refresh 20 years later in 2025, the collaborators are moving on up to the Air Jordan 5.The “Moon Fossil” colorway features a tan canvas upper, a translucent blue outsole, and black midsoles with a shark-tooth accent. Notably, the lateral side features decorative spiral embroidery and a deconstructed overlock stitch following the contours of the collar. For branding, the collaborators embroidered the UNDEFEATED emblem on the lateral and a co-branded wordmark on the heel, both rendered in olive green thread. While the design shifts away from their AJ4's full olive green upper, the new AJ5 maintains the military-inspired essence of the collaboration with an aged canvas materiality. Jordan's classic gray and red palette appear on the oversized tongue, where the red Jumpman symbol lives in its central placement and a reflective stripe runs through the middle.According to multiple sources, the UNDEFEATED x Air Jordan 5 "Moon Fossil" is set for an official release in February 2027.  Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: VERDY Taps Artists That Inspire Him for New Tokyo Group Exhibition
items.text: VERDY Taps Artists That Inspire Him for New Tokyo Group Exhibition Summary Japanese artist and designer VERDY presents 'In Good Company,' a new group exhibition at GYRE Gallery in Shibuya, TokyoCurated by Paulo Calle, the artist's longtime collaborator, the show delves into work that has inspired VERDY through the yearsThe exhibition spans painting, photography, and sculpture and is on through September 27 VERDY and Paulo Calle’s friendship runs deep. After their first link-up in Tokyo in 2015, the creative consiglieres have been moving together, building their labels Girls Don’t Cry and Wasted Youth along the way. So when it came to opening their first group show, it only made sense to head back to where it all began.The Japanese artist and designer has unveiled In Good Company, a new group show at GYRE Gallery in Tokyo, with Calle, the stateside creative director, on as curator. Featuring an international slate of 14 artists the exhibition does away with a single theme, and instead goes all in on VERDY’S influences and the feeling of being amongst those whose work you genuinely connect with.There’s a painting duet by Zoé Blue M., whose playful Little Table Tokyo Tennis x ASICS mascots recently turned heads Paris Fashion Week; cute and mischievous ceramic animal sculptures from Alake Shilling and Diana Yesenia Alvarado; an abstract canvas by Reginald Sylvester II, the artist who first introduced VERDY and Calle; alongside work by VERDY himself.The exhibition “begins with a sense of feeling and resonance,” the gallery wrote, “the comfort, familiarity, emotion, and creative inspiration that these artists and their works have brought into our lives.”In Good Company is now on view at GYRE Gallery in Shibuya through September 27. Find the full list of artists below.Featured artistsAijani PayneAlake ShillingCam HicksCoco CapitánDevin B. items.title: Reebok and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed Question 96/26
items.text: Reebok and Zellerfeld Unveil the 3D-Printed Question 96/26 Summary Reebok and Zellerfeld have revealed the Question 96/26 a 3D-printed evolution of Allen Iverson's iconic signature modelThe release kicks off official celebrations for the 30th anniversary of the original Reebok Question silhouetteThe digital design launches in limited quantities on August 25 exclusively via Zellerfeld's online marketplace Reebok and Zellerfeld have officially unveiled the Question 96/26, a 3D-printed footwear silhouette that transforms Allen Iverson's first signature sneaker into an advanced, digitally native design. Serving as the opening release for the 30th anniversary of the original Reebok Question, the new model translates the classic 1996 basketball shoe into an on-demand 3D-printed ecosystem.The Question 96/26 reinterprets the stance, sweeping proportions, and defining design cues of the original basketball sneaker using Zellerfeld's 3D printing technology. Sculpted into a continuous, fluid structure, the shoe features updated iterations of the silhouette’s signature oval midsole windows and honeycomb cushioning geometry. Launching in Lilac and Stone colorways, the model translates Allen Iverson’s archival heritage into a digital design file that can be updated, produced on demand, and evolved over time.By shifting the historical silhouette into a digital format, Reebok and Zellerfeld move beyond traditional retro re-releases, material updates, or colorway variations. The collaboration utilizes advanced robotics to preserve the original design DNA while establishing a scalable, digitally native platform for future iterations.The Reebok Question 96/26 drops in limited quantities on August 25, 2026, at 12 p.m. ET, available exclusively via Zellerfeld for $169 USD. items.text: Drake's OVO and UFC Reconnect for Exclusive 2026 Capsule Collection Summary UFC and Drake's October’s Very Own (OVO) have announced their second collaborative apparel collection launching this FridayCanadian UFC welterweight Mike Malott serves as the face of the official campaignThe lifestyle range includes hoodies jerseys graphic t-shirts and long-sleeve shirts featuring co-branded artwork UFC and Drake's October’s Very Own (OVO) have officially announced their second collaborative collection, dropping an exclusive lifestyle apparel capsule for 2026. Designed to bridge combat sports with modern lifestyle fashion, the upcoming release officially launches later this week.The upcoming drop builds upon the ongoing partnership between the premier mixed martial arts organization and the Canadian lifestyle brand founded by Drake, Oliver El-Khatib, and Noah "40" Shebib. The collection features a range of premium lifestyle garments, including hoodies, athletic jerseys, graphic T-shirts, and long-sleeve shirts. Each piece integrates fighter-inspired artwork alongside co-branded UFC x OVO iconography, uniting OVO's signature owl branding with UFC heritage motifs. One of the pieces gives a nod to Hasbulla Magomedov while Drake and OVO also pay homage to Islam Makhachev who recently defeated Ian Machado Garry and now holds the record for the longest individual winning streak in UFC history at 17 consecutive wins.Fronting the release campaign is No. 12-ranked UFC welterweight contender Mike Malott. Serving as the primary face of the collection, the Canadian athlete brings an authentic fighter perspective to the project, highlighting the shared discipline, perseverance, and cultural connection between both global entities.The latest UFC x OVO collab drops Friday, August 21, at 10:00 a.m. ET online. items.title: Polaroid Collaborates With Pokémon for a Limited-Edition Collection
items.text: Polaroid Collaborates With Pokémon for a Limited-Edition Collection Summary Polaroid teams up with Pokémon for a special collaborative drop celebrating 30 years of the franchise.Highlights include a Poké Ball Polaroid Now camera, Pikachu and Sylveon Polaroid Go models, themed film and custom accessories.Pre-orders open on August 25, 2026, followed by a global release on October 5. Polaroid and Pokémon have joined forces to celebrate Pokémon’s 30th anniversary with a limited-edition drop. Marking Polaroid’s largest collaborative effort to date, the range brings the franchise’s energetic universe to tangible analog photography. Designed to appeal to both long-time collectors and new fans, the lineup encourages creators to capture everyday moments through custom-styled hardware and specialized accessories.The collab spotlights three special-edition cameras, each featuring distinctive Pokémon motifs. Leading the drop is the full-sized Polaroid Now Camera Generation 3 decked out in a bold Poké Ball pattern, accompanied by two pocket-sized Polaroid Go Generation 3 cameras styled after Pikachu and Sylveon. Complementing the cameras are custom instant film packs featuring custom dark slides and Pokémon-themed frames, as well as a protective Polaroid Go camera case, a matching mini photo album, and a universal camera strap.Highlighting the collaborative ethos, Mathieu Galante, Licensing Senior Director at The Pokémon Company International, noted, "Pokémon has always been about discovery, connection, and exploration. Working with Polaroid feels like a natural extension of these values: encouraging fans to capture moments that matter most to them in their own way and turn their favourite memories into tangible keepsakes."Spanning an accessible price range from just under $15 USD for the universal camera strap up to $140 USD for the Polaroid Now Poké Ball edition, the collection caters to casual shooters and serious enthusiasts alike. Global pre-orders open August 25, 2026, on Polaroid's official website as well as Pokémon Center across the US, UK and Canada, followed by an official worldwide release on October 5, 2026. items.text: Kohei Ogawa Expands His Storybook Universe With ‘Green Cow Garden’ Pop-up in Hong Kong Hong Kong’s BELOWGROUND at LANDMARK is hosting an exclusive pop-up event from August 15 - 31 with Japanese artist and illustrator Kohei Ogawa. Presented by HOW2WORK CTC and organized by regional collectible distributor SAKA SAKA, the Green Cow Garden Pop-Up Store serves as both an immersive gallery and a curated retail space. Bringing Ogawa’s beloved, idyllic universe to life, the two-week event merges original artwork, limited-edition vinyl figures, lifestyle goods and trading cards into a cohesive exhibition experience. Anchored by a 1.4-meter BG Bear statue serving as the installation's visual centerpiece, the venue extends Ogawa’s signature soft, storybook aesthetics directly into the space.The main highlight of the showcase is Ogawa’s debut in the trading card game (TCG) space: the global launch of the HOW2WORK CTC Green Cow Series 1. Translating his character illustrations into archival formats, the series comprises 137 distinct card designs spanning Normal, Rare, Parallel Rare and Secret rarities, alongside randomly inserted hand-drawn sketch cards and on-card autographed UR cards. To commemorate the milestone, a range of event-exclusive merchandise is available, led by the BG Bear Collector’s Set.Ahead of the opening, Hypebeast caught up with Kohei Ogawa to discuss the worldbuilding behind Green Cow Garden, transitioning his artwork from canvas and soft vinyl to collectible cards.Welcome back to Hong Kong! What story are you telling this time with your takeover at BELOWGROUND?Kohei Ogama: This time, we’re introducing collectible trading cards featuring a whole host of characters from my Green Cow Garden universe. I really just want people to get to know them and discover all the different characters I've built out over the years.Can you tell us about the concept of the Green Cow pop-up and its universe?The main idea behind this pop-up is really to introduce the world of Green Cow Garden to everyone. Because I’ve accumulated a large archive of work, turning those pieces into collectible cards felt like a natural next step. The lore itself is set in an old, abandoned human town located near a city. Once the humans left, animals began gathering there, eventually settling down and building a thriving community of their own.” I really want my art to reach a broader audience.”This event marks the global debut for your HOW2WORK trading cards. items.title: Dead Kennedys and UNDER R Merge Hardcore Punk Archive and Streetwear
items.text: Dead Kennedys and UNDER R Merge Hardcore Punk Archive and Streetwear Summary UNDER R partners with San Francisco punk band Dead Kennedys on an archival artwork capsule.Features ZINE-collaged shirts, album art tees, jackets, caps, and socks with custom co-branded neck tags.Drops August 22, 2026, in-store and online via UNDER R. Japanese retailer UNDER R has partnered with seminal 1970s San Francisco hardcore punk band Dead Kennedys for a collaborative apparel capsule.Fusing music, subcultural art and modern streetwear, the collection curates iconic visual assets from the band’s extensive archive. The lineup translates archival album covers, rare concert flyer art and collaged ZINE graphics across a range of streetwear staples, spanning T-shirts, long-sleeve shirts, jackets, caps and socks. Each item carries a custom collar tag combining the Dead Kennedys’ iconic logo with UNDER R’s Old English branding, underscoring the authenticity of the collaboration.To mark the partnership, every piece is finished with a custom co-branded neck label combining the Dead Kennedys' emblem with UNDER R’s signature Old English logo. The Dead Kennedys x UNDER R collection officially releases on August 22, 2026, dropping in-store and online through UNDER R. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.text: le PÈRE Gives the PUMA Suede a “Gentle Man” Makeover Name: PUMA x le PÈRE Suede “Gentle Man”Colorway: Cashew Brown-Silver FogSKU: 409077-01MSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: August 23Where to Buy: PUMA, le PÈREPUMA and le PÈRE have introduced a chic re-interpretation of the classic Suede silhouette. This updated release blends the nostalgic character of vintage French bowling footwear with the effortless sophistication that defines le PÈRE's Lower East Side "Gentle Man" style.The sneaker features a premium full-suede upper with a slimmed-down profile and a distinctive split-toe design, elevating the archival silhouette with subtle sophistication. A contrasting heel panel stamped with dual branding from PUMA and le PÈRE adds a polished detail, while the cream colorway accented by a green lining underscores the balance of understated elegance and playful refinement.Contextually, this release marks the first installment of PUMA and le PÈRE's FW26 collaboration, highlighting their shared ambition to merge sportswear heritage with contemporary menswear sensibilities. Launching on August 23, 2026, the sneaker will be available exclusively through le PÈRE’s New York City flagship store, accompanied by a live performance from Isaiah Rashad. HUF has reunited with Toyota Racing Development (TRD) for a Fall/Winter 2026 collaborative drop. Merging motorsport heritage with streetwear culture, the collaboration spotlights TRD’s performance-driven identity through HUF’s graphic-heavy design language.The capsule spans T-shirts, hoodies, jackets and caps, each featuring co-branded logos, sponsor-style graphics, and racing-inspired motifs. The lineup emphasizes bold iconography and authentic detailing, creating apparel that feels rooted in motorsport while maintaining HUF’s skate and streetwear edge. Accessories round out the lineup, extending the collaboration into lifestyle items that reinforce the crossover between racing and street culture.The collaborative collection is set to release today at 9 a.m. PDT via HUF's official website. items.title: Converse Expands the All Star POINTEDTOE Series With Two Dressy Low-Tops
items.text: Converse Expands the All Star POINTEDTOE Series With Two Dressy Low-Tops Name: Converse All Star POINTEDTOE PA OX, All Star POINTEDTOE GL OXMSRP: ¥10,450 JPY (approx. $66 USD)Release Date: August 21Where to Buy: Converse JapanFollowing the introduction of the radically altered silhouette earlier this year, Converse is expanding its elevated All Star POINTEDTOE series with two new low-top iterations: the PA OX and the GL OX.These updated models reimagine the iconic Chuck Taylor DNA by pairing its classic rubber tooling with a sharply tapered, dress-shoe-inspired toe. The All Star POINTEDTOE PA OX leans into a sleek, sophisticated aesthetic by utilizing a glossy synthetic patent leather across the upper. Designed for a minimalist look, the sneaker features tone-on-tone detailing — from the matching shoelaces to the uniformly colored embroidered "ALL STAR" logo on the tongue. Available in stealthy "Black" and a deep, eye-catching "Dark Red," the PA OX perfectly balances the casual comfort of a sneaker with the refined elegance of a formal pump.As for the All Star POINTEDTOE GL OX, the model offers a bold, structural twist inspired by traditional ghillie shoes. This iteration reimagines the lacing system with a split lace-stay construction that dramatically exposes the center of the instep, allowing the wide, waxed cotton shoelaces to take center stage as a defining design element. The matte finish of the waxed laces elegantly contrasts the smooth sheen of the upper, resulting in a highly stylized, modern profile. Arriving in a rich "Dark Cherry" and a monochromatic "Black," the GL OX delivers a striking visual while still preserving signature Converse hallmarks like the medial ventilation holes, silver eyelets and the classic diamond-patterned outsole.
