items.title: Toyota Uses Acoustic “Plastic Hammer” Diagnostic Tool To Solve Massive V6 Engine Recall
items.text: Toyota Uses Acoustic “Plastic Hammer” Diagnostic Tool To Solve Massive V6 Engine Recall Summary Toyota has introduced a "V35A Crank Bearing Inspection" for its recalled 3.4-liter twin-turbo V-6 engines that involves striking the crankshaft pulley with a custom plastic hammer.Technicians attach an accelerometer to measure resonant frequencies and identify internal bearing damage from manufacturing debris without requiring a full engine teardown. Toyota engineers have devised an unorthodox but highly scientific solution to diagnose a massive engine recall affecting over a hundred thousand vehicles. Mechanics are now testing the recalled 3.4-liter twin-turbo V-6 engines found in recent Tundra trucks and Lexus SUVs by striking them with a custom plastic hammer. The striking procedure addresses a critical manufacturing defect where machining debris left behind on the assembly line can degrade internal components. If ignored, this contamination wears down the main bearings and eventually causes catastrophic engine failure.Officially designated as the V35A Crank Bearing Inspection, the diagnostic tool functions on the exact same acoustic principles as a tuning fork. Service workers previously faced a massive logistical challenge and costly physical teardowns just to determine internal engine health. Dealerships can now bypass that exhaustive manual labor. Technicians simply attach a small accelerometer to the crank bolt and hit the front pulley with a specialized gavel. Diagnostic software then reads the resonant frequencies traveling through the metal block to assess the condition of the number-one main bearing.Measuring these structural vibrations in a controlled environment allows the automaker to identify microscopic abnormal wear without dismantling the truck. Every factory component shares an identical mass and material composition, meaning a healthy engine block will vibrate at a highly predictable frequency. The diagnostic hammer itself provides direct feedback to ensure the swing strength falls within an acceptable range. If the resulting acoustic response deviates from the established baseline metric, the software flags the bearing as heavily damaged.The Japanese automotive giant previously resorted to outright replacing the twin-turbo V-6 for the initial wave of affected owners. This newly implemented surgical approach allows service centers to process the extensive recall campaign much faster while ensuring high-risk motors are properly condemned. Veh

items.title: McDonald’s Launches Dessert-Inspired Caramel Apple Pie Coffee Lineup
items.text: McDonald’s Launches Dessert-Inspired Caramel Apple Pie Coffee Lineup Summary McDonald’s introduced a limited-time Caramel Apple Pie coffee lineup as its featured seasonal offering for fall 2026.The new menu includes four distinct beverage options including iced coffee, hot or iced lattes and a blended frappe.Each drink combines apple and caramel flavoring with the chain’s bold coffee and is topped with salted caramel whipped cream and apple pie crumbles. McDonald’s overhauled its autumnal beverage strategy with the launch of a new Caramel Apple Pie coffee line. The limited-time collection officially arrived at participating locations nationwide on August 18, 2026. Opting for a nostalgia-driven profile over traditional pumpkin spice, the fast-food giant designed the new syrup to mimic the taste of its classic baked dessert. The resulting flavor profile blends sweet apple and caramel notes directly into the brand's signature bold coffee.Customers can order the seasonal release in four different formats. The menu features a standard iced coffee, hot lattes, iced lattes and a blended frappe. To emphasize the dessert-inspired theme, every beverage is finished with a topping of whipped cream, a drizzle of salted caramel sauce and crunchy apple pie crumbles. The latte variations specifically utilize Rainforest Alliance Certified espresso mixed with steamed or cold milk. The blended frappe offers a heavier, ice-based alternative for regions still experiencing late-summer heat.The flavor profile serves as a direct homage to a long-standing staple of the McDonald's dessert menu. The company has served warm apple pies since the late 1960s, debuting around the same time the iconic Big Mac hit restaurants. The chain eventually replaced the original fried version with an oven-baked lattice pie in 1992. By transforming this familiar pastry into a caffeinated format, the brand leverages consumer nostalgia to stand out in a highly competitive autumn coffee market.Recent industry survey data ranks McDonald’s as the third most popular national chain for coffee, highlighting significant consumer interest in drive-thru beverage options. The new specialty drinks provide an affordable alternative to traditional coffeehouses. Nutritional profiles vary across the lineup, with a small iced coffee containing 240 calories and 23 grams of sugar. items.title: Toyota Celebrates 60 Years of Corolla With Limited 2027 Special Edition
items.text: Toyota Celebrates 60 Years of Corolla With Limited 2027 Special Edition Summary Toyota unveiled the limited 2027 Corolla 60th Anniversary Special Edition based on the Hybrid SE trim.Features two-tone 18-inch wheels, custom badging, Supersonic Red paint, black/red sport seats, and a 10.5-inch touchscreen.Capped at 2,500 US units, the 138-hp hybrid model arrives in early 2027. Toyota officially unveiled the 2027 Corolla alongside a new 60th Anniversary Special Edition that honors the nameplate's global debut in 1966. Over six decades, the compact car transformed into a staple of the global automotive landscape. Now the brand aims to celebrate that enduring legacy by outfitting the commemorative model with specialized styling tweaks and upgraded tech. Built on the popular Hybrid SE trim, the anniversary vehicle trades traditional SE badging for exclusive decals on the rear doors. Buyers can select between Ice Cap or the edition-exclusive Supersonic Red exterior paint. Visual upgrades are rounded out by a set of two-tone 18-inch machined alloy wheels with a sleek black finish.The interior of the anniversary model focuses on a sportier aesthetic to match the athletic exterior stance. Drivers are greeted by black and red sport seats featuring specialized fabric inserts alongside custom anniversary-themed floor mats. Door sill plates carry the commemorative motif to emphasize the vehicle's limited-run status. Modern technology takes center stage via a standard 10.5-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia System. This expansive display is a significant upgrade over the standard eight-inch screen found on entry-level models. Furthermore, the cabin integrates the Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 suite to provide a comprehensive array of driver-assistance systems.Mechanically, the 60th Anniversary Special Edition utilizes a highly efficient hybridized powertrain. The vehicle is equipped with a 1.8-liter four-cylinder engine paired to the fifth-generation Toyota Hybrid System. This setup produces a net combined 138 horsepower while delivering an estimated 50 combined miles per gallon. The chassis rides on the proven TNGA-C platform to provide a low center of gravity and agile handling capabilities. items.title: ‘Dune: Part Three’ Unleashes Final Chapter Visuals in Latest Teaser Footage
items.text: ‘Dune: Part Three’ Unleashes Final Chapter Visuals in Latest Teaser Footage Summary Denis Villeneuve’s Dune: Part Three triggered online queues and immediate box office sellouts as advance tickets went live.Filmed with IMAX cameras, the sci-fi epic delivers 71 minutes of exclusive expanded aspect ratio footage.Early December screenings hit 25 specialized US 70mm IMAX theaters days before its official December 18 premiere. Denis Villeneuve’s highly anticipated Dune: Part Three ignited a massive ticketing frenzy this week as seats for the trilogy's conclusion finally hit premium format booking platforms. Following a rapid sellout of initial advanced sales back in April, Warner Bros. opened the floodgates for registered "Dune Insiders" to secure early viewing access. The sudden surge in consumer demand immediately crippled the digital infrastructure of major theater chains, creating endless online queues, widespread error messages and immediate sellouts across the country.Easing the sting of the booking chaos, a new television spot arrived in tandem with the ticket drop. While lighter on plot details than a full theatrical trailer, the fleeting footage delivers a series of dark, intriguing visuals designed to hype up the final chapter on Arrakis. Dedicated fans who survived the digital gauntlet secured passes for a staggered rollout of advanced screenings, which kick off with IMAX 70mm showings on December 14, standard IMAX viewings on December 15 and additional premium formats on December 17.Villeneuve famously constructs his sci-fi worlds with the biggest screens in mind, and this final installment remains no exception. Captured utilizing a hybrid of IMAX Film Cameras and IMAX-certified digital lenses, the blockbuster boasts 71 minutes of exclusive expanded aspect ratio footage. Standard IMAX screens will project these massive sequences in a 1.90:1 ratio, while a select number of IMAX with Laser and 70mm film locations will open up to a towering 1.43:1 frame. The massive 15-perforation film cells hold nearly ten times the resolution of a traditional 35mm print, maximizing the immersive scale of the desert planet.Experiencing the sci-fi epic in its most premium analog format requires a bit of luck, as only 25 theaters across the United States currently house the specialized projection equipment needed for 70mm IMAX film. items.title: Vine Reboot “Divine” Drops Waitlist and Opens to the Public
items.text: Vine Reboot “Divine” Drops Waitlist and Opens to the Public Summary Divine, an unofficial successor to Vine led by early Twitter architect Evan Henshaw-Plath, has ended its invite-only phase and is now available to the general public.The decentralized application maintains the beloved 6-second looping video format and features a classic feed containing over 2 million restored videos from the original Vine archive. Divine, the highly anticipated Vine reboot guided by early Twitter architect Evan Henshaw-Plath, is officially open to the public. The application recently eliminated sign-up codes following a three-month invitation-only beta period to welcome a new generation of creators. Users gain immediate access to a classic feed packed with more than 2 million restored videos from the original archive, preserving the legendary 6-second looping video format that defined an era of internet culture.The new venture positions itself as a sanctuary from algorithmic manipulation and artificial intelligence. Divine strictly prohibits AI-generated media and requires users to record all footage directly through the native in-app camera. Built-in verification tools guarantee the authenticity of every upload. The development team aims to foster genuine human creativity rather than surface-level engagement bait by removing the relentless pressure to optimize for recommendation engines.Divine's technical foundation relies on the open-source Nostr protocol, an architecture notably backed by Twitter co-founder Jack Dorsey. This decentralized infrastructure fundamentally shifts power back to the user community. The system grants individuals true ownership over their identity and content instead of centralizing authority within a single corporate entity. The public launch arrives at a cultural inflection point. Widespread nostalgia for the simplicity of early social media continues to drive users away from the opaque algorithms of current tech giants.The platform prioritizes long-term creator sustainability to avoid the fatal flaws of its predecessor. The original Vine notoriously lost its top-tier talent after failing to provide adequate financial support. Henshaw-Plath and his team are actively exploring distinct monetization structures to ensure influencers can build profitable audiences. This commercial strategy also extends to brand partnerships. items.title: Cadillac Challenges European Hypercar Houses With Track-Only V-One Concept
items.text: Cadillac Challenges European Hypercar Houses With Track-Only V-One Concept Summary Cadillac unveiled the single-seat V-One concept, built on Dallara’s carbon monocoque from the V-Series.R prototype.Freed from race rules, its naturally aspirated 5.5-liter V8 hybrid pushes 830 horsepower.Featuring a silver-to-navy endurance paint gradient, Cadillac is evaluating a limited run for private collectors. Cadillac disrupted Monterey Car Week by unveiling the V-One at The Quail, A Motorsports Gathering. The track-only hypercar concept is born directly from the brand's championship-winning V-Series.R Le Mans prototype.The vehicle utilizes the exact same Dallara carbon fiber monocoque and pushrod-actuated suspension as the competition model. However, freed from strict LMDh class regulations, the naturally aspirated 5.5-liter V-8 hybrid powertrain has been fully unleashed. It now produces a staggering 830 combined horsepower, significantly surpassing the 670-horsepower limit imposed on the race car. Cadillac aims for lap times within ten percent of the professional racing counterpart while tuning the dynamics to be highly accessible for non-professional drivers.Aesthetically, the single-seater maintains the dramatic aerodynamic proportions of the prototype while introducing premium bespoke finishes that align with the brand's luxury identity. The exterior features a meticulous hand-sprayed paint gradient fading from silver at the nose to deep navy at the rear. This distinct visual treatment was designed to symbolize the grueling transition from day to night during a traditional 24-hour endurance race. An illuminated physical Cadillac emblem replaces the standard racing decal on the front structure, joining updated dark-persona badging and a completely new V-Series wheel design tailored specifically for this project.Inside the exposed carbon fiber cockpit, pure prototype racing hardware merges with elevated passenger luxury. The driver-focused cabin is outfitted with specialized recycled fabrics from the Cadillac Collection, a serialized door plaque denoting its exclusivity and a driver’s seat molded to exact customer physical specifications. Engineers also developed an intuitive custom user interface and a tailored steering wheel button layout. This high-tech setup provides clear telemetry data, visual feedback and coaching so the immense hybrid power remains manageable on the circuit for enthusiasts stepping into a factory-level machine.While officially billed as a c

items.title: Apple Leaks Unreleased Devices Weeks Ahead of Annual September Event
items.text: Apple Leaks Unreleased Devices Weeks Ahead of Annual September Event Summary Code references found in the macOS Tahoe 27.6 release candidate have revealed identifiers for over 10 upcoming Apple devices across the iPhone, Mac and smart home product lines.The leak highlights the development of the iPhone 18 series, a foldable iPhone Ultra model, a new home hub running homeOS and camera-equipped AirPods designed for Visual Intelligence features. Apple accidentally left the back door open in its latest software update. Code references buried inside the macOS Tahoe 27.6 release candidate have exposed identifiers for a massive slate of unreleased hardware. Discovered by developers examining the code, the backend strings provide technical evidence for several highly anticipated gadgets nearing production. The software slip offers a rare, unfiltered look at the tech giant's immediate roadmap just weeks ahead of its traditional September hardware showcase.The highly scrutinized iPhone 18 lineup leads the string of leaks. Identifiers point directly to a staggered release strategy encompassing the standard iPhone 18, iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. Most notably, the code includes a V68 designation that aligns with the long-rumored iPhone Ultra. This device is widely expected to be the brand's first foldable smartphone. Internal markers also reference an iPhone Air 2 model that will likely arrive in a later product cycle.Beyond mobile devices, the leak confirms major expansions to the brand's audio and living room ecosystems. A built-in demo video discovered within the files gives a first look at camera-equipped AirPods. The footage features Siri instructing users on how to capture and save real-world objects using Visual Intelligence sensors mounted in the earbud stems. Alongside the headphones, the code outlines a Home Hub smart display. Sporting the J490 codename, this seven-inch tabletop unit will reportedly run a new operating system called homeOS and feature a dashboard heavily inspired by the iPhone StandBy mode.Rounding out the premature reveals are several core computing upgrades. The backend data flags an incoming OLED iPad mini equipped with an A19 Pro chip. Multiple Mac identifiers also appear, signaling the imminent arrival of M6 MacBook Pro configurations and refreshed iMac desktop computers. items.title: On and FKA twigs Debut the Cloudmonster 3 Mule for FW26
items.text: On and FKA twigs Debut the Cloudmonster 3 Mule for FW26 Summary On and FKA twigs have unveiled their Fall/Winter 2026 collection centered around post-performance restorationThe release debuts the Cloudmonster 3 Mule featuring triple-layered CloudTec cushioning across two earth-toned colorwaysThe footwear silhouette is accompanied by relaxed apparel and launches globally on August 27 On and FKA twigs have officially announced their Fall/Winter 2026 collection, highlighted by the debut of the Cloudmonster 3 Mule. Shifting the creative focus from high-intensity training to intentional post-performance recovery, the latest collaborative release introduces the Swiss sportswear brand's first-ever mule silhouette.Designed specifically for slower tempos and post-workout restoration, the Cloudmonster 3 Mule features an ergonomic slip-on construction supported by triple-layered CloudTec® cushioning underfoot. Drawing aesthetic inspiration from natural earth pigments and terrestrial terrain, the backless model debuts in two initial colorways: "Cacao / Espresso" and "Loes / Hare."Accompanying the new footwear silhouette is a suite of relaxed apparel and lifestyle accessories constructed from substantial cotton fabrics and soft, tactile textures. Key pieces from the collection include the Club Collective Full Zip Hoodie, the Club Collective Pants, and the Studio Bodysuit. The campaign—directed by FKA twigs and photographed by Sharna Osborne with a 90s VHS aesthetic—was launched alongside an immersive somatic live event at Seoul’s Oil Tank Culture Park.The On x FKA twigs Fall/Winter 2026 collection officially drops on August 27, 2026, available online and select global retail partners. items.title: WIND AND SEA Reunite With ‘Parappa the Rapper’ for a Special 30th Anniversary Collection
items.text: WIND AND SEA Reunite With ‘Parappa the Rapper’ for a Special 30th Anniversary Collection Summary WIND AND SEA pairs with 'PaRappa the Rapper' for a 30th-anniversary capsule featuring new Rodney Greenblat artwork.Includes rhinestone tees, "96" zip hoodies, kids' apparel, keyholders and woven lifestyle blankets.Launches August 22, 2026, alongside a special pop-up at Shinsaibashi PARCO. WIND AND SEA has reconnected with PaRappa the Rapper once more for a commemorative collection celebrating the rhythm game’s 30th anniversary. Highlighting original artwork newly created by character designer Rodney A. Greenblat, the collection translates the franchise's playful 1990s visual aesthetic into WIND AND SEA’s signature street-ready silhouettes.The lineup includes T-shirts featuring PaRappa’s artwork, rhinestone-detailed designs, pencil-style illustrations, and “96” motifs referencing the character’s 1996 debut. Zip-up hoodies, knit caps, obi-style belts, and necklaces expand the apparel range, while lifestyle items such as blankets, phone grips, magnets, and multi-trays bring PaRappa’s world into everyday use. Kids’ sizes are also available, allowing families to coordinate looks across generations.Key accessories include PaRappa-branded knit caps, pillbox hats, obi-style belts, and silver or gold chain necklaces. The lifestyle lineup is further rounded out by character keyholders spotlighting Master Onion and PJ Berri, custom phone grips, air fresheners, multi-trays and co-branded woven blankets.To mark the release, a dedicated 30th-anniversary pop-up event will run at Shinsaibashi PARCO from August 19 through September 1, 2026. The full collection officially launches globally on August 22, 2026, via the WIND AND SEA webstore and select retail outposts. View this post on Instagram Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III – The Curse of the Serpent’ Lands on Netflix Next Month
items.text: ‘Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III – The Curse of the Serpent’ Lands on Netflix Next Month Summary Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III – The Curse of the Serpent streams on Netflix starting September 29, 2026.Produced by Studio Kafka and Twin Engine, the film concludes the Edo Castle horror trilogy.The story focuses on the Midaidokoro as a vengeful serpent god threatens the empire. Following its theatrical bow in Japan earlier this year, Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III – The Curse of the Serpent (also known as The Serpent God) will officially land on Netflix next month.Directed by chief director Kenji Nakamura and Tomoaki Koshida with animation produced by Studio Kafka and Twin Engine's EOTA, the film marks the grand finale to the feature film trilogy that began with 2024’s The Phantom in the Rain (Karakasa) and 2025’s The Ashes of Rage (Hinezumi). Centered inside the Ōoku - the inner sanctum of Edo Castle - the trilogy examines the internal struggles of noblewomen, with this third chapter shifting focus to the Midaidokoro (the highest-ranking woman in the inner palace) as a vengeful serpent god threatens the empire.The Curse of the Serpent will join its two preceding films on Netflix starting September 29, 2026, where it will be available to stream worldwide. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: Disney and Bobby Kim Deliver Their First Nostalgic Graphic Tee Collection
items.text: Disney and Bobby Kim Deliver Their First Nostalgic Graphic Tee Collection Summary Disney and Bobby Kim launch "Collection 1: Classics," a six-shirt capsule celebrating vintage Disney graphics and subcultural history.Features adult t-shirts highlighting The Little Mermaid , Fantasia , Oliver & Company , The Lion King and rare Mickey illustrations.Available exclusively on DisneyStore.com from August 20 to August 23, 2026, while supplies last. Disney has officially revealed "Collection 1: Classics," marking the debut release from an ongoing collaboration with Bobby Kim, Vice President and Global Creative Director for Disney Consumer Products. Curated directly from Kim’s personal affinity for archival Disney design, the initial capsule serves as a nostalgic tribute to classic character art, subcultural streetwear tropes, and vintage theme park apparel. The range is built around six limited-edition graphic tees designed for adults, drawing creative inspiration from iconic animated feature films, rare Japanese vintage finds and historic 1990s skate aesthetics.The six-shirt assortment highlights a diverse mix of fan-favorite heroes, villains, and scene-stealing sidekicks. Key styles include a navy The Little Mermaid shirt styled after faded 1980s park tees, an ivory Lady and the Tramp top celebrating the 1955 film's classic spaghetti dinner scene, and a white Oliver & Company tee honoring the 1988 NYC-set animation.Villain enthusiasts are catered to with a black The Lion King tee highlighting Scar and the hyena trio Shenzi, Banzai, and Ed, alongside a white Mickey Mouse tee featuring a rare 1990s oval skate-graphic composition with a red bow tie. Rounding out the drop is a Harajuku-inspired Fantasia Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey shirt rendered in black with an all-over star print and hand-drawn illustration.The Disney x Bobby Kim "Collection 1: Classics" capsule drops via DisneyStore.com, launching on August 20, 2026, at 9 p.am. PT and will remain available through August 23, while supplies last. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: adidas Originals Outfits Pets in Real Madrid and Manchester United Kits
items.text: adidas Originals Outfits Pets in Real Madrid and Manchester United Kits Summary adidas Originals FC Pets Collection brings football-inspired jerseys and accessories for dogs and cats.Features Manchester United, Arsenal, Liverpool, and Real Madrid kits plus collars, tees and carriers.Available now via adidas webstores, the adidas app and flagship locations worldwide. adidas Originals has officially expanded its lifestyle footprint with the launch of its 2026–27 FC Collection for Pets. Bringing pitch-side style directly to dogs and cats, the sports-inspired lineup translates official club kits into miniature, pet-friendly apparel.The range features miniature football jerseys for major European and American clubs, including Real Madrid, Manchester United, Arsenal and Club América. Tailored specifically for common pet proportions, each jersey incorporates lightweight, breathable fabrics alongside signature team crests, Three Stripes sleeve striping, and co-branded sponsor graphics, allowing fans to style their pets in matching match-day kits.Beyond the core replica jerseys, the collection offers a broader lifestyle lineup engineered for everyday active pets. The assortment includes sporty graphic tees, weather-resistant track jackets, adjustable Three Stripes collars and co-branded leash sets to deliver a complete head-to-paw aesthetic.The adidas Originals FC Pets Collection is officially available now, dropping globally across adidas.com, the official adidas app and select flagship retail stores. items.title: Ben Quilty Makes the World Scream in 'Devil/God'
items.text: Ben Quilty Makes the World Scream in 'Devil/God' Summary Ben Quilty makes his New York solo debut with 'Devil/God' at albertz benda.The exhibition explores masculinity, power, religion, climate collapse and institutional violence.Drawing from Arthur Conan Doyle’s 'When the World Screamed,' Quilty frames the show as a response to a world pushed to breaking point. Australian artist Ben Quilty is making his New York solo debut with Devil/God, a new exhibition at albertz benda confronting masculinity, power and a planet pushed to its limits.The exhibition takes its cue from Arthur Conan Doyle’s 1928 short story When the World Screamed, in which Professor Challenger drills into the Earth to prove it is a living organism, provoking a scream and violent earthquakes in the process. Nearly a century later, Quilty revisits the premise as ecological collapse makes the story feel less like science fiction.Known for his heavily impastoed paintings, Quilty turns his expressionistic language toward climate change, colonial violence, religion and the systems of power behind them. At the center is one of his most persistent subjects: masculinity. Cars, a recurring motif in his work, become symbols of male pride and aggression, appearing in place of heads or distorted to absurd proportions. One oversized carburetor scoop becomes so large that driving itself is rendered impossible.Elsewhere, Quilty takes aim at institutional authority through a carved figure of the Virgin Mary made from alternating layers of leather and plywood. The materials reference straps historically used to punish children in church schools, transforming a familiar religious icon into an ambiguous figure of comfort, complicity and violence.Throughout Devil/God, Quilty resists easy distinctions between victim and perpetrator, beauty and brutality. Beneath the slashing brushstrokes, mutated bodies and menacing forms are flashes of tenderness and innocence, positioning the work somewhere between anger and empathy.Devil/God is on view at albertz benda in New York from October 15 through November 14, 2026.albertz benda515 W 26th St.New York, NY 10001 Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Bode Is in the Peak of Its Cowboy Era for SS27
items.text: Bode Is in the Peak of Its Cowboy Era for SS27 SummaryBode’s SS27 collection reimagines the 1865-1890s American cowboy era, blending ornate Western styles with contemporary, wearable staples.Signature details include playful cow prints, subtle rodeo motifs, heavy suede and leather fringing, and intricately decorated denim.As a continuation of the FW26 Rodeo Bodeo concept, Bode designer Emily Adams Bode Aujla explores signature Western styles with a timeless touch for SS27. Centering on “the peak of the American cowboy era” (circa 1865 - 1890s), the latest range features strong cowboy cultural references combined with the ornate embellishments and durable materials of the time.Standing out immediately is a women's look featuring a brown cow print bikini and jacket, a high-exposure contemporary number that grounds this time-hopping collection in the present. The pattern continues in a men's look comprising a jacket and shorts outlined by matching green trims and styled with a green striped tee. Other fabrics incorporate cowboy motifs like rope tricks and horses in colorful patterns. Some executions are more discreet than others: a gray animal print is superimposed with blue cowboys in mid-lasso form, which are only visible with a closer glimpse.Suede and leather fringe play a major role in imbuing the broader collection with a cowboy feel. Brown leather riding pants are emphasized with a short fringe finish up the legs, while multiple jackets, including a red blouson with a decorative yoke, feature more dramatic fringe moments. Denim also continues as a main staple for SS27, featured in a camp-collar long-sleeve adorned with star rivets at the pocket and a chore jacket, decorated with folk-style trims around the collar, pockets, and cuffs.Styled with a certain ease true to the present, the overall collection goes heavy on Western-inspiration through statement pieces while grounding it in a foundation of wearable staples like the t-shirts, trousers, and tailored ensembles.See the full Bode SS27 collection in the gallery above. items.title: Superkicks Reimagines the adidas Samba as a Wearable Family “Heirloom”
items.text: Superkicks Reimagines the adidas Samba as a Wearable Family “Heirloom” Name: Superkicks x adidas Originals Samba “Heirloom”Colorway: TBCSKU: TBCMSRP: TBCRelease Date: August 29Where to Buy: Concepts store UAE, Shopigo Turkey, The good life UAE, Carnival Thailand, amos Tokyo, DSM JapanSuperkicks and adidas Originals have joined forces to launch the Samba "Heirloom," a collaborative sneaker that beautifully celebrates memory, craftsmanship and the stories we choose to preserve.Deeply rooted in Indian heritage, the conceptual release draws inspiration from the traditional peti — a handcrafted storage trunk used across generations to safeguard cherished belongings such as photographs, letters, and jewelry. Much like this vessel of family history, the globally recognized Samba silhouette is reimagined as a wearable heirloom. Originating in 1950 as a functional football shoe, the Samba has spent decades transcending its athletic roots to become a cultural icon across terrace, skate, music, and fashion landscapes. By intertwining this rich sportswear legacy with a profoundly personal Indian tradition, the partnership highlights the shared, universal themes of preservation and continuity.Translating the understated character of the peti into a contemporary lifestyle sneaker, the Superkicks x adidas Originals Samba "Heirloom" boasts a refined, material-driven aesthetic. The upper is constructed from a sophisticated blend of premium leather and rich suede, directly evoking the enduring craftsmanship and permanence of traditional Indian storage trunks.Subtle metallic detailing acts as a thoughtful nod to the precious keepsakes, jewelry, and intricate hardware often found within a peti, adding an elegant, elevated finish to the design. Rather than a literal recreation of the wooden trunk, the collaboration offers a nuanced homage that seamlessly fuses the Samba’s timeless DNA with deeply rooted cultural storytelling. Ultimately, the "Heirloom" iteration transforms a legendary sportswear staple into a meaningful tribute to heritage, designed to be worn, treasured and passed down. items.text: Studio Mir and Brian Tyree Henry Team Up for Netflix Original ‘Bass X Machina’ Summary Netflix released the teaser for Bass X Machina , confirming a global premiere date of November 3, 2026.Animated by Studio Mir, the steampunk Western stars Brian Tyree Henry as lawman Bass Reeves.The series blends historical frontier lore with steam-powered mechs, cyberware and industrial soundscapes. Netflix has officially released the first teaser trailer for Bass X Machina, an upcoming original animated series that reimagines the life of legendary Wild West lawman Bass Reeves through an action-packed steampunk sci-fi lens.Produced by Studio Mir - the animation studio behind Devil May Cry, The Legend of Korra and Voltron: Legendary Defender - the series stars Emmy-nominated actor Brian Tyree Henry as the voice of Bass Reeves. Set against an alternate post-Civil War American frontier, the story follows Reeves, a former enslaved man turned formidable deputy US Marshal, as he navigates a treacherous landscape populated by outlaw gangs, steam-powered mechs, and cybernetic enhancements.The 78-second teaser trailer offers a high-octane preview of the show's blend of historical Western lore and futuristic mechanical warfare, showcasing heavy-hitting revolver shootouts, train heists, and colossal mech battles across snow-covered frontier towns.Watch the latest teaser above. Netflix has confirmed that Bass X Machina will make its global streaming debut on November 3, 2026. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘Fool Night’ Will Premiere on Netflix This November
items.text: ‘Fool Night’ Will Premiere on Netflix This November Summary Bandai Namco Filmworks released a new teaser for Fool Night , confirming a global Netflix premiere on November 26, 2026.Co-animated by Sunrise and Shaft, the dystopian sci-fi series adapts Kasumi Yasuda’s award-winning manga about human-to-plant "transfloration." Bandai Namco Filmworks has released a new teaser trailer for Fool Night, officially announcing that the anime will premiere worldwide on Netflix on November 26, 2026.Adapted from Kasumi Yasuda's acclaimed manga series serialized in Shogakukan’s Big Comic Spirits, the story is set in a bleak, sunless future where oxygen levels have plummeted, forcing humanity to develop "transfloration" — a surgical procedure that turns terminally ill individuals into oxygen-producing plants in exchange for a monetary grant.Co-animated by Sunrise and Shaft under director Hiroshi Yasuko, the narrative follows Kamiya Toshiro (voiced by Kouki Uchiyama), an impoverished young man who undergoes transfloration and finds himself tangled in a series of botanical murder investigations.The 60-second teaser trailer offers an eerie, atmospheric look into the anime’s body horror worldbuilding and noir-infused visual design. Alongside lead voice actor Uchiyama as the main protagonist, the preview also unveils newly added cast members, including Fairouz Ai as Yomiko Yomogi, Yuka Nukui as Ayaka Akira, Ayane Sakura as Ayasuko Amano and Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiratoko. items.title: The First Dedicated Jellyfish Museum in the US Opens in South Florida
items.text: The First Dedicated Jellyfish Museum in the US Opens in South Florida Summary The private Jellyfish Museum has officially opened in Florida as the first facility in the United States dedicated exclusively to the aquatic predators.Founded by Ukrainian refugees Alex and Yana Yanovsky, the destination houses roughly 20 distinct species inside customized saltwater tanks and immersive digital environments. The Jellyfish Museum has officially opened its doors just north of Fort Lauderdale, establishing itself as the first dedicated facility of its kind in the United States. Lit primarily by glowing saltwater tanks and expansive oceanic projections, the mesmerizing space in Pompano Beach places a singular focus on the resilient, brainless invertebrates that have populated the earth’s oceans for more than 500 million years.The ambitious project is the brainchild of Alex and Yana Yanovsky, who bring over two decades of experience in the aquarium industry. The couple previously operated a successful jellyfish-centric attraction in Kyiv but were forced to leave the facility behind when fleeing the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Recognizing the universal draw of the pulsing, translucent creatures, the founders quickly sought to recreate their passion project in South Florida as their first stateside aquatic endeavor.Transforming a former Wells Fargo bank branch into an underwater sanctuary, the 10,000-square-foot venue was supported by roughly $100,000 in community redevelopment grants from the city. The immersive space is designed to foster a sense of deep tranquility, pairing its 21 specialized tanks with five-meter-high 3D projections that simulate the feeling of drifting through open currents.Inside, the museum rotates through a diverse roster of marine life acquired via licensed aquaculture partners. Current highlights include Japanese sea nettles, spotted jellies and the upside-down jellyfish, a species commonly found resting on the seafloor among Florida’s native mangrove swamps. Because the animals consist almost entirely of water and possess a simple nerve net rather than a centralized brain, their rhythmic movements offer a meditative visual experience unmatched by traditional aquariums.Beyond aesthetics, the founders aim to provide essential ecological context. items.title: beabadoobee Explores Nostalgia and Longing on Latest Single “Memories”
items.text: beabadoobee Explores Nostalgia and Longing on Latest Single “Memories” Summary beabadoobee released "Memories," the latest single from her upcoming fourth album, Pylon .First debuted during her live set at Lollapalooza and Hinterland, the song blends bittersweet nostalgia with raw, unfiltered songwriting. beabadoobee has shared her latest single, "Memories," offering another sonic glimpse into her upcoming fourth studio album, Pylon.Described by Bea as “one of the happiest songs on the album,” the track carries a bittersweet undercurrent, with lyrics that romanticize past moments while acknowledging the sadness of wanting to live in them forever. Lines such as “clinging onto ideas that should make me happy but actually make me feel sad” capture the tension between nostalgia and longing. Sonically, “Memories” continues the raw, unfiltered songwriting approach that defines Pylon, a record Bea has said was written largely in solitude, echoing the intimate process of her teenage years.Having recently given "Memories" its live debut during festival appearances at Lollapalooza and Hinterland, as well as a headline performance at Red Rocks Amphitheatre, beabadoobee is now gearing up to bring these new tracks on the road. The artist will embark on the 'Powerlines Tour' this late fall - her biggest headline run to date - which kicks off October 1, 2026, and includes arena stops at Madison Square Garden, The Kia Forum, and London's The O2 Arena. items.title: LEGO Pays Homage to Ayrton Senna With 931-Piece F1 Helmet Set
items.text: LEGO Pays Homage to Ayrton Senna With 931-Piece F1 Helmet Set Summary LEGO unveiled a 931-piece set (#43024) recreating Ayrton Senna’s iconic yellow, green, and blue Brazilian racing helmet.The set features printed vintage sponsor logos, brand-new helmet printing techniques, and custom curved builds.Includes an Ayrton Senna minifigure in a Senninha cartoon tee, a mini helmet and a signed display plaque for $89.99 USD. LEGO expanded its Formula 1 Helmet Collection with a 931-piece tribute to three-time World Champion Ayrton Senna. The set, designated as number 43024, recreates the unmistakable yellow helmet featuring the green and blue stripes of the Brazilian flag. Unlike several previous entries in the series that relied on a shared modern template, this model uses specific build techniques to mirror the more rounded and compact profile of era-appropriate racing headgear. The Ayrton Senna Helmet specifically celebrates the driver's legendary 1988 season where he secured his first World Drivers' Championship behind the wheel of the dominant McLaren MP4/4.The collectible kit introduces several premium details designed to satisfy hardcore motorsport enthusiasts. Builders will find printed versions of period-accurate sponsor graphics, including the vintage BOSS emblem and the now-defunct Nacional bank logo. For the first time in its brick history, the brand developed a new technique to print directly on the back of a motorcycle helmet element. This commitment to accuracy elevates the display piece beyond a simple toy, turning it into a genuine piece of racing memorabilia that honors a silhouette instantly recognizable from across a room.Beyond the primary build, the package includes an exclusive Ayrton Senna minifigure depicted with a partially unzipped race suit revealing a graphic t-shirt underneath. The shirt features Senninha, which is a beloved cartoon persona created by Senna himself to inspire children in his home country. The minifigure is accompanied by its own miniature matching headpiece and can be positioned on the included display base right next to a printed signature plaque. This pairing adds a highly personal touch to the build, bridging the gap between the man and his larger-than-life motorsport legacy.Set for an official release on September 1, 2026, the commemorative project joins a modern LEGO Editions lineup that already includes grid mainstays like Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc. items.title: Amazon Scales Prime Air Drone Network to Nearly 500 US Cities
items.text: Amazon Scales Prime Air Drone Network to Nearly 500 US Cities Summary Amazon announced a massive expansion of its Prime Air drone delivery service, aiming to serve nearly 500 US cities and towns by the end of 2026.New service areas scheduled for launch include metropolitan hubs in Atlanta, Boise, Chicago, Cleveland and Syracuse.The network utilizes MK30 drones to transport lightweight packages in roughly 60 minutes without generating traditional vehicle emissions. 13 years after Jeff Bezos first pitched the sci-fi concept of airborne logistics on national television, Amazon is finally taking its drone delivery network mainstream. The retail giant announced a sixfold expansion of its Prime Air program, projecting coverage for nearly 500 US cities and towns by the end of 2026. Operations will soon launch in major metropolitan areas including Atlanta, Boise, Chicago, Cleveland and Syracuse. These new hubs join 11 active locations across the country, fundamentally accelerating how consumers receive everyday essentials.The expanded service relies on the MK30 drone, a fully electric aircraft capable of cruising at 73 mph at altitudes up to 300 feet. Six vertical propellers provide lift, allowing the machines to navigate light rain and winds exceeding 20 mph. Each local site serves a 175-square-mile radius, pushing packages weighing five pounds or less directly to customer driveways and backyards. Delivery times clock in around 60 minutes, though some drops are completed in as little as half an hour. Consumers can order millions of eligible items ranging from cosmetics and groceries to high-end electronics like smartphones.Prime Air has already executed hundreds of thousands of drops this year, with internal projections targeting one million annual deliveries. The corporation is aggressively incentivizing the adoption of this futuristic fulfillment method. Prime members receive free ultrafast shipping on orders exceeding $50, while smaller baskets incur a minimal $2.99 fee. Non-members pay a flat rate of $4.99. By integrating drone dispatch stations into both small same-day facilities and massive robotic fulfillment centers, the brand is bridging the gap between digital storefronts and immediate physical gratification.Scaling autonomous aviation requires strict regulatory compliance and community approval. items.title: Voltempo Reimagines Heavy Logistics With a "Box on Wheels" Electric Lorry
items.text: Voltempo Reimagines Heavy Logistics With a "Box on Wheels" Electric Lorry Summary UK electric vehicle specialist Voltempo is developing a cabless 15.6-meter autonomous rigid lorry designed to maximize cargo capacity and minimize vehicle weight.Prototype testing is scheduled for late 2027 at a dedicated track in South Wales with initial commercial deliveries expected to begin in mid-2028. UK electric vehicle specialist Voltempo is engineering a cabless autonomous rigid lorry that pushes heavy goods transport beyond current legal dimensions. The prototype stretches to 15.6 meters in length and utilizes a five-axle layout with a 42-tonne capacity. By completely ditching the traditional driver space, the vehicle transforms into what founder Michael Boxwell calls a "smart trailer." This streamlined approach significantly reduces both aerodynamic drag and overall vehicle mass to extend electric range while maximizing freight volume.Eliminating the cab frees up roughly two tonnes of dead weight. An electric articulated tractor and trailer typically weigh around 19 tonnes empty, but the new design drops the unladen mass to between 10 and 12 tonnes. That architectural shift creates 15 % more cargo space and adds five to seven tonnes of usable payload. Instead of adapting an old diesel format, the company is building a hyper-efficient box on wheels tailored strictly for autonomous operations and zero-emission delivery.The physical construction is being handled by Berkeley Coachworks an advanced manufacturing facility specializing in lightweight composite structures. A prominent commercial vehicle manufacturer will supply the electric drivetrain. Every major European truck brand has reportedly signed on to approve the prototype as an official vehicle classification. The timeline moves aggressively, with the initial build slated for completion by September 2027. Testing kicks off shortly after at a dedicated track in South Wales.Favorable legislative shifts are paving the way for immediate real-world application. The UK Automated Vehicles Act 2024 establishes a legal framework for driverless transport to operate on public roads, meaning trials will likely scale directly to highway routes. Initial deployment targets hub-to-hub motorway trunking and short-distance intermodal shuttles between ports and logistics centers. items.text: Mattel Integrates Secret Cheat Codes into 3,509-Piece Original Xbox Replica Summary Mattel unveiled a 3,509-piece, $330 1:1 scale building set recreating the original Xbox console and its classic "Duke" controller for the platform's 25th anniversary.The interior houses removable dioramas and 12 NanoWorld figures celebrating Halo: Combat Evolved , Morrowind and Psychonauts . Nostalgia meets detailed craftsmanship as Mattel has announced a massive 1:1 scale building brick recreation of the original Xbox console. Released under the premium Mattel Brick Shop brand to celebrate the upcoming 25th anniversary of the platform, the 3,509-piece interactive display piece serves as a physical tribute to early 2000s gaming history. The highly detailed set features an authentic replica of the hardware alongside its famously oversized "Duke" controller.Builders who assemble the intricate exterior can pop open the top of the console to trigger the iconic original Xbox startup sequence. Inside, the shell houses three distinct modular dioramas paying homage to genre-defining classics Halo: Combat Evolved, The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind and Psychonauts. These highly detailed modules seamlessly slot into the main chassis and can also be removed for individual display. To populate these miniature scenes, the box includes 12 separate one-inch NanoWorld figures featuring eight characters from the Halo universe, two from Morrowind and two from Psychonauts.The included Duke controller functions as an interactive remote rather than just a static companion piece. Pressing the tactile buttons on the controller triggers unique sound and lighting effects that bring the interior dioramas to life with their corresponding in-game soundtracks. True to early gaming cheat codes, builders can also input a secret button combination to unlock an exclusive hidden lighting sequence. This ambitious crossover highlights a growing collector market where premium toy manufacturers are elevating retro gaming hardware into high-end display art.Priced at $330, the immersive building set is currently available for pre-order through various major retailers including Amazon, Best Buy and the official Mattel Creations website. Early listings suggest the sprawling tribute will begin shipping to eager fans on October 1. The release follows previous block-building forays into the gaming space, arriving as a premium centerpiece for enthusiasts looking to physically recreate their favorite digital memories. Cli

items.title: Hyundai Debuts Boxy “Art of Steel” Aesthetic on the 2027 Tucson
items.text: Hyundai Debuts Boxy “Art of Steel” Aesthetic on the 2027 Tucson Summary Hyundai unveiled the fifth-generation 2027 Tucson, showcasing a larger, boxier design inspired by the brand’s recent Crater concept.The redesigned interior debuts the centrally mounted Pleos infotainment system, replacing the previous model's dual-screen layout. Hyundai unveiled the new 2027 Hyundai Tucson, introducing a radical departure from the curvier outgoing model. The fifth-generation crossover steps into a bolder aesthetic utilizing the brand's Art of Steel design language. Up front, a full-width lighting bar pairs with vertical H-shaped LED daytime running lights while indirect lighting produces a soft glow to emphasize the three-dimensional front fascia. The squared-off front and rear quarter panels, sharp angles running across the door skins and beefy rocker panels give the vehicle a striking profile. At the rear, the design incorporates a light bar and narrow vertical prism lamps equipped with three-dimensionally protruding lenses.The updated SUV grows in virtually every dimension to cement its position as a highly capable family hauler. The vehicle measures 185 inches long, adding 2.3 inches over its predecessor, while the track widens by 1.5 inches to improve ride quality and expand interior room. The wheelbase now stretches to 109.6 inches, contributing to improved cabin proportions. Second-row passengers benefit directly from the lengthened roof and stretched wheelbase, gaining over an inch of additional headroom while rear doors that open wider allow for easier access.Inside, the completely new cabin follows modern industry trends by swapping the twin curved displays of the previous generation for a single tablet-like Pleos infotainment system. Floating dashboard elements, orange accents and air vents separating the upper and lower sections create a distinct futuristic vibe. Drivers face a narrow digital gauge cluster and a squircle four-spoke steering wheel. A striking stacked central transmission tunnel and console house wireless phone charging pads alongside plenty of soft-touch materials.For buyers seeking a more aggressive aesthetic, the XRT variant returns with exclusive rugged styling cues. The adventurous model features a distinct boxy front bumper, a dedicated rear bumper, a prominent skid plate, unique badging and black exterior accents. items.title: Can-Am Drops Two Unrestricted SxS Concepts to Signal Future Design Direction
items.text: Can-Am Drops Two Unrestricted SxS Concepts to Signal Future Design Direction Summary Can-Am unveiled the Defender Prerunner and Maverick R XRay, two non-production side-by-side concepts exploring extreme off-road design.The Defender Prerunner boasts a 6x6 configuration with 35-inch tires and an integrated LinQ bed built for hardcore desert race support. Can-Am introduced two wild side-by-side concepts that push the boundaries of extreme all-terrain engineering. Dubbed the Defender Prerunner and Maverick R XRay, these conceptual flights of fancy serve as unrestricted design studies rather than impending production models. Unencumbered by mass-manufacturing realities, the brand’s designers created aggressive purpose-built machines that signal future stylistic evolutions in the off-road space.Conceived as the ultimate remote race support vehicle, the Defender Prerunner is a gargantuan six-wheeled beast engineered to conquer the planet's most grueling environments. The custom crew cab truck rides on a heavy-duty 6x6 configuration, anchoring its stance with rugged beadlock wheels wrapped in massive 35-inch off-road tires. The exterior is equipped for maximum utility, sporting front and rear winches, a robust front skid plate and platforms designed to hold specialized tools. A specialized LinQ bed houses a massive spare tire carrier alongside mounted fuel jugs and shovels, preparing the rig for high-stakes desert recovery operations.Inside the cabin, the heavy-duty utility transitions to high-performance motorsport aesthetics. The driver and passenger are secured in premium Sparco racing seats paired with four-point harnesses. A flat-bottom steering wheel, fully digital instrument cluster and an integrated infotainment system provide the crew with modern tactical control during remote excursions.Targeting sand dune culture, the Maverick R XRay takes a radically different approach that prioritizes lightweight agility and nighttime presence. The two-wheel-drive concept swaps traditional body panels for an aggressive exoskeleton structure covered by translucent, backlit panels. Likened to an illuminated wasp nest, the glowing bodywork serves a functional safety purpose: the ambient lights shift to a bright red when the driver applies the brakes. The lighting can also be programmed with various dynamic patterns to ensure the vehicle stands out against the dark desert backdrop.To optimize performance in deep sand, the Maverick R XRay sits aggressively on dedicated pa

items.title: EVANGELION:95 Drops Third Impact Graphics and Distressed Caps for Its Second FW26 Drop
items.text: EVANGELION:95 Drops Third Impact Graphics and Distressed Caps for Its Second FW26 Drop Summary EVANGELION:95 FW26 Drop 2 delivers four graphic tees, two caps and a stole featuring a large colored illustration of Rei Ayanami.Designs spotlight iconic anime scenes from both the 1995 Neon Genesis Evangelion and The End of Evangelion .Available now via the EVANGELION:95 webstore. Following up on its earlier release this month, EVANGELION:95 returns with the second delivery of its seasonal collection, continuing to translate iconic scenes and motifs from the original Neon Genesis Evangelion anime and The End of Evangelion film into everyday wardrobe staples. The new drop comprises four distinct graphic T-shirts, two cap variants and a statement scarf.Leading the tee selection is the white 0104 T-Shirt, which showcases a grid layout of the series' core female characters from the 1995 opening sequence. Meanwhile, the dark-toned 0106 T-Shirt presents an ominous visual of the crucified Lilith inside Terminal Dogma. Drenched in deep purple, the 0102 T-Shirt captures EVA Unit-01's long-range sniper attack against the 5th Angel from Episode 6. Rounding out the apparel, the white 0107 T-Shirt immortalizes a pivotal Third Impact scene from The End of Evangelion, depicting Unit-01 emerging from the third eye of the Rei/Lilith hybrid.On the accessories front, the 0124 Cap arrives in black and brown with a subtly distressed finish, featuring heavy-metal-style "MASS PRODUCTION MODEL" embroidery above an embroidered Spear of Longinus and splattered red dots that evoke the film's climactic battle. Closing out the release, the 0120 Stole is emblazoned with Yu Honda's iconic illustration of an injured Rei Ayanami floating in a pool of LCL. The full delivery is available now via the EVANGELION:95 webstore, with prices ranging from ¥16,500 to ¥26,400 JPY (approx. 104–166 USD). Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: ‘Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2’ Teaser Locks in Official Netflix Release Date
items.text: ‘Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2’ Teaser Locks in Official Netflix Release Date Summary Netflix confirmed Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 officially premieres globally on October 20, 2026.Produced with Studio Trigger, the standalone 10-episode sequel returns to Night City with a fresh cast.English and Japanese dubbed teasers showcase hyper-kinetic action centered on revenge and redemption. Netflix has unveiled a new teaser for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, confirming the anime’s official premiere date of October 20, 2026.Produced once again in collaboration with Studio Trigger, the upcoming sequel series returns to the neon-drenched streets of Night City to follow an all-new storyline set within the universe of CD Projekt RED's Cyberpunk 2077. Building on the overwhelming critical and commercial success of the 2022 original, which sparked a massive surge in the video game's player base - the new project continues the franchise's signature mix of hyper-kinetic action and emotional storytelling.In the meantime, watch the official English dubbed teaser above, and the Japanese version teaser below. Read more at Hypebeast

items.title: UNION Subverts Industrial Uniforms for New Dickies Collaboration
items.text: UNION Subverts Industrial Uniforms for New Dickies Collaboration Summary UNION and Dickies drop a capsule flipping classic workwear inside out with exposed seams.Features inverted chore jackets, Eisenhower-style tops, double-knee work pants, and graphic T-shirts.Drops today online and across UNION Los Angeles and Tokyo flagships. UNION has joined forces with Dickies for a collaborative Fall/Winter 2026 capsule titled "INVERSE." True to its name, the collection reimagines Dickies' classic utilitarian silhouettes by flipping traditional garment construction inside out. The design language highlights exposed seams, inverted fabric textures, and contrast stitching across Dickies' signature heavy-duty cotton twill. By subverting industrial uniforms into elevated street staples, the joint project bridges Union’s refined West Coast streetwear aesthetic with Dickies' century-old workwear legacy.The "INVERSE" capsule centers around a set of co-branded workwear suits, featuring unstructured chore jackets and wide-leg Eisenhower-style tops paired with matching double-knee work pants and relaxed trousers. Each piece is finished with dual logo patches, exposed interior taping, and subtle contrast stitching that emphasizes the collection's inside-out theme. The lineup is further complemented by graphic T-shirts and daily layering tops.The UNION x Dickies “INVERSE” collection officially releases today via UNION's official webstore and in-store across UNION flagship locations in Los Angeles and Tokyo. items.title: ASICS Debuts the GEL-KINETIC FR in a Duo of Two-Tone Colorways
items.text: ASICS Debuts the GEL-KINETIC FR in a Duo of Two-Tone Colorways Name: ASICS GEL-KINETIC FR “Cocoa Powder” & “Black”Colorway: Cocoa Powder/Champagne, Black/Pure SilverSKU: 1203B051-200, 1203B051-001MSRP: TBCRelease Date: August 21Where to Buy: ASICSASICS is debuting the GEL-KINETIC FR sneaker, a progressive new everyday model that draws heavily from the brand's early-2000s running archive. Coming in two colorways - "Cocoa Powder/Champagne" and "Black/Pure Silver" - the silhouette features a feather-light construction that wraps closer to the foot, creating a streamlined, fluid profile. A reworked synthetic quarter panel gives the layered, technical upper a cleaner look.Underfoot, the shoe features an evolved cushioning system inspired by the GEL-KINETIC 2.0, incorporating Scutoid GEL technology with pods positioned directly beneath the heel for enhanced comfort. Additionally, a thicker sock-lining construction adds forefoot cushioning and contributes to a smoother transition through each step, perfectly balancing the shoe's technical foundation with a softer, more considered feel. items.title: Czapek Reverses Its Escapement for the Skeletonized Promenade Transparencies Aqua Blue Watch
items.text: Czapek Reverses Its Escapement for the Skeletonized Promenade Transparencies Aqua Blue Watch Summary Czapek introduces the Promenade Transparencies Aqua Blue, limited to 38 pieces, featuring a smoked sapphire dial with blue fumé gradient.Powered by the skeletonized Calibre SXH7, showcasing dual‑sided finishing and recycled platinum micro‑rotor.Available for pre-order now via Czapek. Czapek has expanded its openworked line with the launch of the Promenade Transparencies Aqua Blue, a limited edition that builds on the design language established by its predecessor, the Viridian Green. The watch’s centerpiece is a smoked sapphire crystal dial engineered to expose the fully skeletonized, in-house movement beneath.To achieve its blue fumé gradient, Czapek utilizes a specialized metallization process that applies microscopic metallic dots - each measuring approximately eight microns in diameter - to the underside of the sapphire disc. The dot density gradually thins out toward the center and thickens at the outer edges, providing optical clarity over the movement while creating an opaque perimeter.Fitted into a slender 38mm stainless steel case measuring 10.8mm thick, the watch introduces custom hand-applied hour markers made from solid blocks of light blue Super-LumiNova. Beneath the sapphire dial beats the automatic Calibre SXH7, an in-house skeletonized movement whose seven openworked bridges pay homage to François Czapek’s 19th-century pocket watches.To present a clean, architecture-focused front, Czapek’s watchmakers reversed the escapement and relocated the small seconds subdial off-center to the 4:30 mark. The movement also features a micro-rotor machined from 100% recycled platinum, openworked ratchets, sandblasted bridges and extensive hand-chamfered inward angles that are finished symmetrically across both sides.Capped at a limited run of just 38 pieces, the Czapek Promenade Transparencies Aqua Blue opens for orders starting today via Czapek’s Geneva flagship boutique, authorized global retailers, and the brand’s website. items.title: Aimé Leon Dore Teases Knicks Collaboration for FW26 Delivery 1
items.text: Aimé Leon Dore Teases Knicks Collaboration for FW26 Delivery 1 SummaryAimé Leon Dore’s FW26 collection features collaborations with Technics, GORE-TEX, The North Face, and Last Resort AB.Delivery 1, which may include the brand’s first Knicks cap alongside Yankees headwear and new apparel, will be released shortly.Aimé Leon Dore has officially unveiled its FW26 lookbook, which appears to hint at a possible New York Knicks collaboration. Rooted in the brand’s NY provenance, the broader collection brings its signature high-end sportswear aesthetic into the fold with additional collaborative pieces from Technics, GORE-TEX, The North Face, and Swedish label Last Resort AB.If you flip through the lookbook, you can easily miss the single Knicks cap featured in the collection alongside new Yankees caps and beanies. The Knicks cap could very well be the brand’s first-ever partnership with the basketball team, though it has repped the NY Yankees baseball team as far back as 2017. The lookbook also continues its collaborations with Japanese audio brand Technics and GORE-TEX, while introducing another debut footwear collaboration with Swedish brand Last Resort AB. Standout outerwear pieces include the Suede Cafe Racer Jacket, the Technics Varsity Leather Jacket, and a North Face puffer jacket with leather yoke details. The season’s knitwear is expressive with chunky yarns and colorful Fair-Isle patterns. Tailoring is executed with classic woolen tweeds and earth-toned windowpane checks seen in double-breasted jackets and matching trousers. To balance out more tailored looks, denim plays a crucial role in this range, appearing in double-knee carpenter pants, pinstriped jeans, and even shirting.The Aime Leon Dore Delivery 1 drops on Friday, August 2 at 11 AM ET on aimeleondore.com and at the brand’s flagship stores in New York, Los Angeles, and London. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

items.title: Supreme Chief Creative Officer Steps Down After 22 Years
items.text: Supreme Chief Creative Officer Steps Down After 22 Years SummaryErin Magee stepped down as Supreme's Chief Creative Officer after 22 years, likely to focus on her growing label, Mademe.Her exit adds to Supreme's recent instability, following Tremaine Emory's controversial resignation and successive corporate buyouts.On August 20, Supreme Chief Creative Officer Erin Magee announced her departure via Instagram after more than two decades at the NYC-born streetwear label. “It has been the honor of a lifetime to be part of the World Famous Supreme Team,” she shared in the post.Magee had been with the brand since 2004, having held several positions during her tenure. Since the brand’s early days, she has been behind the development and direction of some of the brand's most iconic pieces and collaborative projects. In 2007, Magee launched women's streetwear brand Mademe, which she may very well center her focus on now that she has departed from Supreme. The Mademe label has continued to grow in the 2020s, capturing major partnerships with brands like Doc Martens, Alpha Industries, and Courtney Love's band Hole. View this post on Instagram A post shared by erin_mademe (@erin_mademe)The news is only the latest reshuffle to come from the brand in recent years, including its 2020 VF Corp acquisition, designer Tremaine Emory’s sudden departure from his new Creative Director role in 2023, and VF’s sale of the label to EssilorLuxottica in 2024. Emory's departure, only a year after his appointment, was particularly controversial as he cited internal discrimination as the reason for his decision. Since then, the brand has left the Creative Director position without replacement. Supreme has yet to announce who will fill Magee's long-held CCO role.Stay tuned to Hypebeast for the latest fashion industry news and insights. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast
